hymns.title: 'Mochenu Omochenu
verses:
'Mochenu_Omochenu or' Omonguru,
Ekero bogokia tokobake Aye;
'Mochenu 'Monyamabera bw'echinguru,
Nay'omogambi kare na kare.

'Mochenu malaika bagosasima,
Babek' egutw'as'enyancha y'ekerore;
'Megand' emeganda bakogosasima,
Naye oreo kare na kare.

'Mochenu nony'omosunt'ogontuba,
Nonya titokoror'obonene bwao;
Nay'or' omochenu kobua bonsi,
'S'obwanchani, 'nguru n'obochenu.

hymns.title: Tobake Nyasae
verses: Tobake Nyasae, As'Omwan' Omwanchwa, Ase Yes'okwete bon'ore Igoro.
Tobake Nyasae, As'omoik Omuya; Otworokirie Yeso Omotoria.
'Gotogigw'ase, 'Manw'eria yakwete; Kabogori' ebibe na gotosibia.
Atogigw'ere Nyasae bw'obuya; Oy'otogorire na gotoraa.
Toboki'emioyo, toichori' Obwanchani; Morero Igoro okune chinkoro.
hymns.refrain:
Haleluya tokobake, Haleluy'abe bo;
Haleluya tokobake, toboki emioyo.

hymns.title: Motogie Tat'Okorir'Amanene
verses:
Motogie Tat'okorir' amanene,
Agancha'ens agato' Omwan'oye,
Akerua gokwa atosibi' ebibe,
Oyoranche anyore Obogima.

Okoborigwa ogoikeranu,
Oyobwanchire nare na eira
Mosari'onde bwensi oramwegene,
Kegim'ere nanyore okwaberwa.

Okorire na kwegeri'amanene,
Twagokire ime y'Omwana Yeso,
Nkob'ogokumia 'bochenu, 'bonene,
Tomoroche gator'as' orogendo.
hymns.refrain:
Mobake 'Monene, Ense emoigwe,
Mobake 'Monene, Abanto bagoke:
Inchwo ase Tata Yes' abarete,
Momotogie okorir' amanene.

hymns.title: Togi' Okobua Kwa Yeso
Togi' Okobua Kwa Yeso
verses:
Togi'Okobua kwa Yeso Malaika sasima,
Malaika sasima; Ret' egutwa y'obogambi;

'Nw'abachore b'omonene, Mwagorirwe,
Nere, Mwagorirwe Motogi'oyobatoririe;

Nainwe abanto bonsi, Mor'ase ens'eye,
Mor'ase ens'eye; 'Bonene bwonsi nobwaye;

Amo n'omogand'oigoro, Natomosasime,
Natomosasime; Ntosange am'ogotera;
hymns.refrain:
SIT: Mobe-kere, Mobe,-kere,'gutwa,
Mobe-ker'egutwa.
A: Momobe-kere, 'gutwa, 'gutwa, Mobe-kere 'gutwa,
Mobekere'egutwa.
B: Momobe-kere, 'gutwa, E-gutwa.
Mobeker'egutwa.

hymns.title: 'Ba Igoro Mosasim' Omogambi
verses:
Aba Igoro sasim Omogambi Tera
Obwanchani bw'ogokumia; Enguba
Embingwa nere botambe;
Y oichire nobuya n'ogotogigwa.

Ter'obobui n'obuya bwaye.
Ere bwebisetie Oborabu:
'Ndamwamu yaye yareta rirumbe,
Nabuet' obotindi bwemerindo.

Borendi bwao mbogokwaneka,
Bwarosi' embeo bwarabi omobaso
Bwaika korw' ebitunwa gochi' omweya,
Bwatoerer'ase rime n'embura.

Ntw'ab'eriroba ntor'abareu,
Twagosemeri'aye n'omobui;
'Maber'ao y'obworor'a botambe,
'Motongi, omoboria,
n'Omosani oito.

hymns.title: Tata Twagochera
hymns.refrain:
Tata twagocheire, totoombia
'Gw'ogosaba gwaito ntw'abareu,

hymns.title: Nyasae 'Motoria Oito
verses:
Nyasae 'Motoria oito, Korw'emiaka yonsi;
Ekiriri'as'emechando, Enka ya botambe.

Inse y'ekiriri kiao, natomenye buya;
'Koboko kwao ngoisaine gotorenda twensi.

Otaratonga ens'eye, Tikiarenge gento;
Nyasae kwareo nay' orab'emiaka yonsi.

'Biare elfu 's'ore bing'e mogorob'eyemo;
'Bieng'e bun'ensa ya mambia Ko bogokiamoka.

Nyasae 'Motoria oito, As'emiak'egocha;
Torae gatoremoyo, 'S'enka ya Igoro.

hymns.title: 'Gw'Ekerero Nyoroki' Amabera
verses:
'Gw' ekerero nyoroki'amabera Omotoria inchuo;
Moy'orosire nkogania oche Omotoria inchuo.

Tindi n'ase ndebise botuko Omotoria inchuo;
Nay'obogim'okong'omobaso Omotoria inchuo.

Inche bweka narosir'enchera, Omotoria inchuo;
Narora omosasoko as'ore, Omotoria inchuo.

Tori kwanga Omoyo bwerure, Omotoria inchuo;
'Gwa'gosaba n'okorera kwane, Omotoria inchuo.
hymns.refrain:
Natarire ense eye embe,
Natarir'are korwa nka,
Nyoyi'ong'iranie ase obweri,
Omotoria inchuo.

hymns.title: Omotongi One
verses:
Egetongwa kiao, Ing'a obogima,
Nyasae one ngotogie omoy'ogotogie,
Nyasae one ngotogie omoy'ogotogie.

Ninki ndakoe ko bionsi bir'ebiao,
Nkeri keegwa keraisan'obwanchani bwao,
Nkeri keegwa keraisan'obwanchani bwao.

'Buya bwao bombeke,
'nguru chia_ igoro,
Kera ring'ana n'okogania bib'ebiao pi,
Kera ring'ana n'okogania bib'ebiao pi

hymns.title: Nchw' Ensoko
verses:
Nchw' Ensoko ya Ker'egesio, Ninter'obuya bwao,
Maber'amang'ataere, Agere tokobake;
Nyegerie kogosasima, Nyorok'obuya bwao,
'Gosemeria Kw'Obonene, Nkor'eichorw'obwanchani.

Nateneniri 'Ebenesa*, kwandendire goik'aa,
Nasemeirie as'obuya bwao, ning'ike inka
Yes'akandigi'omosiru, Konareng'are nere,
Gonkonya korw'emechando, Gaiter'amanying'aye.

Botambe nd'omonyasira, 's'obuya bwa Nyasae,
'Buya buna chingatare, bombwaterani' as'ore;
Mbetereirie ntayaye, ntige Nyasae nyanchete,
Ir'enkoro yane tata, yegach'agwo igoro.

hymns.title: Yes 'Omonyaira
verses:
Yes' omonyaira, nonya nabake
Bachire gosaba, nobe aroro;
Twanchire ring'ana togosasime,
Yeso tosesenie, natokorore.

Nkwabete na intwe korw'agwo kare,
Ko ntokoganetie goika oche;
Inchuo Omoboria, toe obuya,
Toigwe otwanche, otosesenie.

Yeso otokonye, natogotogie,
Totere as'ore, igw' ogosaba;
Buna togosaba, erio twegene,
Erio tosemerie, twanche kobua.
hymns.refrain:
Yeso tosesenie, nao toraa;
Inchuo tosesenie, mono botambe.

hymns.title: 'Mariogi Onsi Tig 'Atere
verses:
Mariogi onsi tigatere, 'Rieta riaYeso rigiya;
'Kobakwa kwa Nyasae oito, 'Rieta ria Yeso rigiya.

Nigo rikorusi 'obwoba, 'Rieta riaYeso rigiya;
'Monyene ebib' amwanche, 'Rieta ria Yeso rigiya.

Riasaria nguru chi'ebibe, 'Rieta ria Yeso rigiya;
Amanyinga yogosibia, 'Rieta ria Yeso rigiya.
hymns.refrain:
Rieta rigiya, 'Rieta nigiya,
Rieta ria Yeso rigiya;
Rieta rigiya, 'Rieta rigiya,
Rieta riaYeso rigiya.

hymns.title: Baka Tat' Ogosesenia
verses:
Baka Nyasae 'Mosesenia,
Bitongwa bi'ense mobake,
Mogand'O Igoro mobake,
Tata, Omwana n'Omoika.
Amen.

hymns.title: Nyasae Nintare N'Aye
Kwana N'enkoro Yane
verses:
Kwana nenkoro yane,
Ontebi' amangana Nyiwe enkoro ime,
"Tori aye bweka"; Igor' enkoro yane,
Nyigwe riogi riao; Erio ngotogie aye, Nchenge ime yao.

hymns.title: Ninkoganeti' Omonene!
verses:
Ninkoganeti' Omonene! Igo inde n'ebibe;
Mbwate okoboko ndae, Erio nyare korora.

Mbekere oboitongo, Ebibe biambuire;
Nyoroki' oboreu bwane, Ing'a chinguru chiao.

Tinkoiroka as'ore, A ye nondae buya;
Tara na inch' Omotoria, Nay' obogima bwane.

Kende gionsi nagechicha, 'Mogoko n'obororo;
Omoyo nobe as'ore, Naye orantimokie.
hymns.refrain:
Botambe, botambe,
Ninkoganeti' Omonene!
Botambe, botambe,
Omotoria ondende.

hymns.title: N'Yeso Tai Nche
verses:
N'Yeso, tai nche, Kristo, Anchwe naend' asikwe;
N'Yeso, tai nche, 'Manywe, aigweke,
N'Yeso, tai nche, As' ebikorwa bionsi
N'Yeso, tai nche, 's'ebirengererio.

N'Yeso, tai nche, Aremi' as'obororo;
N'Yeso, tai nche, Atinyi'amariga,
N'Yeso, tai nche, Aimokie egurube,
N'Yeso, tai nche, Aserie obwoba.

N'Kristo, bweka, Tinkwana ayar'amabe;
N'Kristo, bweka, Tintera amabe
N'Kristo, bweka, Tinyeimokia igoro,
N'Kristo, bweka, Tinyetang'ania inche.

N'Kristo, bweka, Ner'okong'isanekia,
N'Kristo, bweka, Obogima bwane,
N'Kristo, bweka, Mobere nomoy'one,
N'Kristo, bweka, 'Ns'eye na Igoro.

hymns.title: Omotoria Torae Ntwe
verses:
Omotoria torae ntwe, otorende kegima;
Toe 'ndagera engiya, Tobe riicho riao.
hymns.refrain:
Yes' omuya, Yes' omuya, Aye gwatogorire;
Yes' omuya, Yes' omuya, Aye gwatogorire.

hymns.title: Mosalab' Omotori' Agakwa
verses:
'Mosalab' Omotori' agakwa,
'Gwo nkarera nsibigw'ebibe,
'Manying'ay' agansibi 'enkoro,
'moe 'bonene.

Nchera y'ogokumi' antoririe,
Yes'omenyete ime yane,
Agw'omosalab'ombogorie
'moe 'bonene.

Ensok'engiya y'ogotoria,
nagokire gosoa ime,
Yeso antoria na gonchena,
'moe 'bonene.

Nchwo 's'ensok'entenenk' engiya,
karu'enkoro ya' eyi'entaka
soa 'me rer'oikeranigwe 'moe 'bonene.
hymns.refrain:
Moe 'bonene, 'Moe 'bonene,
Manying'ay' agansibi'enkoro,
Moe 'bonene.

hymns.title: Nyasae Oito Negetare
verses:
Nyasae oito negetare. 'Botamero  emechando,
'Gokonyeka kore ang'e, Emechando ende yonsi.

Botuko, mobaso nere, Botamero emechando.
Igo titokoiroka, Ekiagera are naintwe.

'Mechand' ende netonyora, 'Botamero emechando,
Twamanyire nomorendi, Oyore ang'e botambe.

Nyasae negekengano, 'Botamero emechando,
Amatuk' onsi norwaki, Oyore ang'e botambe.
hymns.refrain:
'Getare gototimokia,
'Kiriri gokenderera,
'Morai as'orogendo
'Botamero emechando.

hymns.title: Ngwekane Buna Yeso
verses:
Ngwekane buna Yeso; Amenye ime yane,
Ng'ichorie obwanchani, Nindabe omwororo,
 Ngwekane buna Yeso, kangotara as'ense,
Mbe n'omoika oye, 'Monene nchwo ase nde.

Gakoigwa chinyoni, Nagochirenda buya,
Nanyigwe ekerero, n'ogochandeka kwane;
Nanyorokie boronge, Anyabere 'komocha,
Nchenek' enkoro yane 'Monene nchwo ase nde.

Ngwekane buna Yeso; Amatuko onsi pi,
Nintimoke as'are, Ninyw' amache amaya;
Nimbe n'obuya bwaye, Nyor' obwanchani bwaye,
Ninyegene kegima 'Monene nchwo ase nde.

hymns.title: Tong'etani' Omotori' One
verses:
Tong'etani' Omotori' one,
'Gwa kangosaba;
Gokorangeria abande,
Takong'etania.

'ekerogo ki'amabera,
Ntimokereo;
Ntung'ame as' oboitongo,
Nkonye nyegene.

Naye ore omoremia,
Kobua bionsi;
Kaiar'oyomoreng'aine,
Nse nonyaigoro.

hymns.title: Ngwanchete
verses:
Ngwanchete, Ngwanchete, Ngwanchet'omonda
Ngwanchet' Omotoria, Ngwanchete Nyasae.
Ngwanchete, Ngwanchete, kwamanyir'Aye,
Bikorwa biorokie, buna'Ngwanchete.

Ngogete, Ngogete, Mono kobua,
Ntenen' egetunwa, ngoke botambe
Nyerore enibo, agwo ndamenye,
Yeso, malaika, n'abaya bonsi.

hymns.title: O Yes Omobori' One
verses:
O Yes' Omobori' one, 'Mogok' ogotera,
Motori' omosasoko, Kero nchandegete.

Nay'ore okoremia. As' emiaka yonsi,
Mosunte korantube, 'Marig' agotonya!

Ninkwegen' Omotoria, Mosani_Omorai,
Naki aye nomuya, Kobua bonsi pi.

Nintere nomogoko, Kond' ense y'ebibe,
Nintere n'omogoko, bisieri bia Igoro.
hymns.refrain:
O Yes' Omobori' one, Ninkobake aye,
Mosani onde tari, Bw' amatuko onsi.

hymns.title: Naye Obogima Bwane
verses:
Naye obogima bwane, bobuet' obwenseye,
Orogendo rwane nseye, 'Motoria ntare naye.

Tari mogoko ngosaba, tindigeti_obonene,
'Meremo as'emechando, bwanche intare naye.
Mbe naye, mbe naye, mbe naye, mbe naye
Meremo as'emechando, bwanche intare naye.

Ntang'ane_ime yomosunte, 'Nyimokie erio
mbue, Omonene nsoe naye 'bogima botaere.
Mbe naye, mbe naye, mbe naye mbe naye,
Omonene nsoe naye 'bogima botaere.
hymns.refrain:
Mbe naye, mbe naye, mbe naye, mbe naye
Orogendo rwan' enseye, 'Motoria ntare naye.

hymns.title: Chimeme Chionsi Chitere
verses:
Chimeme chionsi chitere; Kobak'Omoboria! Kobak'Omoboria!
'Buya bwa Nyasa'Erwoti;
(Bobui bw'obuya) Bobui bw'obuya
Bobui bw'obuya, Bobui bw'obuya.

Omonene Nyasa'one; Onkony'erio ndarie! Onkony'erio ndarie!
Ndari'Erieta riao ense;
('Bonene bw'erieta,) bonene bw'Erieta
Bonene bw'Erieta, Bonene bw'Erieta.

Yeso n'Erieta ri'obobui; Riseria obwoba Riseri'Omoichano!
Goter' as'Omonyabibe;
('Bogim'omorembe) 'Bogim'omorembe
'Bogim'Omorembe 'Bogim'omorembe.

Abuna 'nguru chi'ebibe; 'Sibor'omosibwa! Sibor'omosibwa
Manying' ay'asibi' ababe;
(Nainche nansibie bo) Nainche nansibie bo,
Na nche nansibie bo, Nainche nansibie bo.

hymns.title: Ning'ore?
verses:
Ning'ore ng'umbu bweri
Barisia basasima?

Ning'or' emechand' ime
Kweng'ata as'eroro?

Ning'o gosesenigwa
'Samang' an' obwororo?

Ning'o bakoretera
'Barwaire nebirema?

Ng'o 'teneine korera
'S' embera ya Lazaro?

Ning' oyio emeganda
'Gokwania nobobui?

Ning'o botuko gati
Gosaba Gethsemane?

Ng'O ng'umb' omote goro
'Gokwa as'obororo?

Ning'O 'zyio korw' embera
Gocha gotori' abanto?

Ng'O korw' as'ekerogo
'Kogamba chinse chionsi?
hymns.refrain:
N'Omotoria bw'ogokumia,
N'Omogambi bw'obonene
Togw' as'amagor' aye
Kae Yes' obogambi.

hymns.title: 'Rieta Ria Yeso Rigiya
verses:
Rieta 'giya 'goro n'ense nkoro yan'emanyete,
Nyasae Tata aruete, As'Omwana Omwanchwa.

Risesenia im' enkoro, Ninditogie kobua,
Nindiatore as'abanto, Mbwatore buya bwaye.

Nintere botogi'obwanchani, Bwaye bw'ogotoria,
Ntogi' Eriet'erio botambe, Riyabuete onsi.

hymns.title: Yes'Omwanchi Omorisia one
verses:
Yes' omwanchi omorisi' one'
Obuya botareme
Tinkonyara koremerwa
Nare nainche botambe.

Ngatig'enchera ngasira
'Kandigia nobwanchani
Kanyimoki' as'egekuba
Kang'ira nka ngogete.

As'amache y'obogima
Ondendire botambe
Ondisirie Ondendire
Yes' Omorisi' Omuya.

Amakweri tinkwoboa
'Kero Yes'are nainche
Onkiriri' ontenenirie
Nere ogontang'ana.

Ong'ariganeiri' emesa
Onkoreir'ekeng'wanso
Ongokiri' as'endagera
'Manying'ay' ansibirie.

'Samatuko y'obogima
Gonsesenia botambe
Omorisia ninkobake
Nyomba mwao botambe.

hymns.title: Nter' Obwanchani Bwa Nyasae
verses:
Nter' obwanchani bwa Nyasae,
'Moik' oy' omeny' ase nde Goichan' ogokor'omogoko,
Nyaber' ebibe biane. 'Mosunte noba omonene, otebire nabe nainche
'Ng' oborabu 's'ekiriri, 'Kieni ribaga rie ribu.

Nter' obwanchani bw'Omotoria, 'chandeget' as' omote
'Bobisi bw'okoba kwaye oo, Nche mbe omosibore
'Gacha gotori' abanyaibibe, Chinkoro echi chiarosire
'Ng'a 'mogoko 'okweumia, Kieni ribaga rie ribu.

Nintere obuya w'enchili, Ekoreta obuya 'Kong'a mogoko n'oborabu,
And' onsi ase ndabe 'Mboyi' eyanga y'omogok' oye,
Kero nde nobwob' obonge
Bong'a borabu, kiriri, Kieni ribaga rie ribu.
hymns.refrain:
Ongokirie (ongokirie) as' obororo ('s'obororo)
'Ng' obwanchani ('ng'obwanchani) nseri'obwoba (nseri' obwoba)
'Ng'a Borabu's' ekiriri, Kieni ribaga rie ribu.

hymns.title: 'Binto Biakobak' Aye
verses:
'Binto biakobak' Aye; Goro, n'ense, n'enyancha
Bionsi kwabitongete, Bikorari' Omonene
Bionsi bigosasime; 'Monene tokobake

Bikobaka bionsi pi Mbura, mokobinyongo
'Mogoroba, amare Chindoche, n'emerindo
'Nsakia Bokendu; bionsi 'Monene togotogie

Bionsi bikobak' Aye Omotongi,
Ring'ana Omoik'oyoreo Twatung'amir' as'ore
Tokoe nkoro chiaito 'Monene; tokobake.

hymns.title: Mbe N'Obosera Bwa Yeso
verses:
Mbe n'obosera bwa Yeso ime yane,
'Mabera n'obochenu bwaye bwonsi;
Omoik' Omochenu Anchene kegima,
Goika Yes'arorekane ime yane.

Mbe nobosera bwa Yeso ime yane,
'Buya bwaye bororekan' asende;
Tig'amang'an' ane Nebikorwa biane,
Bioroki' obosera bwaye Yeso.

'Ker'orogendo rwane rwaerire,
Ntare na Yeso botamb' as'obuya;
Nkoimokigwa igoro 'S'enka y'omorembe,
Neb' omogok'one komenya Nere.

hymns.title: Tata Tosibore Bono
verses:
Tata tosibore bono, N'ogwancherab okuya
Toe omogoko oo, Torusie ebibe pi
Toe gwancha, Toe gwancha
Gatokogend' ens' eye.

Gatokogenda ens'eye, mbuya togokorere
Gatogotunya enchera, Totokona tatiga,
Obe ang'e, obe ang'e Goika Oirane.

hymns.title: Motoria Twabak'Erieta Riao
verses:
Motoria twabak'erieta riao,
As'ogotera kw'ogotigana;
Gatwakorire ogosasima,
Twatung'ama kogany'omorembe.

Toe 'morembe gatokogenda,
Twachaka twakora ituko naye;
Rend'emenwa n'enchinkoro chiaito,
Abwo bagwatoir'as'enyomb'eye

Toe' morembe gator'ens' eye,
Riog' as 'obororo n'amatemwa;
Ker'orachik'esegi eere,
Toe 'moremb' okare na kare.

hymns.title: Ira Erieta Ria Yeso
verses:
Ira erieta ria Yeso, Oyore n'obororo;
Rikoreter' omogoko, Rirarie ande onsi.

Ira erieta ria Yeso, Ribe buna enguba;
Goetanan' amatemwa, sab' Erieta richenu.

'Rieta rigiya ria Yeso, Rikoremia
chinkoro; Atoimokie n'amaboko, N'amatera
motogie.

Orogendo rokoera, Twekanye gosasima;
Tomobekere egutwa, Mogambi bwa'bagambi.
hymns.refrain:
Erieta......Rigiya.... Mogok'ense na'goro,
(Erieta) (Rigiya) Erieta....
Rigiya... Mogok'ense na'goro.(Erieta) (Rigiya)

hymns.title: Yeso Nagwanchire Aye Noyone
Yes' Omwanchio moy'one
verses:
Yes' omwanchi omoy'one, Ancha menye as'ore,
Merindo nemenene, nomwaga nomotindi.
Nyebise Omotoria, Goik' emechando eere,
Rokoer' orogendo As'aya Kristo ng'ira.

Tindi n'ogokonyeka, Tig' aye Omonene;
Tontiga inche bweka, obe ang'e botambe,
Negenire as'ore, Nyor'ogokony' as'ore
Otube omotw'one, Na orobaba rwao.

Kwang'isanire aye, Nas'ore bire bionsi
Abororo n'ababe, Nkobakony' ore bonsi
Omuy' ore Nyasae. Inche tindi n'obuya
Oyore n'obochenu, Nabwatirwe n'obobe.

'Buy'obonge nas'ore, korusi' ebibe bionsi
As'ainache amaya, Norigetie onsibie
Kwabeire ase tore, Ensoko y'obogima
Obe nue asende, Emiaka na emiaka.

hymns.title: Nintere Obwanchani
verses:
Nintere obwanchani, Motoria, Onyanchete,
Agacha, gokwer'ense, S'omot' o Kalwari.

'Mariga 'Omonene 'gaiteka'ngencho yane;
Ng'inyore Ogosaba, Ere nanyanchete.

Bwanchani bwaye 'bonge Ense tekoboemanya;
Ebibe bun' ebiane, Mbirabe kegima.

Tindarua kend' ekiya, Okang'a bwanchani;
'Moy'one ob'as'ore,  Ng'orokie obwanchani.
hymns.refrain:
Nintere (Nintere) obwanchani
Mogoko (Mogoko), as' omoyo
Agakwa (agakwa) imbe moyo,
Nter' obwanchani bwaye.

hymns.title: Ninde N'ogoter' Okuya
verses:
Ninde n'ogoter'okuya, Naki naborigwe;
N'Omotoria one Yeso.Naki naborigwe.

Kristo ner' ong'isanire, Naki naborigwe;
Nkore buna arigetie, Naki naborigwe.

Ninde na kirori omuya, Naki naborigwe;
Oyogoseria obwoba, Naki naborigwe.

Naroserigwe omochie, Naki naborigwe;
Ase ndamenye botambe, Naki naborigwe.

hymns.title: 'Karar' As'Embera
verses:
'Karar' as' embera, Yes' Omotoria;
Kaganya Koboka, Monen' one.

Bakarend' embera, Yes' Omotoria;
Bakarenda bosa, Monen' one.

Tabuetwe nogokwa, Yes' Omotoria;
Kabu' ebisibo, Monen' one.
hymns.refrain:
Kaboka. korw' embera,
Nobobui as' omobisa
Akabok' akabua omosunte
Amenyete n'abachenu kogamba
Kaboka, kaboka, Alleluy' akaboka.

hymns.title: 'Se Kalwari
verses:
'Se Kalwari yes'agakwa, 'Monen'one akabambwa;
'S'amanying'ay' akangora, Erio nyore amabera.

'Bitare bigatandoka, 'Rioba rikab'omosunte;
'Getambaa gotandoka bikarag'ogotoreka.

'Monen'one naki yare, Ay'okang'a obogima;
'Kabogori' omosalaba, N'oboror'aria Kalwari.
hymns.refrain:
O Kalwari y'omosunte,
Ase Yeso ankwerete; (inche)
O Kalwari 'sesenirie!
Nao 'Motori'ankwerete.

hymns.title: 'Gwancha Tikogokwaneka
verses:
Bwanchani Yes'anyanchete, Agankwer'omosalaba;
Erio nyaberwe ebibe, Tibogokwaneka.

Boror' obong'anyorete, Gatwekw'engata y'amagwa;
Erio mbe moyo botambe, Tibogokwaneka.

Morembe mbwate as'Are, Ansororera Nyasae;
Bobui as'amanying'aye, Tibogokwaneka.

Mogoko mbwate Kar'ang'e, Ko ndaire tindi kwoboa;
Gosemeria mbwate as'are, Tikogokwaneka.

hymns.title: Ntebi' Amang'ana A Yeso
verses:
Ntebi' amangana a Yeso, Mbeke onsi omoyo
 Nyorokereria boronge, Maya abuete onsi
Ntebie bun' Amalaika, Baterete kaiborwa.
"Obonen' ase Nyasae,'Moremb' obuy'as'ense."

'Keng'ata bweka eroro, Ntebi'engak' akorete
 'S'ebibe biait' agatemwa, Omoeri'akabua
Ntebi' engaki y'emeremo, N'oboror'anyorete
Achayetwe nagochandwa, Motak' otari n'enka.

Ntebie ase abambetwe, Akaba n'obororo
Ntebi' ember' atindegetwe, Ntebie un'are moyo
'Bwanchani 'S'mang'an' ayio, Bore maiso marore
 Karakira ndararera, 'Bwanchani bwamboririe.
hymns.refrain:
Ntebi' emeremo ya Yeso,
Mbeke onsi enkoro
 Nyorokereria boronge,
Maya abuete onsi.

hymns.title: Naborigwe Naki Ndararie
verses:
Naborigwe naki ndararie! As' amanyinga y' engondi,
Koborigw' as' amaber' aye, Nabeir' omwan' oye bori.

Koborigwa ngok' ase Yeso, Kobua buna ndakwane;
Oborabe bw' okoba kwaye, Nabomenye nainche bori.

Ndengereri' Omoboria one, Morengererie botambe;
Nter' ekiagera tingokira, Eganga neb' obwanchani.

Nindore as' obuya bwaye, 'Ngokiri' as' amachik' aye;
'Yokondenda ker' ase ndabe, Kong' amatera botuko.

Inche nagacheirwe egutwa, Yabekirwe ang'e igoro;
'Kero toraikeranigwe, Erio as' are nimbeo.
hymns.refrain:
Koborigwa! As' amanyinga y' eng'ondi
Koborigwa! Nabeir' omwan' oye bori.

hymns.title: E Rituko Riomogoko
verses:
E Rituko ri'omogoko, Nachoret' Omotori' one
Tig'enkoro yan'echenge, Nakorari' obuya'onsi.

Okobwatana kwabeire, Nche n'oyoye, ner'oyone
Akang'usa nkamotunya, Nagokigwe komwatora.

Enkoro yane timoka, Ase obotoereru
Gose torw' as' Omonene, Ere oyore 'obuya.

'Gor'ekaigw' okobwatana, Okoyia kera rituko
Goik' omoerio nyekanye, Goseseni'okobwatana.

'Ker'omoganda oIgoro, Gotirimboka goch'ense
Eri' Omonen'atenene, 'Gambe nk'engiya botambe.
hymns.refrain:
Rituko! mogoko! Kero Yeso ansibetie
'Kanyegeria ogosaba, 'Menye nomochengo
riokaRituko'mogoko! Kero Yeso ansibetie.

hymns.title: Erituko Erinene
verses:
E rituko, erinene. Ri'ogotogia Omotoria!
Omoy'one noichorete, Koba buna omwan'oye.

Amang'an'aya namaya, Nind'oyoye,
ner'oyone; Akang'usa komotunya.
Namwanchire n'omoy'one.

Eira yane ya kare, Ninyegache 'miaka,
yonsi; Goik'achich' Omonene,
Natobe n'obuya bwonsi.
hymns.refrain:
Rituko, rituko, Ri'ogosibia 'bibe biane!
Okorenda n'ogosaba, Ogotunya,
bun'omwana, Rituko, rituko, Ri'ogosibia,
'bibe biane.

hymns.title: Nkoro Nere N'Omogoko.
hymns.refrain:
Obwanchani bw'ogokumia
Bw'ogokumia bwa Yeso
Obwanchani, bw'ogokumia
Bw'ogokumia bwa Yeso.

hymns.title: Yeso Omotoria Bethlehemu
verses:
Yes' Omotoria Bethlehemu, 'S'obweri bw'ororo n'obosoku;
Nakumirie buna antoririe, Agacha kondigia.
Agacha kondigia, Agacha kondigia
Nakumirie buna antoririe, Agacha kondigia.

Yes' Omotoria ase Kalwari, Agaakan' esir' akamboria;
Naichanire ng'aki yabete bo, Ere agankwera
Ere agankwera, Ere agankwera
Naichanire ng'aki yabete bo, Ere akandigia.

Yes' Omotori' one korwa kare, 'Kandigia konare gotayaya
As' obwororo agansorora, Er' akandangeria
Er' akandangeria, Er' akandangeria
As' obwororo agansorora, Er' akandangeria.

'Motori'one nache korw' Igoro, Bun'eira yaye egoteba
o nimorore ere kagocha, Gochicha konyoyia
Gochicha konyoyia,  Gochicha konyoyia
o nimorore ere kagocha, Gochicha konyoyia.

hymns.title: Yeso Obeire Omosani
verses:
Yes' obeire omosani, Obogima bwonsi;
Ombekire omokia pi, Nere onkonyire.
Kondemeire arangokie, Onde tariomobuete
Chinsa chionsi arangokie, 'Mosani.

Yes' obeire Omosani, Ase emechando:
Ning'end' as'are botambe, Korigia ebisio.
'Mobaso bwonsi n'embura, Bikorabia endagera:
'Mobas' oye, otomire, 'Mosani.

hymns.title: Ng'usa Ang'e N'enkoro Yao
'Motoria Bw' Ogokumia
verses:
Kristo bwerur' ekeng'wanso, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!
Twaborigw' orur' esira, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!

Nimobak' as' amanyinga, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!
Ang'anchanetie na Nyasae. 'Motoria bw'ogokumia

Agansibi' enkoro yane, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!
Ner'okogamba korwa ime, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!

Atara nainche botambe, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!
Na gonkora omwegeni, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!

Ang'a nguru chi'obobui, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!
Erio nabua ker'ensa, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!

Namoeir' enkoro yane, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!
'Nse tekonyora getari, 'Motoria bw'ogokumia!
hymns.refrain:
'Motoria bw'ogokumia nere Yeso one'
'Motoria bw'ogokumia nere Yes' one!

hymns.title: Nchiare Emerongo Kianda Na Kianda
verses:
Nchiare emerongo, kianda na kianda Chiaraire egora ime,
Eyemo egasirer' ebitunwa Are are n'egeita gi'enka
Are ase ebitunwa ebibe Teri ase omorisia omuya
Teriase Omorisia omuya.

"Monen' emerongo kianda na kianda Echio tichigoisaini?"
'Morisi' akairania: Eyemo yane Yasirire korwa ase nde-
Nonya enchera erembe mono Ning'ende as'eroro koyerigia
Ning'ende as'eroro koyerigia.

'S' ababorigwa onde tamanyete Chindiba echi ambogete
Gos' omosunte Yeso aetete Ataranyor' engondi yaye
Ar' as' eroro akaigwa ekwana 'Ndwair'etari kwenyar'er'ang'e gokwa
'Ndwair'etari kwenyar'er'ange gokwa.

"Monene ng'ai amanying'aya arwa, 'Nyororoget' egetunwa?"
'Nigo aitekeret' omosiru, 'Morisi' ataramoirania'
Ninki giasionoir' amabok'ao" Nigo asionorwa n'amagw' amange
Nigo asionorwa n'amagw' amange'.

As 'ebitunwa chinkoba chigoaka, Korwa egetare 'goro
'Riogi rikaigweka gochia igoro, 'Goka nanyorire eng'ondi!
Malaik' agater' as' ekerogo, "Monen' oiranirie egiasirete
Monen' oiranirie egiasierete.

hymns.title: Ar' As' Egetunwa
verses:
Ar' as'egetunwa nor' omosalaba,
Bw' emechando n'obosoku;
Naywanchir' Omote, S 'omuy' Omosera,
Gatokwer' abanyabibe.

Omosalab' oria, ochayire n'ense,
Nore nomong'us' ase nde;
Ng'ondi ya Nyasae. Gatig'obonene,
Koyoira aria kalwari.

'S' Omosalab' oria, Nimbe Omwegenwa,
Nyimoki' obosoku bwaye,
Erio nandangerie, gochia nka igoro,
'Nsange obonene bwaye.
hymns.refrain:
Ngoker' omosalaba oria,
bobui bwane mbeke inse
Nintarer' omosalab' oria,
Kaa nyoonchoreri' egutwa.

hymns.title: Togi' Omonen' Omotoria
verses:
Togi 'Omonen' Omotoria, 'Moik' atobwatanie,
Gatobwatanirie 'go, Tobe n'omoy'oyomo.

'Tochikire tober'aa, Tob'abam' as'are,
Erio totere gator'amo, Gochi' enchera 'goro.

Abanchet'erieta riay' Obaeir 'ebiegwa;
Natworoki 'obuy'obonge, Gatwanchaine buya.

Toigwanaine buy'as'ense, Togok'ase Yeso;
Mogoko ki oyi'orabe, Gatwaikireigoro.

hymns.title: 'Bw'emechando'
verses:
''Bw'emechando! 'Ndieta ki as'Omwana o Nyasae
'Chete kobori' ababe Haleluya' n'Omotoria!

'Kabogori' obosoku, 'Gaitwa ribaga riane 'Kangora
'S' amanyinga. Haleluya n'Omotoria!

'Bamochi_ababe tware, 'Re tare nakemoa
Ekeng'wanso ekiya, Haleluya n'Omotoria!

'Kaimokigwa agakwa, Karera "Yaerire!"
Bono Igoro are, Haleluya n'Omotoria!

'Ker 'arach' Omogambi, Kwoyia ababorigwe
 Ntotere ogotera, Haleluya n'Omotoria!

hymns.title: Nter' Okobua Kwa Nyasae
verses:
Nter' obuya bw'Omonene, Bwaret' endagera;
'Kabitonga nering'ana, kabikor' ebiya,
'Monen' a'makumia ao, Aichir' ense yonsi!
Nonya nas'ense ngotacha, N'erioba igoro!

hymns.title: Nere Embura Engiya
verses:
Nere embura engiya 'Gotwa koret' ebisio;
Goisanekia ab'erang'o 'Monene nainche ntwerie

Tong'etania Tat'omuya; Nimba omonyabibe
 Amaber' ao botambe 'monene Onyorokie.

'Natebanir'as'ebibe nkogechia na gokwanga,
Ense nigo ensibete. Nyaber' erind 'onkonye!

Tong'etani' Omoik' omuya, 'Nkoru'ore okorora,
Ooroki' Obuya bwa Yeso. Itebie ay'Omorembe.
hymns.refrain:
Nonya nche Nonya nche,
Tig'amatoim' angwere.

hymns.title: Inchw' Omoik' Omochenu
verses:
Inchw' Omoik' Omochenu
Onsibi' omoyo one, Onsibie enkoro yane,
Inchuo ng'ichorie bono.

Nong'ichori' Omoik' omuya
Nonya tinkogotebia ko ninkoganetie mono
Inchuo ng'ichorie bono.

Naichoirwe n'oboreu
Nekanyire as'ore Omoika
Omochenu Ombekere chinguru.

Nchene, ndemie, nsesenie nkony' sibie
'nkoro yane N'ay' okoremia,
gotoria Bono nkong'ichori' ore.
hymns.refrain:
Ng'ichorie, Ng'ichorie, Yeso nchwo ong'ichorie
N'okoboko kwao ogochenu, ng'ichorie bono.

hymns.title: Omoika Omochenu
'Moika Igw' Ogosaba
verses:
'Moika igw' ogosaba, Omeny' as'enkoro
Nechinguru ochich' aye, Omoika  inchuo.

Inchuo buna oborabu, 'Keene twagania
Tworoki' enchera endonge, Tokor' emeremo.

Inchuo buna omorero, Tosibie chinkoro
Tochirw' ekengwans' ekiya, Ase  obwanchani.

Bun' embura tosesenie, Kero 'ga twerure
Ker' enkoro yororobe, 'Se chinguru chiao.

Bun' omwaga 'Moika nchuo, Buna Pentekote
Otworoki' ogotoreka As' abanto bonsi.

hymns.title: Moik' Omochenu O Igoro
verses:
'Moik' Omochenu o igoro
Rab'as' enkoro yane
 Oserie Omosunte
Oyokor' Oborabu.

'Moika 'nguru chia _Igoro
Ochen' enkoro yane
Ebibe biangambeire
 As' engaki entambe.

'Moik' omogok' oigoro
Enkoro yane remia
Seri' emechand' emenge
Gwenia enkoro yane.

'Moika, bionsi bia_ igoro
Omenye omoy'one
Nsererie chisanamu
Ongamber' aye bweka.

hymns.title: Ngosanga Ki Mogok'o Igoro
verses:
Ngosanga ki,'mogoko Igoro, Nyeegek' ase Yeso bweka
Ngosesenigwa ki 'Moranbe ki, Nyeegek' ase Yeso bweka

Ninyenyar' enchera enyerere, Nyeegek' ase Yeso bweka
'Nchera nenyare koba enyango, Nyeegek' ase Yeso bweka.

Tikeri kende gekonyirokia, Nyeegek' ase Yeso bweka
Ninde morembe bw'Omonene , Nyeegek' ase Yeso bweka.
hymns.refrain:
'Moremb' otari n'obobe
Eegeke, Eegek' ase Yeso bweka.

hymns.title: Tari 'Mosani Obuete Yeso
verses:
Tari omosani obuete Yeso, Tario kegima;
Tari' oratogwenie chinkoro, keen', ekeene.

Tari omosani 'mochenu o igoro, Tario kegima
Tari' omoitongo buna Yeso, Tario kegima.

Tikeri ker'atari'ang'e naintwe, Tikeri, kegima
Tibori botuk' atatoremie, Tibori kegima.

'Mochenu tari omotigire, Tario kegima
Mobe tari aranyare kwanga, Tario kegima.

Keegwa buna Yeso nkiaruetwe, Nkiareo kegima
Tagotwanga gotoira bwoye, Takwanga kegima.
hymns.refrain:
Omanyir' emechando yaito, Natorae goik' omoerio
Tariomosani obuete Yeso, Tario kegima.

hymns.title: 'Masase As' Egetunwa
verses:
Masase as' egetunwa, Masase ar' enyancha,
Akobara ebirubo, As' oborisi' obuya;
Korende mbor' oborabu, Bor' omoy' one ime,
Omoboria nao ore, Oborabu mboreo.
hymns.refrain:
Amasase amaya mono, Ayare omoy' one
Yeso kare amo nainche, Namasase enkoro.

hymns.title: Ko ndabe Amo Na Yeso
verses:
Ko ndabe amo na Yeso, Nyigw' Amang'amaya!
Aase agiya ndabe, Mbe aroro botambe!
Kondabe amo na Yeso, Ning'inyore botambe;
Bwanchani bwaye n'obuya, Bwankonyire kegima.

Kondabe amo na Yeso, Ase ndasesenigwe;
'Bibe biane motigere, Anyare gontimokia
 Kondabe amo na Yeso, Ninyare komosaba,
Ere nang' Obuya bwaye, Na kondemia botambe.

Onsesenie, Omotoria, Kondabe amo n'Aye
Nyoroki' obwanchani Bwao, Ndore obosio bwao
'Monene ngwekane Yeso, Omochenu bun' Ere
Kondabe amo na Yeso, Nere obuya bwane.

hymns.title: Omonene Ningwanchete
verses:
Omonene ningwanchete Kobua ebiense
Kwang'eire omoremb' oo Kende getasarie.

Namanyire nore ang'e Kobua abense
Aye n'omuya Kobua, Kobua bionsi pi.

Kwangokirie as'omoyo, Nsasoke Kobua
Ntware obwanchani bwao; Ting'ichana mono.

Omotori' omuya mono, Otar' amo nainche
Natonyore omogoko, Gatorakorore.
hymns.refrain:
Abange tibaramanya (bamanye)
'Bwanchani obuya;
Abange tibaramanya (bamanye)
'Manying' ansibirie (nsibirie)

hymns.title: Nanyorire Omosani
verses:
Nanyorire Omosani! 'Kanyancha ntaramanya;
 Akang'usa n'obwanchani, Nabo inche ndamwanche.
Ime as'enkoro yane, Ere ong'eir' obuya
Nind' oyoye ner'oyone, Igo kare na kare.

Nanyorire Omosani! Oeirwe okobua,
Kondaa gochia Igoro, Na kong'ikia aroro
Bonene bwarorekana, Mboinyore botambe
Bono nkore emeremo, Nintimoke botambe.

Nanyorire Omosani! 'Muya omoitongo
Agonsemia na kondaa, Oyokondwanerera
Ere akanyancha mono, Ninki kerandusie o?
Ogokwa tigokondusia, Noyoye nde botambe.

hymns.title: Nyasa' Abarende Botambe
verses:
Nyasa' abarende botambe; Abateneni' abarae
Buna abanchani baye; Nyasa' abarende botambe.

Nyasa' abarende botambe, Ababise n'echimbaba
Endagera ebaisane; Nyasa' abarende botambe.

Nyasa' abarende botambe, Ase emechando yonsi
Abaagate kegima, Nyasa' abarende botambe.

Nyasa' abarende botambe, Mobe 'obwanchani mwensi
'Siri' obwoba bw'amakweri, Nyasa' abarende botambe.
hymns.refrain:
Erio (erio) tororane, Tororan' omoerio (moerio)
Erio (erio) tororane, Nyasa' abarende botambe.

hymns.title: Amaene Yeso N'Oyone
verses:
Amaene Yeso n'oyone,
Bwansu bw'obonene obochenu
Omonyamwando ONyasae,
'Boirw' as' Omoika, n'amanyinga.

Koigwera n'omogok' omuya,
'Ndoto chingiya chianchichera,
'Malaika barwa igoro,
Baret' amaber' obwanchani.

Koigwera n'ogotimoka,
Ningoke ime y'Omotoria,
Ndende, nganye, ntengere 'goro,
Ng'ichorw' obuya n'obwanchani.
hymns.refrain:
'Mogano n'ogotera kwane,
Motogie 'Motoria botambe,
'Mogano n'ogotera kwane,
Motogie 'Motoria botambe.

hymns.title: Ntebi' Omogano OIgoro
hymns.refrain:
Ntebi' omogan' okare, Ntebie mogan' okare
Ntebi' amang'an'a Yeso, Nobwanchani bwaye.

hymns.title: Seseni' Obwanchani
verses:
Seseni'obwanchani
Bwe chinkoro chiato 'Bomo bwe
chinkoro chiato, Bonga bwa Igoro.

Obosio bwa Tata, Tosabe n'omoyo;
Ogosemeria kwegeria, Bib' omoy'oyomo.

Sanger' emechando, Noborito bwonsi;
Botambe tororerane, Amabera rioka.

Gatogotigana, Natwechande mono;
Korende ntobwatanigwe, Tokoumerana.

hymns.title: Nkor' Ogosemeria
verses:
Nkor' ogosemeria, 'kuya kw'eriogi,
Kobu' emegoko yonsi eyi' ense yanchete.

Ner'engenang'eni, Korabi' omosunte,
'Masaria aye arabe abu' amakweri.

Riogi riogotogia, Riaimokia enkoro,
'Seria tang'utang'u teba 'Nyasae bwanchani."

Riogi ria Kalwari, Riarari' okwaberwa,
Ng'enang'eni ner' ogosemeria kwa Igoro.

hymns.title: Ng'a Ay' Ebuku
verses:
Ng'a ay' Ebuku etaya engiya,
 Gokony'abanto bachandekire;
Kende Tikegotangaokwegena,
Buna Yes' achete gototoria.

Ng'a ay' Ebuku konde nogoichana,
Ker"omoyo oichoirwe n'ebibe;
Ng'a ring'ana riakwanetwe na Yeso,
Nyegene morore Yeso ang'e.

Ng'a ay' Ebuku inyare komanya,
Mechando yonsi ere ens'eye;
Amasas' aye aseri' omoichano,
Ayerabi' enchera y'omorembe.

Ng'a ay' Ebuku 'taya y'obogima,
Gokoiran' achiche komboria;
Onyorokie etaya ya Igoro,
Nindore obonene bwa Yeso.
hymns.refrain:
Ng'a ay' Ebuku amang'an' amaya,
Amasas' aye nanyare kondaa;
Gochika kwaye eir' obwanchani,
Goik' omoerio bigenderere.

hymns.title: Nanchir' Eng'ana Ya Nyasae
verses:
Nanchir' eng'an' ya Nyasae,
Kende tigekoribua
Rikonyoroki' obomenyo,
Rintebia ntame korw' abe.

'Mang'an' amay' anyorokia,
'Monene, one ntarochi
Korw' as'ore negeire,
'Mogok' okoretwa nere.

Nobe ribaga Riay' aa,
Ontebi' obwanchani Bwaye,
Ningosome n'okwegena,
Nsang' omogok' o Igoro.

'Me yao nao nkonyora,
'mwando bw'Omotongi one
'S' enibo y'obong'aini ere,
Goichori' ebirengererio.

Karu' amasase arabi' ense,
Andae im' omosunte
Morek' enkoro emwamu,
Tinsira korwa as'ore.

hymns.title: Nintebe Omogano
verses:
Nintebe omogano,Bw'ebinto bia Igoro,
o Yeso n'obonene, Nobwanchani bwaye,
Nintebe omogano. 'Kiagera namaene,
Nig'okong'isanekia, Kende getanyare.

Nintebe omogano, 'Yore bw'ogokumia,
Kobu'ebiens' ebiya, Nonya 'ndoto ngiya
Nintebe omogano, Onkonyire mono,
Nakio ekio kiagera, Nkogotebia bono.

Nintebe omogano, N'omuya koirorwa,
Ker' ekero ngoteba, 'Mwansu bw'ogokumia
Nintebe omogano, Bande mbarayoigwa,
'Ng'ana y'ogotoreka, Ring'ana na Nyasae.

Nintebe omogano, 'S'abayomanyete,
Bare nchara n'erang'o, Koigwa bun' abande
as' obonene ntere, Gotera okoyia,
Nob'omogan'o kare, oyio naganchire.
hymns.refrain:
Nintebe omogano, Nob'omogoko one
Nteb' omogan' o kare, N'obwanchani bwaye.

hymns.title: Inchwo Abegeni
verses:
Inchwo abegeni abamwabuire,
'Nchwo Bethelehemu 'nw'ababui,
Ror'Omogambi O'goro Oiboirwe.

Ter'amalaika, tera n'omogoko,
Ter'abanto bonsi bare igoro,
'Bonene bwonsi ase Nyasae igoro.

Togochengere kwaiboirw',
emambi'engiya, Yeso oegw' obonene,
bwonsi, 'Ng'ana ya Tat' oboirw' as' omobere.
hymns.refrain:
Inchwo tomosasime,
Inchwo tomosasime,
'Inchwo tomosasime Omonene.

hymns.title: Nindigetie Manye Yeso
verses:
Nindigetie manye Yeso,
'Buya bwaye mboorokie
Ndor' ogotoreka kwaye,
'Bwanchani bw'oy'onkwerete.

Ndigetie nyegere Yeso,
N'obochenu bwaye manye
'Moik' oye ab'omworokia,
Konyorok' onsi a Kristo.

Manye Yes' ase Ring'ana,
Nkwane n'Omonene one
Erio nyigw' eriogi riaye,
'Mang'an' aye ab' ayane.

'Manye Yes'as' obogambi,
'Bonda, 'Bonene nebiaye
Bonda bwaye bomenteke,
'Mogambi bw'omoremb' ache.
hymns.refrain:
Kobua, kobua, nimomanye Yeso
Ndor'ogotoreka kwaye, 'Bwanchani
bw'oy'onkwerete

hymns.title: Kobusura Mambia
verses:
Kobusura mambia, 'mbusuro chingiya,
Kobusura mobaso, mogoroba
Toganye rigesa n'ogosangereria,
Natochenge tokoreta rigesa.

Twabusur' ensakia nonya n'ekiriri,
Titobugwa n'obokendu n'omwaga
Mbwango eraere emeremo yonsi,
Natochenge tokoreta rigesa.

Busurera Yeso Ase amariga,
Nase emechando n'omoichano
Ero gekoera natoire bwoye,
Natochenge tokoreta rigesa.

hymns.title: Tori' Abagosira
verses:
Tori' abagosira, Gweni' abagokwa,
Taboria korw' embera y'ebibe
Rer 'abakomocha, 'Moki' abakogwa
Batebie Yeso ner'Omotoria.

Nonya bachayete, Nabaganyete,
'Ganyete oyom'ogoonchoka
Bakurere mono, Baebererie,
Nababere kabaramwegene.

Motemi'osaririe, chinkoro chiabo,
'Buya bokony', ebirengererio
'Bwanchani, Bwororo,
Bikun'enkoro, Nebe moyo ase Omonene.

Tori' abagosira, Nab'eganeirie,
'Monene ere nakoe chinguru
'S'oboremereria, obairanie,
Batebi' Omotori' obakwereire.
hymns.refrain:
Tori' abagosira, Gweni' abagokwa
Yes' omonyamaber' abatorie.

hymns.title: Korer'Omonen' Emerem'Emiya
verses:
Korer'Omonen' emerem'emiya n'ogwancha,
Kabe n'oboremu kora motari koiroka.

Nonya Saitani nabek'emeribo y'obobe,
Oy'otorangeirie n'omwegenwa natorende.

Eira yaye as'abasomba baye ner'eye
"Meremo yao as'Omonene teri bosa".

hymns.title: Totamera Kende
verses:
Totamera kende, 'Meremo nereo,
Kabe ang'ogende, Ase oratomwe
Okorangeirire, Botamb' as' obuya,
Tibwang' emeremo, 'Miya ya Igoro.

Totamera kende, 'Monen' orangeirie,
Kwangir' aye mono, igw' eriogi bwango
Rigesa riamire, 'Bagesi nabake,
Kabe n'omogoko, Korer' Omonene.

Totamera kende, Bono totebana,
Tomochaya Ere, Ande nagotige
Ribaga korire, Orore Igoro,
Ngosororwa ore Inchuo nabwaberwe.
hymns.refrain:
Aye nchwo (bono) Totamera kende,
Aye nchwo (bono) Kabe ang' ogende
Totamera kende, Ande notebigwe,
"Aye gwanchayete, Togochia Igoro".

hymns.title: Omonene Rigoro Nainyora
verses:
Monen'one 'S'ogokumia nkoinyora;
Bint'amabok'ao akorete,
Ndora ng'enang'eni nyigwa chinkoba:
Bioroki'ense okobua kwao.

hymns.title: Kor' Emeremo Mboire
verses:
Kor' emeremo mboire, oyekore mambia;
Kora korime rire, As' ebisicha
Yekore kobogokia, Risase korire
Kora bwango naboire, Ker' otakore.

Kor' emeremo mboire, Yekore mobaso
Kera ensa yekore, Bwang' otimoke
'Kero gi'ensakia nyora, Egent' okogacha
Kor' emeremo mboire, Ker' otakore.

Kor' emeremo mboire, kora kobokoira;
Kamasas' akomesa, 'Tuko riaeta
Masase akorima, Atabare rinde
Ker' omosunt' ogocha, Ker' otakore.

hymns.title: Tekob' Egetunwa Igoro
verses:
Tekob' egetunwa Igoro, Gose ng'umbu y'enyancha,
Gose tai oroari ime, Nyasa' Aranganerie;
Gakorangeria ng'or' obwororo, Nintamany' enchera,
Korambwat' okoboko ningende, As' origetie ngende.

Nare amang'ana obwanchani, Yes' arigetie ntebe,
Gose nab' omonto' 'as' ebibe, 'Yongwenerete ndigie;
'Motoria korab' Omorai one, 'Nchera neb' embe,
Ninkwan' amang'an' ao amaya, Bun' origetie nintebe.
3.
Ase nare ens'achayire, ko rigesa ndireo,
'Se ndakore emeremo ya Yeso obambetwe;
Kondegene as' oborai bwao, 'Manyete nonyanchete,
Ninkore obwanchani bwao obuya, Nimbe buna origetie.
hymns.refrain:
Ningende as' origetie ngende,
Bitunwa, 'birubo, 'nyancha;
Nintebe bun' aganetie ntebe,
Nimbe buna aganetie.

hymns.title: Nimbwate Omosani
verses:
Namanyet' okogania, Morete oyomo;
Onchikire ntebie
'bande, Ring'ana rigiya,
Ntebe obwanchani bwaye, 'Kiageret' agakwa.
Twakora emeremo, Ere nainche.

hymns.title: Kondaror' Omosalaba
verses:
Kondaror' Omosalaba,
Ase Kristo ankwerete
'Nibo yane yonsi mbosa
Ntig' oboenenu bwane.

Rora omobere oye
Obororo n'obwanchani
Biana koumerana rinde
Gos' amagwa kob' egutwa?

Nche omosiru nabeirwe
'S' erieta, Ring'ana riaye
Tinyetogeria gent' ense
Tatig' omosalaba' oo.

Nintwar' obotongi bw'ense
Tibogoisan' Esadaka
'S' Obwanchani bwogokumia
Bonganetie nche na bionsi.

hymns.title: Tokor' Emerem' Abasomba ba Yeso
verses:
Tokor' emerem' abasomba ba Yeso,
Tobwatie enchera yaye aetete
'S' ogosemia kwaye Tonyore chinguru,
Tokore eki'amabok' aito akonyara.

Tokore emeremo bonsi baigote,
Amache abare n'erang'o bayanywe
'Mosalab' ebendera yaito erabe,
Baranderie "ogotoreka kwa bosa."

Tokor' emererno amo toyekore,
Obogima bw'omosunte n'abosire
Rieta ria Yehova rimokigwe Igoro,
'S'Ogotera "Ogotoreka kwa bosa."

Tokore emeremo goik' omoerio,
Rigesa ndiike bagesi bachiche
Omochie bw'ababorigwe nobe seito,
Natotere "Ogotoreka kwa bosa"!
hymns.refrain:
Omokia, omokia, Omokia, omokia
Tosabe... (mono) Torende...(rioka)
Tokore ach' Omonene.

hymns.title: 'S'Omogoko Natomokorere
verses:
'S'omogoko natomokorere,
Omonen'emerem'emiya; Kende gionsi
bun'Er'arachike, S'okwegena natogekore.

'S'oboitongo tomotunye Yeso,
Totare chincher'atarete; Toirani'
abasiruas'Omotoria, Baror' Emanwa ya Nyasae.
hymns.refrain:
Korera (Korera) Yeso, As'omogoko (ee)
As'omogoko, Korera (Korera) Yeso,
'S'omogond'oy'as'ense.

hymns.title: Ebisio Amang'ana Y'enkoro
verses:
Ebisio amang'ana y'enkoro. Gosaba,
gosoma ring'ana; Igo nario tokorigia mono,
Ebigutu Kera Omwaka.

Esadaka nech'as'Omonene, Emeremo,
natoyekore: Toganyet'Omonen' airane.
Ase baria basemeretie.

Natoorokie ebibe biaito Tobe abarabu
twaberwe: Gatoregen'Omonene Yeso,
Tokonywe tonyore chinguru.

Nony'ekero Ki'embura y'etoigo,
Tosabe Nyasae ayerue, Embura
y'Omoik'Omochenu, Naki Omoerio ng'ang'ore.
hymns.refrain:
Aiga mbareo, ababwatete, ababwatete;
'Machiko Aye, n'okwegena kwa Yeso.

hymns.title: O Ng'ai Abagesi
verses:
Ng'ai abagesi bakogesa, Abant' abegeni
korwa ense? 'Merem' ekorek' as' ekeene,
Onde tatimoka goika eere.

Gend' as'ebinchera mobarigie, Babe
mbange k'abaya mbareo Barigie nchera
timotig'onde, Basangererie kogenda 'goro.

Rigesa riarabire And'onsi, 'Nse bono
neganyete rigesa Bagesi mbake,
merem'emenge, Abange mbasire rikonyorwa.

Bono nchwo n'emeyio mwanyabanto,
Mogese embusuro engiya Kor' omoki'
Omonene nachiche, Twegokie ner' as' enka yaye.
hymns.refrain:
Ng'ai bagesi bare bache, Basang' obonen'
enka y'erigesa 'Ng' oratokonye,
kobareta,Bant' abegeni korwa ense.

hymns.title: 'Ngegu Y'enyancha Ng'umbu
verses:
Ngegu y'enyancha ng'umbu,
'Kobara buya mono Riogi rikondangeria,
Ng'ayerere ng'ikeo.

'Monene otebire, 'Bagesi ayerera!'
Mogondo ng'ar' okare,
'Baminto tiga ng'ende.

Eng'umbu y' emerindo, 'Koboko,
nkoimokirie Ebisieri mbigoire,
'Basiru bandageirie.

Tata, Baba, n'abana, Mwensi tigara buya,
Aria ng'uimbu y'enyancha,
'Meremo nenganyete.
hymns.refrain:
Ning'ende tintebana, Monene ondangeirie,
Ningende inyigwere, Minto tigara buya.

hymns.title: Gosimeker' Amariga
verses:
Gosimeker' amariga,
'Mbusur'as'obwanchani; Takorosa na
korara, Nonyor' obuya bwaye.

Ngotw' ere korwa Igoro, 'Borabu
bw'omobaso; Emete yonsi nayame,
Ne chinguru chia Nyasae.
hymns.refrain:
Rigereria ense yonsi,
Rigesa ndire ang'e;
Ror' endagera yamire,
Rigesa ng'ang'e rire.

hymns.title: Igw' Omogano Bw'ogokumia
verses:
Igw' omogano bw' ogokumia,
Twamenyet' abasiru
Yes' agaika n'obonene,
Gatorusi' egesibo.

Taiyo orenge gototoria,
Nonya namalaika
'Kabambwa agachayw' akangwa,
'Yomo ase Nyasae.

Mbwerue ase Omotori'oyo?
Mbwanche bwekany 'as'are?
Naye noror' obuya bwaye,
Nagotori' ere bono.
hymns.refrain:
Ng' otorusiri' omosunte? (Nere Yeso
obambetwe)'Nki akorete?
(Agankwera) Ng'ai akare? 'goro gotosabera
(Egene Igoro gotosabera.)

hymns.title: Korangerigwa Nkore Korwa Ng'umbu
verses:
'Korangerigwa nkore korwa ng'umbu, Toma oborabu
Chinkoro chiganetie, ogokonywa, Toma oborabu.

Korangerigwa korwa Makedonia, Toma oborabu
Twerue intwe as' omot'abambetwe, Toma oborabu.

Tosabe buya boche ense yonsi, Toma, oborabu
'Koba buna Kristo kobe and' onsi, Toma oborabu.

Titorosa gokora obwanchani, Toma oborabu,
Tosangererie baye as' egutwa, Toma oborabu.
hymns.refrain:
Borabu 'nchili 'sesenirie, Borabe goik',engegu
Botambe masari' ayerabie, Ense yonsi botambe.

hymns.title: Nkorandi'ore Ring'ana Ri'obonda
verses:
Nkorandi' ore ring'ana ri'obonda,
'Yomito ko ribaga rire?
Nkorandi' ore ring'ana ri'obonda 'Yominto
k'omobaso ore?

Nkorandi' ore ring'ana ri'obonda,
'Botuko botoererete?
Nkorandi' ore ning'ana ri'obonda,
Rigesa rigiya richenu?

Nkorandi' ore ring'ana ri'obonda,
'Ncher' eyi' abanto baraigwe?
Nosangererie rigesa rigiya,
Inchwo obwatane n'abande.
hymns.refrain:
Rigesa bono ng'ang'e rire('ng'e rire);
'Mererno y'abagesi eere (kegima)
Rigesa riao naki rirabe; 'Monene
kagosangereri' abanto.

hymns.title: Tiga Ker' Etaya Yoke
verses:
Tiga ker' etaya yoke, Omosunte ngoch' ore
'Mosunte bw'ens' Omonene, Omonen' ataracha.

Nony' abange mbasundoka, Bakwanga gwanch' enchili
Kwegena gwaito ntobeke,'S' eira yokoirana.

'Ng'ana riaye nari'etaya Ntokonyara gosira
'Mechando neba ker' ase, Titokonyara kwangwa.

Merem' emiy' eoroke, eyesokie ens'eye
'koigwera koret' ebisio, Gatore n'okwegena.
hymns.refrain:
Rosia chitay' abaminto, Mochirosie n'okoiroka.
Gocha kwaye ng'ange kore, Kera etaya yoke.

hymns.title: Motori' Atotebia Torende
verses:
Motori' atotebia torende,
Tosabe rioka Aru' Omoika bwe
chinguru 'Se baria banchire.

'Totebia torende tosabe,
Tob' abarwani Tokonye toigw' eriogi
riao, Koigwer 'obogima.

'Totebia torende tosabe,
Naki bwango ng'ache Gototimokia
atoire, Enka ya botambe.

'Totebia torende tosabe,
'Mogambi ochire Na toigwere
n'omogoko, Torende goik' ache.

hymns.title: Bugia Engoma Y' Enchili
verses:
Bugia engoma y' enchili, Ker' omont' akurerwe;
Oyokoigwa Ring'ana, Aonchok' abe moyo.

Yebugie chinsinyo chionsi, ''Se abasibwa bare;
Teba 'Bionsi ng'ang'e bire, Tata obarangeirie."

Yebugi' ebitunwa igoro, Ase chiroro chionsi;
Chindiba chiiranerie, 'Mogok' ogotoreka.

Yebugie 'S'abarosire 'Ganetie batimoke;
Omotori' obachikire, 'Mbuya moche as'ende."
hymns.refrain:
Bugi' engoma Omwegeni, Yebugi' ense n'enyancha;
Nyasae ochikire ker'omosibwa asiborwe.

hymns.title: Imok' Abakristo Bun' Abesegi
verses:
Imok' Abakristo bun'abesegi,
Mosalaba O Yes' otang'aine
bosio Kristo natang'aine ase esegi,
Bosi' as'esegi ror' ebendera.

'Riogi ri'obobui Saitani atama,
'Bakrist' abarwani, rwana mobue
 Makweri aiguswa koigw' okobaka,
Abaminto tera 'moki'amariogi.

Kanisa ya Nyasae bun' abarwani, Toet' as'abegeni
baetete; Titwatananeka, intwe nabamo,
gosemeri', ogwancha, kwegeri'okomo.

'Bagambi baeta, Magambi agwa,
Kanisa ya Yeso nebeo rioka;
Nguru chi'amakweri, Nchikoyebua,
Ntore n'eira ya Yes' etabugwe.

'Nchwo abanto twensi togende amo,
Tera naintw' ogotera kwo'bobui;
Gosik' ogotogia Kristo Erwoti,
'Malaika, 'banto tera botambe.
hymns.refrain:
Imok' Abakristo bun'abesegi,
Mosalaba 'O Yes'otang'aine bosio.

hymns.title: Enkoro Yane Imoka
verses:
Enkoro yane imoka, Ne chinguru chionsi,
 Esegi n'ey' Omonene, Keegwa n'egutwa.

Eriogi n'eria Nyasae, Rigokorangeria,
Ner' omonyene okorwa, 'Gutwa y'obogima.

'Barori nabwo abange, Bakorigereria;
Toinyora as' okorwa, Bwatia orogendo.

'Monene gwatochakirie, Koamererania;
 Buna intwe tokobua, Kobua nokwao.

hymns.title: 'Bachenu More N'oboros' Obuya
verses:
Bachenu more n'oboros'obuya ase
okwegena ring'ana riaye;
Nkiaratebe Kebuet'egiatebete,
Ning'onagotamera Omotoria?
Ning'onagotameraOmotoria?

Timoiroka ninde amo nainwe,
Naki Ninche Nyasae orabatorie;
Nkoe 'nguru, ngotorie, ngotenenie,
nkobwate n'okoboko gwe chinguru,
Nkobwate nokoboko gwe chinguru.

Kondakorangerie korw' as'amache,
Ndoche chi'obororo nchigokobua;
 Naki nimbe naye kogosesenia,
Na kogochena korw'as'emechando
Na kogochena korw'as'emechando.

Nonya kogoet'emechand'emenge,
Obuya bwaneobonge mboisaine;
'Morerb' omong'orakobue,
Nayobekir'ogochen' ogosibie'
Nayobekir'ogochen' ogosibie.

Nkoro etimogete ase Yeso,
Tinkoyetig'egend'as'ababisa;
Nkor'eyio amakwerimnayenyegeria,
Tinkoyetiga yaya tinkoyetiga,
Tinkoyetiga yaya tinkoyetiga.

hymns.title: Enkoro yane Renda
verses:
'Nkoro yane renda; Babis' emeganda,
B'ebibe babetereria; Gokorusia Igoro.

Renda rwana saba; Timotig'esegi,
Rwan'as'oboyia botambe; Saba ogokonywa.

'Segi teraera; Totig' amatimo
'Segi eye tekoera; Goik'onyore egutwa.

hymns.title: Tindi N'eki Nyegenete
verses:
Tindi n'eki nyegenete; Tati'amanying' a Yeso,
Tinkonyara Omonyene; 'Bibe biane kobisibia.

Mosunte n'otub' amaiso; 'Buya,bwaye bong'isane,
Emerindo kerang'ake; 'Ngurun chiaye ching'isane.

Amanying' Aye n'eira; Binkonye as' emechando,
Onsi ense gekoera; 'Monen' Ere nang'isane.

Karache n'ebitureri; Tiga ntoke nde ime yaye,
Nyeboyetie oboronge; Ntari nakomocha konde.
hymns.refrain:
Yes'egetare nteneine,
S'ande nigo nkorimera,
S'ande nigo nkorimera.

hymns.title: Tenena Bokong'u ase Nyasae
verses:
Tenena bokong'uase Nyasae,
Komwaga omonge okogusa;
Ner' egetare, nere chinguru,
'Bibe kobire ang'e.

Tenena bokong'u s' oboronge,
Nkoro y'ekeene y'okwegena;
Nas' Egetare orabuere,
Obonge bw' obosiru.

Tenena bokong'u s'ekeene,
Nonya kegotebana nkebue;
'Getar' Omorembe Motimoko
merindo keraete
hymns.refrain:
Totenene bokong'u as' egetare,
'Getare.Kristo bweka;
Gatoraremererie ntotenene,
'S' ekerogo ki'obonene.

hymns.title: Rend' Engaki Nenke
verses:
Rend' engaki nenke, Nderoibaga rire,
Rend'ense tebua, Morende mosabe
Renda ntw' abareu. Mobisa mokong'u.
Renda tari are, 'Monene bw'enyangi.

Oserie chitoro. Nechitang'utang'u,
Eira Neyao, 'Mogoko botambe;
'Monen' akarenda, As'engcncho yao,
Akagoiterera Amanyinga Aye.

Aye mwanche Yeso nenchinguru chiao,
'Mobisa ng'ang" are, 'boyi ebirwanero.
Bono ribaga ndire, Tirieta bosa,
Renda na gosaba, 'Bakristo renda.
hymns.refrain:
Renda, Saba, Renda, Saba,
Rend' osabe obotuko na omobaso,
Renda mosabe.

hymns.title: Aka Eriogi
verses:
Aka eriogi! Ror' omobisa!
'Moki' ebendera ya Nyasae
Beka ebinto bi'esegi yaye,
Mwegen' Amarik' Amachenu.

Tob' abakong'u as' omobisa,
Twensi twamanya ntobue
'Nguba, 'bendera chimekameke,
Rwaner' ekeene ntobue.

Nyasa' otoigwe gatogosaba,
Tokonye n'obuya, bwao
Segi_ekoera tob'ababui,
Ntobek' egutwa bosio bwao.
hymns.refrain:
'Barwani etanan' ebendera!
S'oboremu raria ring'ana
Genda bwango Motere Hosana!
'Sagini yaito nere Kristo.

hymns.title: Toagach' Egetare Ke Moyo
verses:
Toagach' Egetare ke moyo,
Yes' Egetare Kiemiaka;
Toremererie okogoswa,
Omwaga gokogusa

'Bande baagach' amaroba,
Korora kw'enibo y'ense
Aband' emerindo y'ebibe,
'Megok' ogotogigwa.

Agach' egetar' ekeene,
'Boroso botasareke;
'Gosemeria kare na kare,
Ogotoreka gwaito.
hymns.refrain:
Natoagache As' egetare
Toagach' egetar' egekong'u
'Se Krist' Egetare.

hymns.title: Nkogenda Nde Bo Igoro
verses:
Nkogenda nde bo igoro,
Ngosukande gochia ang'e:
Ngosaband' amatuk'onsi,
'Yes' antenenie igoro.

Tinkogoka komeny' as' obwoba,
ne chitang'utang'u;
'Bande mbancha komenyao,
Gosaba kwane nchie igoro.

Nindigetie 'menyeigoro,
Nonya Saitan ogontema
'S'okwegena naigur' ogotera
kw' abachenu Igoro.

Ndigetie ng'ike igoro,
Ndor' amasas' obonene;
Ngosaba nde goika ng'ike,
Yeso Ndae ng'ike igoro.
hymns.refrain:
Onyimokie Ontenenie,
'Sokwegen' ense ya igoro
'Ns' engiya kobua chionsi,
Yes' antenenie igoro.

hymns.title: Morendiobonene Mboche
verses:
'Morendiobonene mboche, bwa Zayoni as'emambia?
'Bimanyererio bi'ogocha biakorabeiri' enchera?
Omotoria Oramokie, 'Masase nkobar' are,
Eboyie ase enyangi, Bwakire boka! boka!

Omorendi, amasaria 'Mentekire kobua,
'Bimanyererio as'ense, Biorokirie ogocha
'Getureri gekobuga, geture abakure,
Abachenu nababoke beboyeti ogotakwa.

'Morendi rora bwakire, Rituko ri'Omonene;
Natoake amariogi, Obonda ng'ang'e bore,
 Omotari ndora ng'umbu Kanani ekoorokia,
 Yerusalemu omuya boig' ororekanire.

'Morendi nka yedhahabu' Karanset' Omogambi;
Ochabeire buya mono, 'S' omoremb' agamb'onsi
'Borabu as'ebitunwa Amasaria akomesa
Chinsoko chingiya mono, Ebisicha ebiya.

'Morendi, ror' ens'egocha, Yamete buya mono;
 Ere ng'umbu ang'e mono! omogond'o Edeni
 Igwa amater' amaya,  Agoterwa Igoro,
 Ror' abange bagotera, Omotari nabeo.

hymns.title: Omonyamwando Naki Ogosundoka?
verses:
Omonyamwando nakiogosundoka?
Naki_okorara kogwaikire?
Imoka bweboyi' ebinto bi'esegi;
Matuko nkoer' ar' ayerera.

Omonyamwando naki ogotebana?
Naki ogotiga eng'eria yao Eboyie
Omotoria ngocha are;
'Morototer' amare igoro.

Tagoteban' as' omong'uso bw' ense!
Buya bw' ense nigo bogosira
Butora chingatare chia omobe;
Omonyamwando onchoka tama.

hymns.title: Abarendi Ba Zayoni
verses:
Abarendi ba Zayoni, Teba ay' obotuko
Eng'enang'eni yachire? Nabokiamoke gose?
Mwarorire, amasase agocha?
Mwarorire, amasase agocha?

Ebimanyererio bi'ense, twabietire gose?
'Ngoika tor' ekiambokero, nonya nengegu gose?
Amaene, twarorir' obogambi?
Amaene, twarorir' obogambi?

Oborabu bwachichire, Toake egeturi;
Twarorir' eng'enang'eni, Igor' endabu mono!
Chenga mwensi, 'Gotoreka gwachire
Chenga mwensi, 'Gotoreka gwachire.

Twanyorire omorai; Ense ng'ang' eberete;
Natogende bosio bwango, Tosoe as'agiya,
Tera mono, na kogoka kegima
Tera mono, na kogoka kegima.

hymns.title: Tokob'Omosunte
verses:
Tokob'Omosunte Yes'ogocha,
Tokob' Omosunte Yes'ogocha;
Tokob'Omosunte Yes'ogocha,
Kobaira abanchwa nka:

Bororo mbokoba Yes' Ogocha,
Bororo mbokoba Yes'Ogocha;
Neb'emambi' engiya Yes'ogocha.
Kobaira abanchwa nka.

Kweumia ngokaiy' Eker'agocha,
Kweumia ngokaiy' Eker'agocha;
Rigesa rigiya Yes'ogocha,
Kobaira abanchwa nka.
hymns.refrain:
Kobaira abanchwa nka ('ra nka),
Kobaira abanchwa nka ('ra nka);
Tokob' Omosunte Yes' Ogocha,
Kobaira abanchwa nka.

hymns.title: Krist' Omorai Oito
verses:
Bendera yait' eramboke botambe,
'S'ebibe biegachete mbitugutwe,
Krist' Omorai oit' Obuire ense,
Tobwati' e'nchera yonsi.

'Segi nendoro ko tekoira geka,
Nobobui tosoe omoganda;
Totere ogotera kw' obobui,
Gatorabwati' enchera.

hymns.title: Twagosabire Chinguru
verses:
Twagosabire chinguru,
Chiria chiare riria kare
Chiagerete bakerua pi,
Bakabua emechando.

Ng'ai Omoika oria ore,
'Koret' Abramu oyoo?
'Kanyete Paul' enkoro,
'Kaba na nguru chia Igoro.

Omoik' oria orandetie,
'Bwanchani chinchera chiao
'Karabi' amarik' a Isaya,
N'amatera a Daudi.

Buya bwao mbori nguru,
'Bun' ekero kia Elija
Musa akaror' obonene,
Ayub' akaremereria?

Inyor' amatuko aria,
Keror' emeremo
yao Gatwakoeire chinkoro,
Toiterere omoik' oo.

hymns.title: Tenena Ase Yeso
verses:
Tenena ase Yeso, Abarwani baye,
'Moki' ebendera igoro, Tebaisa kobugwa!
Morae mogand' oye, Bobui as'obobui
Mobabu' ababisa Erio Krist' agambe.

Tenena ase Yeso, Igwera engoma,
Esegi yarorire, 'tuko ri' Obobui
Abaye mokorere, korwani' ababisa
Remereri' emechando, Ogokwa nokoba.

Tenena ase Yeso, Esegi neere;
Rero nario esegi, ankio nobobui
Ere Oyorabue, Gutwa y'obogima
Er'amo n'Omorwoti, Mbagambe botaimbe.

hymns.title: 'Monene Ngoika ri?
verses:
'Monene ngoika ri, Orateban' Aye?
Emioyo yarosire Koganya ochiche.
'Kero ekio orache, Nakebare mono,
'Borabu bwao mbobar' as' abanto bao?

'Motoria ngoika ri, Oratig' abao?
Gwatebanire mono, 'Mbake baganyete.
Abakori emeremo, Borobire mono,
Abake bagangayete, 'S' ogokorotota.

Tura abanto bao, 'S' okobachanchima,
Abachenu batebe, "Motoria ng'ang'are."
Chitaya chiaito nchioke, Tweboyie
bokong'u Tokoganye kegima, Tokoror'
obosio.

hymns.title: Ong' Okwegen' Okonene
verses:
Gotagoswe n'ab'ens'eye, Nagosekwa bori
Ogotabugwe n'ebibe, gosirigwe bori
N'ebiya bi'ens'eye.

'Monene ng'a okwegena, Erio kende ngecha
Ninyor' Omogok' omuya nonya nde as'ense
Bw'enka ya igoro.

hymns.title: 'Mokristo Boka
hymns.refrain:
'B' omoremu, B' omoremu
'B' omoremu, Rora omobisa

hymns.title: 'Morendi Bw'Omosalaba?
verses:
'Morendi bw' Omosalaba, 'Motunyi bw' eng'ondi
Tinkwobo' emeremo yaye nonya Nerieta gwatora.

Ng'irwa igoro yamare, As' agiya mono
Bande korwanerera keegw'a eke as'obokong'u.

Bosi' ababisa tibaiyo? Nimbwatesie omorindo
'Ns'eye mb' omosani bw'obuya konyira 'se Nyasae?

Ndwane omoerio ngambe, Ondemi' Omonene
Ndemererie obororo bwonsi, Nyore nguru 'se Yeso.
hymns.refrain:
Totang' e ------ Merindo Erio taik' as'are
Totang' e ------ Merindo Erio toik' As'are.

hymns.title: Abanchete Nyasae
verses:
Abanchete Nyasae, Moche nomogoko
Ter'ogotera okuya, Ter'ogotera okuya
Ase ekerogo, Ase ekerogo.

Batamomanyeti Nyasae mbatera,
Bana b'Erwoti ya igoro, 'Bana b'Erwoti ya 'goro
Boroki' Omogoko, Boroki 'Omogoko.

Rimisu rigiya rirw' ase Zayoni
Totaraika igoro, As' ebitii bia Igoro
Gotara chinchera chiria chiedhaabu.

'Matera abuche, 'Mariga asire,
Bana b'Erwoti ens' eria, Ens'eria ya Imanueli!
Gochia chinse chinde, chingiya chia Igoro.
hymns.refrain:
Togende Zayoni, Omochi' omuya Zayoni
Totire gochia Zayoni, 'Mochi' omuya o Nyasae.

hymns.title: 'Monene Nakwegene?
verses:
'Segi yokorwanerera, 'Keene noboronge
'Segi ndoro yokorwania, chinguru chi'omosunte
Baremu barigirie, Eri'ere nakwegene?

Rora bacha nendamwamu, Nechinguru chi'omobe
Nechinguru chi'omobisa, korw' ense y'omosunte,
'Baremu barigirie, Eri' ere nakwegene.

Tata igo atoroche, 'Malaik' atotoria
Yeso ner' Omorai oito, titokonyara kogwa
Baremu nababua, Eri' ere nakwegene?
hymns.refrain:
Monene Nakwegene, Nomoe, obonene
Rem' okwane nomokia, Eri'ere nakwegene?

hymns.title: Emeremo Yaerire
verses:
Emeremo yaerire, Esabato yachakire;
Esasoki' enkoro yane, Rirende n'amasikani.

Motogie obaeire, Abarosu, gotimoka
'Mioyo yabo etimoka; kobua amatuk' ande.

Omoiranerie mbuya, Buna rimisu rigiya
Tonyore omotimoko, onde tari__orayomanye.

'Mogoko bw' enkoro ime, Nokogach' ogotimoka;
Ogacheire ekanisa, Omoerio bw'emechando.

hymns.title: 'Sabato Enchenu
verses:
'Sabato enchenu, 'Banto bagokeire,
Toganyete koigw' eng'ana, Chinkoro chigoke.

'Tuk'erio Esabato, Neri'a'aye Tata,
Naintwe otosesenie Tokogosasima.

Seseni' abachenu, Kero togosaba,
Togoker' ogotimoka,Torend' Esabato.

Chisabato chikoera inse aiga,
Esabat'etakoera Ntotimoke Igoro.

hymns.title: Tibweb' Esabato
verses:
Tibweb' Esabato. Monen' asesenirie
Erituko rigiya, Goetania onsi
Riret' ogotimoka, Nomogoko bori
'Masari' ay' agoika, Nobuya bwa Igoro.

'Yerend' Esabato, mosasime rero
Ere oyotebete; "Nche ninch' enchera"
Gatoramotunyane, Omotoria oito
Natonyoinsie mono, Amach' Obogima.

Rituk' omogoko, Renda chinsa chiaye
Totere ase Yeso, 'Mosani Omuya;
Omogweni' Omwanchwa, 'Muya bw'Ogokumia!
Omenye naintwe bori, chinkoro botambe.
hymns.refrain:
Ika Ang'e, ika ang' Esabat' enyansu;
Ika ang'e, ika ang' Esabat' enyansu.

hymns.title: 'Mochakano Nyasae
verses:
'Mochakano Nyasae, 'Gatonga Esabato
Eri' akayesesenia, 'Kayerwa as'abanto.

'Ria gatano narimo, 'Meremo ekaera
'Sabato egachaka, Toigwere totimoke.

'Bange bayeonchoire, 'Timoka Jumapili
Rigi' Ebuku momanye, Teri kobatebia bo.

'B'ekeene mbatebe, mwanyabant' onchoorete
Korende as'ebuku, Goonchoka tikori oo.

Nkarigia na ekero, narora Esabato
Nkayerera koigwera, nero yoka enchera.
hymns.refrain:
Twagokire, Twagokire
Twagokire rituko, 'Sabato ya Nyasae.

hymns.title: Rituko Ri'Omogoko
verses:
Rituko ri'omogoko Rire ri'amasase
Eriogi ri'omoichano, Ri'ekieni rigiya
'S'ore', banene, 'bake, 'Bacha gosasima
Batera Omochenu, O kare na kare.

Aye nekiambokero, 'S' emerind' etache
'Mogondo bwe chinsoko, Chingiya chia Igoro
Ensoko y'ogokendia, Bogima bokong'u
'S' ore negetengero, Gia ense y'omwando.

Rituko ri'okomesia, Naye bw'obwanchani
Rikoboki' amaiga, Y'ebinto bia Igoro
Tonyor'obuy'oboyia, As' ogotimoka
Torigi' ogotimoka, Ogosesenirie.

hymns.title: Eskuru Y'Esabato
verses:
Eskuru y' Esabato, Ngiya mon'ase nde;
Moy'one okogokeire, Esabato' enyansu.

Nkoro yane entayayi, 'Karor'encher' enyia;
Nkarigia aas'agiya, Enka y'esabato.

As'eriogi riobwanchani, Yeso ondangeire;
Erio' mochor'ere bweka,'S'enka y'Esabato.
hymns.refrain:
Sabato (Sabato) Enyansu (enyansu)
Sabato (Sabato) Enyansu (enyansu)
Moy'one okogokeire, Esabat'enyansu.

hymns.title: Kegima Twaikire Omokubio Naende
verses:
Kegima twaikire Omokubio naende, tiga torigi' ebisio,
Toganyet' aiga mwaye;
E rituko rinene, 'Gotimoka okuya,
E rituko rinene, 'Gotimoka okuya.

Gatokorigi' obuya, 'S'Erieta ri'Omotoria
Tworoki' obosio bwao, Torusi' ebibe bionsi
'Maboko atimoke, Totimoke as'ore
'Maboko atimoke, Totimoke as'ore.

Tobak' Erieta Riao, Nay' obe ang'e naintwe
Bonene toborore, Gatore nyomba mwao
Omonene tomenie, 'Ndagera y'obogima
Omonene tomenie, Eya kare na kare.

Ng'an' ekune ababe, Eremie abachenu
Obuchi' obuya bwao, Ogweni' abachandeku
Chisabato chibe bo, Goika togambe n'Aye
Chisabato chibe bo, Goika togambe n'Aye.

hymns.title: Rituko Riao Richenu
verses:
Rituko riao richenu, Kobua ayande,
Titorengereria ense, Tatiga Nyasae.

Ribaga ria ogosaba, Tonyare kwaberwa,
Tokwane na oboremu,,"Tat' ore Igoro".

'Mang'ana ay'omorembe, Ere atotebie,
Koraa omoonchoki, Aike Igoro.

'Bibe biaito biaberwe, Tosibore buya,
Ere bwanchete enkoro, Natoe obuya.

hymns.title: 'Meremo Yaerire
verses:
Meremo yaerire, 'Sabato y'Omonene,
Twasoa ogotimoka, n'Omorembe chinkoro.

Namany' as'okwegena, 'Sabat' as'obotongi,
N'ogwancha kway' Omotoria, N'omochengo chinkoro.

Korigereria ng'umbu, As' amais' atarore,
Buya bwaye bw'ogokumia, Sabato chinkoroime.

Togosoa ens' enyia, 'S'obuya bwonsi bore,
'S' Esabato etaere, Tomenye goika kare.

hymns.title: 'Monen' Obuya Bwao
verses:
'Monen' obuya, Bwao bw'ogokumia,
Ogatong'ense, N'ebinto bionsi;
As'amatuko, Atano na rimo,
Ogatimok 'Esabat'enchenu.

Chinyoni chionsi, Chiter' obuy' obo,
Ebitunwa n'amagoko boigo;
'Banto bonsi baitaberi' as'eriogi,
Ogatimok' Esabat' enchenu.

Ase tore n'omogok' omonene,
Esabat'ekoret' Ogosanga;
Abanto twacha, Amo gosasima,
Ogatimok 'Esabat' Enchenu.

hymns.title: Rituko Richenu Mono
verses:
Rituko richenu mono, Riatongetwe na Nyasae, Totimoke
rituko riaye. Natosesenigwe mono.

Twatimokir' Esabato, Twagokire gosasima; N'ogotera
tomobake, Ase obwanchani bwaye.

Tobake Nyasae mono, Ase Yeso Omotoria; Ase amanyinga
aye, Twanyorire okwabera.

'Kina ki'ebibe nogokwa, Atokweret' Omotoria; Tobwat'
amachiko Aye, Titosari' amang'an' Aye.

hymns.title: Ika Ang' Omokubio
verses: Ika ang' omokubio, Boitongo ase ense; Kun' enkor' enyororo. N'amasaria Igoro.
Rituko gotimoka, Ngaki yao ngoet' ere; Neriogo 'S' obororo, Goik' emeremo eere.
E rituko richenu, Gotogia na gosaba; Gosemia abororo, 'Bisio biao ebinge.
Ika ang' omokubio, N'omong'us' Omochenu;  Sesenia chinsa chiao, Nkoro yan' eganyete.

hymns.title: Ker'Emambia
verses: Ker'emambia nobwanchani, Torenda rituko rionsi. Gatwarendirw'obotuko, Meber' ere nechinguru.

Kabogokia n'amabera, Se tore gatogosaba;
Mechand'eete twaberwe, Tosemeretie igoro.

Emeremo ye rituko, Toisa koyerengereria;
Bond'oboyia, nib' enene, Nyasae nerue ekengw'anso.

Bimoremo bisinini, Mbitotange titosaba;
Na kwang' enchera endonge, 'Gotoiki' ase Nyasae.

S'obwanchani bwao Tata, Tobwenere gotimoka;
Tokonye rero botambe, Tobe buna togosaba.

hymns.title: Omonene Ka Bogokia
verses:
Omonene kabogokia, Noigw' eriogi riane;
'S' ore inche ningosabe, Ninkogaramere.

Igoro Kristo achiete, Gosaber' abaye;
Komworokia Tata oye, Ebirero biaito.

Omoika oo andae, Chinchera chindonge;
Rongeyia ker' omoremo, As'obosio bwane.

Abanchet' erieta riao, Abasemeretie;
Monguru obaetanane, 'Buya bun'eng'aya.

hymns.title: Rituko Riaerire
verses:
'Megoko yaerire, Toiranie mbuya;
Chinsa chi' omosunte tichitobera chimbe. Yeso tomorekere, Torend' as' obotuk' obo.

'Meremo yaerire, Natogoterere
Chinsa chi'omosunte nchib' echi' emechando. O Yes' ototengerere, Torend as' obotuk' obo.

Tokanyekie chinkoro, Nyasae kwamanyire,
'Mechand' eng'aki eng'ana etoganyet' ense. Yes' omwanchwa otoigwe, Otorend' otorusie oo.

hymns.title: Kabe Nainche
verses:
Kabe nainche mbwango bokoira,
Mosunte oichoire kabe nainche;
Abande basinyirwe kondemia,
Mokonyi bw'aboro, Kabe nainche.

Bogima bwane bwaeta bwango,
'Mogoko bw'ense nig'ogoeta,
Ebinto bionsi-biaonchokire,
'Yotagoonchoka, menya nainche.

Ninkoganetie ekero gionsi,
Buya bwao mbobu' omobisa;
Ng'o bun' ay' oranyare kondaa,
S' obuya n'obobe, menya nainche.

Amo naye tindi n'okoiroka,
Marwair' obororo bionsi mbosa
Nonya nogokwa tikori kende,
Nabuire onye kore nainche.

hymns.title: Ker' Erioba Riagure
verses:
'Ker' erioba riagure, 'Mosunt' otubir' ense
Ching'enang'eni kobara Motogie Omotongi bw'obotuko.

Omonyen' obogima, 'Menyet' oboiko bwonsi
Tosangereri' abao, Ase riicho riao, ng'ang'e ore.

Bwanchani bwa' obonge, Bobe naintwe botuko
Gator' ase chitoro, 'chiche im' as' omoika, Togosaba.

Kero ching'enang'eni, Rituko n'obotuko
Biaetire korw' ense, Monene nabonkiere, Botaire.
hymns.refrain:
'Mochenu Nyasae, bw'emeganda
Gwaichoire Igoro n'ense,
Bionsi bikobak' Aye Tat'o Igoro.

hymns.title: 'Mobaso Bw'enkoro Yane
verses:
'Motori' omobaso one,
Botuko mbori koreo
'Mechando y'ense tetoka,
Gontanga korw' amais' ao.

Konanyorire chitoro
Ng'ichori' ebirengererio
Naki ere buya ndare,
'Gekuba kiao botambe.

Kabe nainche kobogokia,
Otaiyo tinkoba moyo
Kabe nainche kobokoira,
Otaiyo nigo ndakwe.

Onsesenie gankoboka,
Ntarasoa ase ense
'Bwanchani bwao bombue,
Goika ntoke Igoro.

hymns.title: 'Megondo Yamire Mono
verses:
Megondo yamire mono, 'Ndagera yarabire,
Ande onsi yarabire, 'Magoko n'ebirubo.

Bagende kero bogokia, Na mobaso bagende,
Goika erioba rigwe, Basangererie onsi.

Abamwatomirwe Reta okwama kwain' okuya,
Mogoroba so' asare N'omogok' omonene.
hymns.refrain:
'Monene tom' abagesi igw' ekerero giaito
Basangererie rigesa, Emeremo eere.

hymns.title: Igwa Ring'ana Ria Nyasae Oito
verses:
Igwa ring'ana ria Nyasae oito, Reta chitaisi as'emonga;
Karue chinkoro chiano chionsi bori, mwegen'eira y'ebisio.

Norigeti' ornanye 'nguru chi'omoika, Reta chitaisi as'emonga;
Menya n'Ere buya chingaki chionsi, Gakoru'eira y'ebisio.

'Mater'aigweke 'goro as'amare, Kamwaretire chitaisi emonga;
Amatera y'omogok'aigwekane, Ntore neira Y'ebisio.
hymns.refrain:
"Morete chitaisi as'emonga, Montem" Otebir 'Omenene;
"Nimbatwererie ebisi'ebinge, mono goetani'ebi moganetie.

hymns.title: Nki Keransibi' Ebibe?
verses:
Nki keransibi' ebibe? Namanyinga aye Yeso;
Nki keranchene ime? Namanyinga aye Yeso.

Kegochena tikeiyo, Tatig' amanying'a Yeso;
'S 'okwaberwa ninsabe, Amanyinga aye Yeso.

Kende ngekombwatania Tatig' amanying'a Yeso;
Tindakora ekiya Tatig' amanyinga' Yeso.

Tindi n'ogosemeria Tatig' amanying'a Yeso;
'Buya gos'oboronge Tatig' amanying'a Yeso.

Obonene! nintere, Amanyinga aye Yeso;
Nintere na kobaka, Amanyinga aye Yeso.
hymns.refrain:
Ogoitek' okuya, Kogonchena bori;
Nsoko ende teiyo, Tatig' amanying'a Yeso.

hymns.title: Ngakoa 'Bogima
verses:
Ngakoa' bogima, Ngaiter' amanyinga
Ob'omoborigwa, Korw' as' abakure
Ngakoa ngakoa obogima, Aye nki kwang'eire?
Ngakoa ngakoa obogima, Aye nki kwang'eire?

Natigete Tata, N'obonene bwaye,
Nechandete ense, Ase omosunte;
'S' engencho yao nkabitiga, Nki gwantigareirie?
'S' engencho yao nkabitiga, Nki gwantigareirie?

Nkagochandekera, 'Monwa otakwane
'S'oboror' obonge, Gokorusia aabe
Ngakobogoreria bionsi, Nki kwambogoreirie?
Ngakobogoreria bionsi, Nki kwambogoreirie?

hymns.title: Rigi 'Abasiru
verses:
Rigi'abasiru Obasoror' abasireir' ebitunwa igoro;
Na kobatebi'amang'ana aye, 'inchwo ase nde nimbanchete.

Rigi abasiru borokie Yeso, Abwo barosire chinkoro;
Nakobar' as'ogotoreka, boroki'enchera y'obogima.

Ningende naki Yes'ondangeirie, motunyane kera rituko
Ndend'abagokwa moki'abakogwa, Mborokie Yeso ner'enchera.
hymns.refrain:
(Bass)
Nindagende are gochi 'ebitunwa, mbairani 'abasiru'se riicho,
Ase obweri bw 'Omoboria one, Yes 'okweret' abanyabibe.
(S.A.T.)
 Nindagende gochi'ebitunwa, Nimbairanie 'basiru gocha;
As'obweri bw'omobori'one, Yes'okweret' abanyabibe.

hymns.title: Yes' As' Obworor' Okorangeirie
verses:
Yes' as'obworor' okorangeirie, Eri' oche nka, oche rero
Naki_ogotayaya korw' asare, Gokogend' are mono?

'Rangeiri' omorosu otimoke, oche rero, oche rero
Ret' egurube nagosesenie, Ere takogoseria.

Yeso nakoganyete ochiche, koganyete, aye rero,
Inchw' omworokie ebibe biao, Totebana nchuo bwango.

Yeso ogosoroire omoigwe, Igw'eriogi riaye rero;
Abegeni baye nabagoke, Imoka genda bwoye.
hymns.refrain:
Inchwo rero (Inchwo rer'okorangeirie)
Inchwo rero (Inchwo rer'okorangeirie)
Inchwo rero (Inchwo rer'okorangeirie bono)
Okorangeirie n'obwororo.

hymns.title: 'Mogeni Ngesieri Are
verses:
'Mogeni ngesieri are, Igora; ('Motori' asoe 'Motori' asoe)
Nao are botambe, Igora; ('Motori' asoe 'Motori' asoe)
Igor' ataragenda Igorer' Omochenu
Yeso Kristo O Nyasae Igora (Motori' asoe Motori' asoe)

Igor' enkoro yao, Igora; (Motori' asoe Motori' asoe)
Gokoganya nagende, Igora; (Motori' asoe Motori' asoe)
Igorer' Omosani, Arende nkoro yao;
Nabe naye botambe, Igora (Motori' asoe, Motori' asoe)

Origw' eriogi riaye, Igora; (Motori' asoe, Motori' asoe)
Mochore ab'oyoo, Igora (Motori' asoe, Motori' asoe)
Ngesieri ateneine, Omogoko nonyore
'Rieta riaye ribakwe, Igora (Motori' asoe, Motori' asoe)

'Mogeni korwa Igoro, Igora; (Motori' asoe, Motori'asoe)
Omoyega arosie, Igora. (Motori' asoe, Motori' asoe)
'Bibe biao biaberwe, K'ebiense bikoera
Nakoire Igoro, Igora (Motori' asoe, Motori' asoe)

hymns.title: Nkorangeri' Are Ng'ora
verses:
Nkorangeri' are ng'ora n'obwanchani, Korangeri' aye nainche,
Aganyete egesieri gi'enkoro, 'koganyet' aye nainche.

Titotebana, Yeso osoroire, Inche amo naye bo;
Nase ki togochay' obuya bwaye? Arure ase tore.

O engaki ngoeta ere bwango, Ngotoetanie ere;
'Mosunte n'amakweri ngocha bire, Bigotochera twensi.

Borengererie obwanchani bwaye, Bw'Eira ase tore;
Nonya twamochire natwabere bo, Aye nainche bori.
hymns.refrain:
Nchwo nka'. . . . Nchwo nka'. . . . , Mwarosire moche nka;
'Sogosorora Yeso okorangeirie, Monyabibe nchwo inka.

hymns.title: Nkaigwa Yeso Ogokwana
verses:
Nkaigwa Yeso ogokwana "Ninchwo otimoke;
Ikaransa kwarosire, Bweegek' ase nde."
Inkamochiera ndosete, Nde n'omoichano!
Akang'a obotimoko, Ere ongokirie.

Nkaigwa Yeso ogokwana, "Ninche Omobaso;
Ondigererie Orabe, Orabe botambe".
Nkamorigereria Yeso 'kang' eng'enang'eni
Nintare as'oborabu, Nkore orogendo.

hymns.title: Yes' Omorisi' Omuya
verses:
Yes' Omorisi' omuya, Okorangeirie,
Gocha ase riicho, Otimoke nyomba;
Nchwo bori nechinguru, kore omosae,
Soa ase riicho, Enchera endonge.

Yes' Omorisi' omuya, Akerua as'ore,
Bono nkorangeri' are, Omotari inchwo;
Karue as' emechando, Yeso otebire,
Soa ase riicho, Soa motimoke.

Koganya noboriri, Chisese nchireo,
Gochirigia ching'ondi, Chinsiru chichirie,
Yeso Morisi' Omuya, Otebire oche,
Soa riicho riaye, Erio otimoke.

hymns.title: Igwa Eriogi Ria Yeso
verses:
Igwa Eriogi Ria Yeso, Rikorangeria iga, 'Ing'o
bwanchire kogenda, Korem' omogond' one?"
Botambe nkorangeri' are, 'Ng'eria yaye nenene;
Ing'o bwanchire atebe, "Naond' aiga, ntoma".

Onye tokwambok' enyancha, goiker' abasiru
Mbare bataraonchoka, ang' as'ore bakonye
'Takwane buna Paulo, gos' abamalaika
Randi' obwanchani bwa Yeso, buna abakwerete.

Onye tokob' Omorendi, 'S' orwaki rwa Zayoni
Korag' enchera ya igoro na kwerua ase bonsi
As'ogosaba n'enibo, nokore aya Igoro,
'Mwegenwa buna Aroni, akonyet' Omobani.

Kabant' abange bagokwa, Yeso okorangeirie
Toigwek'aye kogoteba: "Kende nkeri ndakore".
Bwata emeremo eye, Yekor' as' omogoko;
Korarangerigwe teba; "Naond' aiga ntoma".

hymns.title: Twarigure Ring'ana
verses:
Twarigure ring'ana: Yes' er' Omotoria;
Randia ring'ana onsi: Yes'er' Omotoria.
Morarie ring'an' eri, Ense nonya n'enyancha,
Igwera ogochika: Yes' er' Omotoria.

Rigende ande onsi; Yes' er' Omotoria
Abanyabibe manya: Yes' er' Omotoria
Ebisinka bitere, chindiba chitaberie,
Ense echenge mono, Yes' er' Omotoria.

Motere as' esegi: Yes' er' Omotoria
Agakwa akaboka: Yes' er' Omotoria
'Bachandegete tera, Gokoromwa enkoro Tera
nonya embera: Yes' er' Omotoria.

'Mwaga noro orarie: Yes' er' Omotoria
Ebisaku bigoke: Yes' er' Omotoria
Bitunwa n'amagoko, Eriogi riigwekane
Ogotera kw'obobui: Yes' er' Omotoria.

hymns.title: Oyoraigwe
hymns.refrain:
"Oyorigetie, Oyorigetie"
'Bitunwa n'amagoko rirandigwe
Ntat' omwanchi korangeri' omosiru
"Oyorigetie, nache!"

hymns.title: Geita Giasie Botambe
verses:
'Geita giasie botambe, Natosoe bisieri,
'Masase y'Omosalaba, 'Bwanchani bw'Omotoria.

Egeita nigo giasie, Bonsi nabatorigwe
Omoke nomonene bo, Nakera egesaku.

Tokore omokia mono, Egeita kogiasie;
Bogoria omosalaba, natonyore egutwa.

'Kero twambokire ng'umbu, Totig' omosalaba;
Natonyore obogima, Na komwancha Igoro.
hymns.refrain:
O amabera amange! Egeita ekio giasie
Inche. . . (inche) nsoe... . (nsoe)
Egeita giasie.

hymns.title: Omogwenia Oore Ang'e
verses:
Omogwenia ore ang'e, Yes' omonyamabera;
Agosasokia chinkoro, Igw' eriogi ria Yeso.

Obonene as' Eng'ondi, Namwegenire Yeso;
Bono nanchir' Omotoria, Nanchir' erieta riaye.

Riet' erio riseri' obwoba, Rieta rinde tiriyo;
Naki nkogokigwa koigwa, Erieta riaye Yeso.

Gakoretana egutwa, Egutwa y' obogima;
Toikaranse amo nere, Togany' okoborigwa.
hymns.refrain:
Ter' abamalaika, Erieta riogwatora;
Ogotera okuya, Rieta riaye Yeso.

hymns.title: K'ebibe Bire 'Birito
verses:
K'ebibe bir' ebirito, Nchwo ase Nyasae;
Keene nagotimokie, Koregen' Eng'ana.

Agaitera amanyinga, Tonyore ebisio;
Bwetobek' amanyinga ime, orabe kegima.

Yes' enchera, ekeene, 'Koru' ogotimoka;
Momwegene timonyorwa, Namoseseneke.

Nchwo moso' as' omoganda, Mogende Igoro;
Komenya ense engiya, Mogoko botambe.
hymns.refrain:
Mwanche rioka, mwanche rioka,
Mwanch' Ere bono, Nagokonye, 'Gokonye bono.

hymns.title: Yeso Ngoet' Are
'Bogim' Obuya Mbweng'e
verses:
'Bogima obuya mbweng'e buna rito rokogwa
Bun' ebigar' ebiom' obe ang'e,
Matuko nkoer' are nababe batugutwe;
Mabera nkoer' ar' obe ang'e.

Bisicha biya bisira basae bagota,
Tori n'engaki entamb' ob' ang'e;
Nyasae okorangeirie tiga ogotayaya,
Karwe as' obosiru ob' ang'e.

Bwang' engaki neete, emechando echiche,
Tama goch' ase Yes' ob' ang'e;
Kab' aye omong'aini tosiekerwa isiko,
Erio oche gosir' ob' ang'e.

Aye omonyabibe Igw' eriogi ria Yeso,
Aba Igoro bagok, ob' ang'e;
Tama korw' omosunte Bweorokie 'se Yeso,
'Chak' orogendo bon' ob' ang'e.
hymns.refrain:
Ob' ang'e, ob' ang'e
Yeso gakorangeria obe ang'e
Goteban' as' ebibe gesieri nagesiekwe
Birero biao mbosa ob' ang'e.

hymns.title: Tiga Yeso Ach' Enkoro
verses:
Kwarosire n' egurub' endito, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro;
Koganeti obogima oboyia, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro.

Onye nobochenu oganetie, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro;
Ensoko y' ogosibia nereo, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro.

Kore namatemwa otanyare, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro;
Kore nokogani' ens' etabue, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro.

Gotegeneti abasani bao, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro;
Morore Mosani ki arabe, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro.

Koratere amo nababui, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro;
Korasoe as' obotimoko, Tiga Yeso ach' enkoro.

Ntige chitang'utang'u, Bono tinkomokana;
Naigoire enkoro, Yeso ache nkoro yane.
hymns.refrain:
Tiga chitang'utang'u, Bono takomokana;
Bono igor' enkoro, Yeso ache enkoro.

hymns.title: Ir' Obogima Bwane
Inchwo Bono
verses:
Inchwo bono, Inchwo bono, Ase Yeso bono;
Bono natochiche, Ase Yeso bono.

Nagotorie Nagotorie, Nagotorie bono;
Bono Omonene, Nomotoria bono.

Nanyar' Ere, Nanyar' Ere, Omonene Yeso;
Bono Nanyar' Ere, Omonene Yeso.

Mwegen' Ere, Mwegen' Ere, Omonene Yeso;
Bono , Mwegen' Ere, Omonene Yeso.

Morangerie, Morangerie, Omonene Yeso;
Bono , Morangerie, Omonene Yeso.

Nakoigw' Ere, Nakoigw'Ere, Omonene Yeso;
Bono , Nakoigw' Ere, Omonene Yeso.

Rora Yeso, Rora Yeso, Omonene Yeso;
Bono , Rora Yeso, Omonene Yeso.

Nakwabere, Nakwabere, Omonene Yeso;
Bono Nakwabere, Omonene Yeso.

Takomwanga, Takomwanga, Omonene Yeso;
Bono , Takomwanga, Omonene Yeso.

Halleluya, Halleluya Amen;
Bono, Halleluya  Halleluya Amen.

hymns.title: 'Bwanchani Boria Bwakare
verses:
Yes' Omonen' agateba randi; ogokonyeka,
Abanto bonsi bamanye Yes' osire gocha.

'Mont' oyom' akaagacha 's' amarab' amaya;
Omwag' ogacha omotindi "Okayeiyeria".

Oyond' er' akaagacha egetare igoro;
Oboroso bwar' obuy' omwaga toyeiyeria.

'Bonyansi bwonsi naboyie, 'Bonyansi bosire;
Emete yonsi nesire, Igena ritigare.

Toagach' as' oboros' obuya nere Yeso;
'Merindo yense neb' emenge tegotobua.
hymns.refrain:
'Bwanchani boria bwa kare,
'Bwanchani nobuya,
'Bwanchani bwa kare Yeso bweka.

hymns.title: Yeso Menya Ime Yane
verses:
Nayerure ekaru, Yasibigwe bori,
Tig' oborabu bwao bomese korwa ime;
Ense yonsi ekire, nonya nomobere,
Eri 'omosomb' oo atar' as' ore rioka.

Ebimo biaye bionsi, Biagw' eriogi riao,
Mbire ang'e bionsi pi, Gokor' emeremo yao;
Gose tibiri korosa, tibiri kogania,
Nony' eubi mbibwati, biarurue pi as' ore.

Nenyango gekong'uswa, Teri gwanchereria,
'Ganyet'eki_oratebe, 'Ker' orayerangerie;
Yeso menya_ime yane 'ye 'mogambi_omuya,
Obe amairaneri' as' okogania kwane.

hymns.title: Nchwo Abamwarosire
verses: 'Nchwo abamwarosire, Nche nimbatimokie" Eriogi ria Yeso riacher' abachandeku Rioroki _amaber' aye, Bun' atwaberete Mogoko otaere, 'bwanchani botambe.
"Nchwo inw abatari, Nimba' oborabu" Riogo 'giya ria Yeso Korabi' omosunte Ntware nogoichana, ntwasirete enchera Twanyor' omogoko n'amater' as' emambia.
"Nchwo inwe' abamogokwa, Nimba' obogima" Eriogi riokoremia, Tobue esegi 'Mobisa nomokong'u, Esegi nendoro Ko gwatoeire chinguru mono kobua.

Onde bwensi orache, Tinkomotuguta Titogotiting'ar' S' eriogi ria Yeso 'Torangeiri' abamochi, Totagwenereti
S' obwanchani obonge, Twachicha as'ore.

hymns.title: Nkoro Yan' eyasiboirwe!
verses:
Nkoro yan' eyasiboirw' omotongie Nyasae;
Nyigwe omoy'on' amanying' ari' aitegete.

Ekweru'as' obokanyeku Asor' Omoboria,
'Nkoro ekoigw' eriogi ria Krist'agambe ime.

Nkoro eyakorirw'enyia yaichoirw' obwanchani,
'Ng' ikeranu _endonge, 'nchenu, 'ngiya buna ore.

Chimbwa chiao aye ong'e 'Monene nchwo bwango,
Rik' erieta ri' enkoro yane ri'obwanchani.

hymns.title: Ner' Ensoko Y'amanyinga
verses:
Ay' Emanwa manyingao Takoera nguru;
Goik' ekanisa enchore, Yaborigwe bori,
Yaborigwe bori, Yaborigwe bori,
Goik' ekanisa enchore, Yaborigwe bori.

Omonene negenire, kwang'eire inche,
Ekeegwa kiagorirwe, Ase amanyinga!
Ase Amanyinga! Ase Amanyinga!
Ekeegwa kiagorirwe, Ase Amanyinga!

Ase ogoter' ogwansu, Ntere nguru Chiao;
Ker'oromem' or' orobe, Rwaborigwe bori Rwaborigwe bori, Rwaborigwe bori; Ker'oromem' or' orobe, Rwaborigwe bori.

hymns.title: Yeso Nche Nindigeti' Ogosibigwa
verses:
Yeso nche nindigeti' ogosibigwa. Nindigetie ay' omenye ase nde;
Okeiyerie keria kegwekinia, Onsibie bono imbe omorabu.

Aye Yeso ondigererie bono, Erio mbe ekeng'wanso kere moyo;
Narure bionsi as' ore, n'omoyo, Onsibie bono imbe omorabu.

'Monen' one inche nagosoroire, Ninkoganyete as' amagoro ao;
Onsibie bono n'amanyinga oka, Onsibie bono imbe omorabu.

'Monene nigo nkoganyete aye, Nyasae ontonger' omoy' omuya;
Abakogochera tori kobanga, Onsibie bono imbe omorabu.
hymns.refrain: 'Morabu pi, nimb' omorabu, Aye koransibie nimb' omorabu.

hymns.title: Ngocha Nd' Omosalaba
verses:
Ngocha nd' Omosalaba, Inch' Omwor' omouko;
Natigire bi'ens' eye, Ntunyan' Omosalaba.

Nakorereire mono, Nabuirwe n'ebibe;
Yes' otebire bori, "Nindabitinyie bionsi".

Bionsi narur' as'ore, Ribaga ne chinguru;
'Nkoro yane narure, Bibe biao botambe.

Yeso nache naende! Naisanek' as'are,
Ker' oyor' omochenu, Motogie Omotoria.
hymns.refrain:
Nagwanchir' aye Yeso, Eng'ondi ya Kalwari;
Nakunamir' as'ore Onkonye Omotoria.

hymns.title: Omonene Ndigeti' Eke
verses:
Omonene ndigetie eke, Kiagera nakomocheire,
As' omorero n'amache, Onsibie mono kegima.

Koranyoroki' oborori, Ninyare kogoka mono,
Kondabe n' enkor' enchenu, mbuy' ase nde, mbuy' ase nde.

Bun' enkor' ey' er'enchenu, mbe n'oborori obonge;
Naki as'_obogima bwao, Ndor' ebinto ebichenu.

Omonene natemire, gotanga ay'ar'amabe;
Korende tinkonyara pi, gwechena nche omonyene.
hymns.refrain:
Onsibie ime naisiko; Gos' as'omorer' onsibie,
'S' encher' ende yonsi nsibie; 'Bibe bikwe ime yane.

hymns.title: Gwachir' Ase Yeso?
verses:
Gwachir' ase Yes' as'ogosibigwa?
Gwasibigwe n'amanying' aye;
Mbwegenete obuya bwaye bono?
Gwasibigw' as' amanying' aye.

Ngotar' ore botambe n'Omotoria,
Gwasibigwe n' amanying' aye?
Ngotimok' ore as' oyobambetwe,
Gwasibigw' as' amanying'aye?

Chingobo chiao nchirab' Ere kagocha,
chichenek' as'amanying' aye?
Mbwebeke ang'e ase obomenyo,
N'osibigw' as' amanying' aye?

Rusia chingobo chire na ebibe,
Osibigw' as' amanying' Aye?
Ensoko ner' egosibia enkoro,
Osibek' as' amanying' Aye.
hymns.refrain:
'Manyinga y'eng'ondi 'Gwasibekir' as' amanyinga?
Ngobo chiao tichiri na kemoa?
Gwasibigw' as' amanying' aye?

hymns.title: Natayayire Kegima
verses:
Natayayire kegima, Nkoirana nde;
Natebanire ebibe, Nkoirana nde.

Nasiriri 'emiak'emenge, nkoirana nde;
Neitirie n'amariga, Nkoirana nde.

Narosire as' ebibe, Nkoirana nde;
Nyegen' eng'an' obwanchani, Nkoirana nde.

Nakw' ogosemeria kwane, Nkoirana nde;
Ing'a Yes' er' onkwerete, Nkoirana nde.

Ninganeti' amanying' ao, Nkoirana nde;
Onsibie ndabe kegima, Nkoirana nde.
hymns.refrain:
Nkoirana, gocha nka, Intatayaye;
As' obwanchani Bwao, Ong'iranie nka.

hymns.title: 'Motori' Agantebia
verses:
'Motori' agantebia: 'Nguru chia'o chinke,
Renda na gosaba, Nko' ebinto bionsi.

Monene nanyora 'Nguru chiao chioka;
Chionchor' omobe 're n'enkor' enkong'u.

Timbwati ekiya, Ndanyorer' obuya,
Nsibie ngobo yane, S' amanying' eng'ondi.

'Bosio bw'ekerogo, Nintenene buya,
Ebiegwa biane Nimbek' ase Yeso.
hymns.refrain:
Agaakana, esira yonsi, Ebibe bigansiria,
Er' akabisibia.

hymns.title: Yes' As' Omosalaba
verses:
Yes' as' omosalaba, Nensoko engiya
Ekogweni' oborwaire, Korw' ria Kalwari.

Agw' as' omosalaba, Nkanyor' amabera;
'Ng'enang'eni ya mambia, 'Ndaberi' amasaria.

Ang' as' omosalaba, Ng'ondi ya Nyasae
Nkonye ntare botambe, 'S' ekiriria kiao.

Ang' as' omosalaba, Nganye, nsemeretie,
Goika ng'ike ens' eria, As' oroche ng'umbu.
hymns.refrain:
Kalwari, Kalwari, 'Gotogia botambe,
'Nkoro yan' etimoke, As'oroche ng'umbu.

hymns.title: Bionsi Namoeire Yeso
verses:
Bionsi namoeire Yeso, 'Moyo bwonsi narure;
Mwanche amatuko onsi, Meny' asare botambe.

Bionsi namoeire Yeso, Natung'amir' as'ore,
Nyetig' emegoko y'ense, Yeso ng'ire as'ore.

Bionsi namoeire Yeso, Nimb' oyoo botambe;
Tiga nyigwe ay' Omoika, Manye Aye noyone.

Bionsi namoeire Yeso, Bono namororire,
'Mogoko bw'ogotorigwa, Ntogie Erieta riao.
hymns.refrain:
Bionsi as'ore, Bionsi as'ore,
Bionsi as'ore, 'Motoria, Narure bono.

hymns.title: Nosiboke Korwa As' Ebibe
verses:
Nosiboke korwa as'ebibe? 'Manyinga nare ne chinguru,
Nobibue ebib' ore nabio? Amanyinga ye chinguru.

Nosiboke korwa ogochaya? 'Manyinga nare ne chinguru
'Nchw' osibigwe aria Kalwari; Amanyinga' Aye chinguru.

N'ocheneke na koraba mono? 'Manyinga nare ne chinguru
Ebimoa bi'ebibe bisire, Amanying' Aye chinguru.

N'omokorer' Omogambi Yeso? 'Manyinga nare ne chinguru
Kera rituk' aye n'omotogie? Amanying' Aye chinguru.
hymns.refrain:
Ne chinguru chia ogokumia; 'Manyinga y'eng'ondi
Ne chinguru chia ogokumia; As' amanyinga y'eng'ondi.

hymns.title: Nareo Onyanchete
verses:
Nareo onyanchet' agakw' agantoria
Inch' omonyabibe mbe moyo
Nchera Y' omosalab' akerua gotacha
