Bibe biane bionsi biaberwe.

Nig' are omworor' omoremereria
Ogochena enkoro yane,
Tindi na ekina n' omosibore nde,
Kebibe biane biabambirwe.

'Menye as' Omotoria tinkomotiga,
Ntare n' omogoko botambe,
Nintere n'omonwa Goter' as' enkoro,
Ebibe biane biabambirwe.
hymns.refrain:
Bionsi biabambirwe, Bionsi biabambirwe
Agancha ere kobogoria
N'oboror' obonge Yeso anyorete
Kabibogori' ebibe biane.

hymns.title: Kwarosir' Aye?
verses:
Kwarosir' aye na gochandeka? Motebie Yeso, Motebie Yeso;
Gwechander' ayakona goeta? Motebie Yeso bweka.

Nig' okonakoiyeri' amariga? Motebie Yeso, Motebie Yeso;
Nobwate ebibe bia bobisi? Motebie Yeso bweka.

Kwoboire emechand' emenge, Motebie Yeso, motebie Yeso;
Nig'ogwechandera aya ankio, Motebie Yeso bweka.

Nigo kwarengereirie ogokwa? Motebie Yeso, motebie Yeso;
Kwaganiri' obogambi bwa Kristo, Motebie Yeso bweka.
hymns.refrain:
Motebie Yeso, Motebie Yeso; N'omosani 'manyire,
Tori na Mosani onde bun' Ere, Motebie Yeso bweka.

hymns.title: 'Bogima Mbore Omosalaba
verses:
Bogima mbore Omosolaba, Yes'ateba "Ndigererie";
'Nibo y'ense nig' ere bosa, Enibo engiya nase Yeso.

Nkarigereri' Omotoria one, Nere agansasokera;
'Ker' amatemw' agonchichera, Nindigererie Omosalaba.

Ndigereri' Omosalaba rioka, Nyegen' eira ya Nyasae;
Onde takogw' as' amatemwa 'yo bwegenete nguru chia Igoro.
hymns.refrain:
Rigereria Kalwari (rigereria kalwari),
Onyore obogima (onyore obogima);
Obogima bwa bosa (obogima bwa bosa),
Rigereria kalwari (rigereria kalwari rigereria).

hymns.title: Korabe Nyancha Ime
verses:
Korabe nyancha ime as'omwaga,
Aroro okage gwaisire gokwa;
Chaka kobara ebisio obwate,
Nokumie mon' obuya bwa Nyasae.

Korabe kwarosire n'egurube,
Gokwarengereirie kwabuirwe,
Chaka kobara ebiso obwate,
'Mogoko ay' ogotera nonyore.

Ker' okorora enibo y'abande,
Inyor' eira y'enibo ya Kristo,
Bar'ebisi' otagore ne chibesa,
Ng'eria yao nenka ere Igoro.

Igo as'esegi tagoichana,
Nyasa' ere bwanchire gotokonya,
Bar'ebisio 'malaika mbabeo,
Mbagokonye goika omoerio.
hymns.refrain:
Bar' ebisio, 'kemo ekemo,
Many' eki Nyasa' atomire,
Bar' ebisio, 'kemo ekemo,
Nokumie 'buya bwa Nyasae mono.

hymns.title: Namwanchire Yeso Bweka
verses:
Namwanchire Yeso bweka, Naigur' amang'an'
Aye Tinkoiroka gento kende ko namwanchire Yeso.

'Bibe biane moe Yeso 'nsibirie n'amanyinga
Nandende amatuk' onsi 'kong'iki' ase Nyasae.

Bono tinkoiroka kende, 'nkoro yakwegenire
Nchera neba omosunte, Yeso omorekire.

Nkoro namoeire Yeso, nomober' one bwonsi
'Matuk' onsi nanganyete, ang'ire omochi' oye.
hymns.refrain:
Namwanchire, namwanchire nanchir' amang'ana 'ye
Namwanchire, namwanchire nanchir' amang'ana 'ye.

hymns.title: 'Gosemeria Kw' Omokristo
verses:
Gosemeria kw' Omokristo, Kero are ense,
Koremia enkoro buya, Ense y' obororo,
Koremia enkoro buya, Ense y'obororo.

Gotworokia ens' engiya, 'Baya baramenye.
Toumerane n'abaya. Totatananeke,
Toumerane n'abaya. Totatananeke.

Ens' ebibe bitachiche, Amatemwa taiyo,
Omogoko nomenyeo, Otaere rinde,
Omogoko nomenyeo, Otaere rinde.

Amariga takobao, Amakweri taiyo,
Abamenyi bagwekane Abamalaika,
Abamenyi bagwekane Abamalaika.

Amatuko era bwango, 'Motoria nchwo bwango,
Ntoganetie gokorora, Buna re aye,
Nagoika nka Igoro, Enka y'omogoko.

hymns.title: 'Mbura Netwe Korwa   Igoro
verses:
'Mbura netwe korwa_igoro, Neira y'obwanchani;
Eyekomenta chinguru, chikorw' as' Omotoria.

"Mbura netwe korwa Igoro" Ekobokia chinkoro;
'S' amagoko n'ebitunwa, 'riogi ri'embur'enyinge.

"Mbura netwe korwa Igoro" 'Monene toyetwerie;
Erio tonyore chinguru, Oikeranie eira.

"Mbura netwe korwa Igoro" Tagototweria rero!
Twatore amamoch' aito, Tokorangerie Yeso.
hymns.refrain:
Mbura y'ebisio, nero ntwe toganetie;
Nonya gwatoir'amabera, ko nembura twasaba.

hymns.title: Kemechando Eragoetanane
verses:
Kemechando eragoetanane,
'nchera 'sobosio bwao nomosunte;
'Borabu bosesenirie na Yeso:
Koraborore nobue amatemwa.

Nony'aye tomanyeti egurube,
'Chandete bogima bwao as' ense;
Beka omosalaba bosio bwao:
Mwegene Yes' ase chinchera chionsi.

Genda nokwegen'obu' amatemwa,
Manya Yeso 'motoria nkomo more;
'Segi neb' enkong'u tokwa omoyo:
'Motori' orire eira yobobui.

'Segi neba ndoro yogoichania,
'Matemwa amanene arakobue;
'Monene ng'ang' ar' akoe chinguru:
Chiokobua 'matemwa 'racha 'sore.
hymns.refrain:
Rora 'borabu bokobara,
Oborabu boseri' obwoba;
Rora Yeso 'mosunt' otame:
Omwegene Yeso ng'ang' ar' as'ore.

hymns.title: 'Ker' Arache
verses:
Ker'arache, 'Ker' arache 'sangereri_abaye;
Abare abana baye, Abanchwa baye.

Nasangereri' Ere bwango, Abanchw' as' obonda;
Chilulu 'kobara mono Abanchwa baye.

Abana bonsi abake, 'Banchet' Omotoria;
Nabwo chilulu chingiya, Abanchwa baye.
hymns.refrain:
Buna ching'enang'eni, mbarab' as' egutwa
Bamekameke buya, 's' egutwa yaye.

hymns.title: 'Nkoro Yao Yamigirwe
verses:
Nkoro yao yamigirwe, 'baga ndiy' ase Yeso?
Gwasibirwe n'ebi' ense, 'baga ndiy' ase Yeso?
Ngesieri ateneine, Gotur' omoigorere,
Igwa ngosoror' are, 'baga ndiy' ase Yeso?

Gwasiria nsa chingiya, chiogokor' emeremo?
Nakoe chinguru, chiogokor' emeremo,
Takobugwa nebibe, bakony' abasaririe,
Barigie abasiru, Kae Yeso ribaga.

Ay' okorigi' ebi' ense, Kae Yeso ribaga;
Tori na_ibaga rinde, Komokorera Yeso,
Emegoko n' enibo, Ebinto bi' ense mbosa,
Gwechand' as' okwegokia, kae Yeso ribaga.

hymns.title: Engaki Engiya Mono
verses:
Engaki_ engiya mono, Bachenu bacha amo;
K'Omotori' ar' eganga, 'Kero bakomotera.

Totere obwanchani, bwamosugetie Tata
Aroch' ens' etaraba, Akamoru' Omwan' oye.

Ter' ogwancha kw' Omwana, bun' atigete igoro;
Akaba buna tore, Agakwa atotorie.

Obwanchani bw' Omoika, kwororobia chinkoro;
Kero tware nobwoba, Gatoa Omotoria.

Engaki engiya mono, 'Bachenu baumerane;
Yeso nabe eganga, Bamotere botambe.

hymns.title: 'Monen' Omobas' One
verses:
Monen' Omobas' one, nki ndairoke?
Mobaso, botuko nare nainche;
Ner' ogontoria korw' as' emechando,
Nogosorora kw' Omoik' aretire.

Monen' Omobas'one, 'mare nacha
As' okwegena, nindore igoro
'Se Yes' Akogamba as' obonene,
Naki ndatigar' Omosunte ime.

Monen' Omobas' one, 'nguru chiane,
Ase chinguru chiaye nimbue;
'Maber' atubir' oboreu bwane,
'S' okwegena ntare nere ker'ensa.

Monen' Omobaso; mbionsi ase nde
As' are ere mosunte toiyo;
N' Omobori'Omogambi one,
Nche ninkobake n' abachenu bande.
hymns.refrain:
Monen' Omobaso' one, 'mogok' one;
'Mobaso'botuk'ere nandae
'Monen'Omobaso, 'mogok'one
'Mobaso na botuko nandae

hymns.title: Yeso Nkwegenete
verses:
Yeso nkwegenete, 'Manwa ya Kalwari, Omotoria;
'Gw' ogosaba bono, Onsibie ebibe, Mb' Oyoo kegima korwa rero.

Buya bwa' obonge, bomente chinguru, 'Nkoro yane;
Buna gwankwerete, bwanchani as'ore, Bob' obochenu pi bore moyo.

Naetananire, ime y' emechando, Ay' ondae;
Seria Omosunte, Ontinyi' amariga, Tontiga ntayaye korw' as' ore.

hymns.title: Tat 'O Igoro Namanyete
verses:
Tat'O Igoro namanyete, 'Merind'eratange nchera;
Naserie chitang'utangu, 'Mosunt'obe omobaso,

Tat'O Igoro namanyete, 'Riogo rikogweni' obobe;
N 'ogokuna kw'obwanchani, Agweni'enkor'eye yane, Agweni'enkor'eye yane.

Tat'O Igoro namanyete, Buna ntabu' ababisa;
Narend' Okwegena kwane, Andende goik'omoerio, Andende goik'omoerio.

Tat'O Igoro namanyete, K'orogendo rokoera;
Tiga eker'ekio Tata, Ntoke nyebiset' as'ore, Ntoke nyebiset' as'ore.
hymns.refrain:
'Mosunt'obe omobaso. Omanyir' emerind'erantangen nchera;
(Omanyire, ekeen' emerind'erantang' enchera yane)
Omanyire, Atang' embeo kogusa,
(Omanyire, ekeene, Atange embeo ekogusa).

hymns.title: Nimba Omobe Mono
verses:
Obwanchani bwa Yeso, Botambe gochia igoro
Bwaetania chindiba, Boreo korwa kare,
'Bwanchani bwanyorete, 'Kero nche nasirete.

hymns.title: Nche Ninkoganetie
verses:
Nche ninkoganetie, 'Kero gionsi
Riogi rinde ndiri, Ri'omorembe.

Nche ninkoganetie, Omber' ang'e
'Matemwa tambua, Ker' or' ang'e.

Nche ninkoganetie 'S' obororo
Nchwo bwang' obe nainche, 'Rio tinsira.

Nche ninkoganetie, Onyorokie,
Ne chiira chiao, Kor' ase nde.

Nche ninkorigetie, Omochenu
Onkore mb'oyoo, Yes' omuya.
hymns.refrain:
Yeso nakorigirie, Nkorigetie rioka
Nsesenie Omotoria, Nagocheire.

hymns.title: Ekero Nkoba n'Omorembe Nchera
verses:
Ekero nkoba n'omorembe nchera,
'Bororo bun' emerindo 'Se kende gionsi aye kwanyorokirie,
Goteba nga Mbuy' as' enkoro.

Nonya Saitani naisa gontema,
Ninyeremie ekiagera Kristo ororir' obwororo bwane,
Okure as' ebibe biane.

'Bibe biane bionsi gose tai bike,
Biabambirw' Omosalaba Tinkoragererigwa as'ebibe, Motogi' Omonen' Omoy'one.

Omonen' ayereri' ogocha kwao,
'Goro rioba ndimanoke, 'Konu nebug' ogocha Kw' Omonene,
Nonyaigo mbuya as'enkoro.
hymns.refrain:
Imbuya. . . 'S'enkoro;
Imbuya Imbuy' as' enkoro.

hymns.title: Gotara Na Yeso
verses:
Gotara na Yeso, as' eriarakwane,
Enchera yaito morekire; Gokor' ayanchete,
Namenye naintwe, Na baria, bonsi baregene.

Ntori n'omusunte, Nony' amare taiyo,
Ere bweka obirusirie; 'Tang'utang'u nchiyo,
Nonya n'amariga, Gatoregene na Koigwera.

Ntori n'egurube, n'obororo bwonsi,
'Meremo yait' atoakane; Emechando teiyo,
n'ogweitia nkoiyo, Nogosesenia 'S' okoigwera.

Titokoenekia, obwanchani bwaye,
Goika twerure Kegima; As'ogwanchereria,
n'omogok' arure, Nebiab' abaramoigwere.

As' okobwatana, toikarans' as'are,
Gose totare amo nere; Kor'ekiaratebe,
Gend'as' arachike, Toirok' egene, n'oigwere.
hymns.refrain:
Okwegena, encher' ende teiyo;
Y'omogok' ase Yeso: Egene oigwere.

hymns.title: Mbuya Komwegena Yeso
verses:
Mbuya komwegena Yeso,
Ase ring'ana riaye, "Gwanch' eira na komanya"
Otebir' Omonene.

O mbuya kwegena Yeso,
'S' amanying' agosibia, 'S' okwegena nantobeke,
'S' amanying' okogwenia.

Mbuya komwegena Yeso,
ntig'ebibe kegima, 'Se Yeso nyor'obogima,
motimoko mogoko.

Nagokire nkwegenete,
'Muya Yes' Omosani, Namanyire nobe nainche,
Nobe nainche botambe.
hymns.refrain:
Yeso naki mwegenete, Moenekie botambe;
Yeso, Yes' Omuya Yeso, Nimente komomanya.

hymns.title: Naki Yes' Ar'omosani
verses: Naki Yes' ar' Omosani, Koimoki'ebibe biato! Ngesio ki koa Nyasae, Bionsi as'ogosaba; Morembe ki togosiria Birukunyo twaimokia, 'Kiagera titomoeti Nyasae' as'ogosaba.
Gose ntore n'amatemwa? Mochando nore ande? Ntokw' omoyo toirere, Monen' as' ogosaba; Ntonyor' Omosani omuya, Torasang' obororo Yes' omanyir' oboreu, Moe as' ogosaba.
Ntor' aboro n'egurube, Gochandwa n'okogania; 'Motoria nobotamero, Moe as' ogosaba Basani mbagotamire? Motebi' as'ogosaba Nakoagat' agokenge, Nonyor' omosasoko.

hymns.title: 'Monene Tari Ebi'Ankio
verses:
'Monene tari ebi'ankio, Ingosaba
Nyasae ndende timocha, Rero, rioka
Nkonye nkore emeremo, na gosaba
Nkwane na oboitingo, Rero Tata.
Tinkor' okogania kwane,'mwango koigwa Onkonye inyare koigwa, Rero Tata Tinkwana ayar'amabe, Bwango bwango  Mbata ebikoba biane, Boire pi.

Kero kende mb'omokiru, kende ngoke
Nyengene obuya bwao, Rero Tata
Monene tari ebi'ankio ingosaba
Ndende, ondae, Onyache, Boire pi.

hymns.title: Monen' Omorisia
verses:
Monen' Omorisia tikoremerwa;
Antimokia'as'obonyansi obobese
Ondair' ensemoamacn'amaya
Nigo akong'irania na komboria.

Ning'et' ase rigoko ri' amakweri
Aye nomorendi,tindi n'obwoba;
Nondisie n'nyimbobuyakegima
Tinkoba n'obobe Kor'amo nainche

hymns.title: Rigi' Ob' Omochenu
verses:
Rigi'ob'omochenu, 'Kwane na Nyasae,
'Be Nere na koria, ring'an riaye;
Okor' obosani, okony' aboro,
'Tari kweba kende, origi' ebisio.

Rigi' ob' omochenu, 'Nse nkoagag' ere,
Obe aye bweka, Amo na Yeso;
Komoroche Yeso, Nomogwekane,
'Banto mbamorore, 'Se chimbwa chiao.

Rigi' ob omochenu, 'B' Omorai oo,
Tomotang'anera kende na keba;
'Mogok', obororo, Mobwatie Yeso,
Komoroche Yeso, 'Ncha ng'ana Yaye.

Rigi' ob'omochenu, Otoerere,
Ebirengererio, biragwe Nere;
Oragwe n'Omoika, As'obwanchani,
Bwango nogwenere, 'Meremo Igoro.

hymns.title: Igwa Amang'ana A Yeso
verses:
Igwa amang'ana a Yeso,
'Mang'an' obogima bori
Otari gosaba, igwa inyora,
Basesenigw' abagokora.

Koigwa bosa nkori kende,
Chiira nachibe bosa
Kobigwa, kwoboa, mbigototoria,
Basesenigw' abagokora.

Baso' omochie n'omogoko,
Abachenu abasera
Basibekire bare n'obonene,
Barie Omote bw'obogima.
hymns.refrain:
Ababwatete amachik' Aye,
Mbare negesio negesio
Ababwetete amachik' Aye,
Mbuya, mbuya, mbuya bare.

hymns.title: Tar' Enchera Y'Omonene
verses:
Tar' enchera y'Omonene,
'Korae botambe Omoik' oye korwa igoro, Oseri' omosunte

Tar' omobaso bw'Enjili, okorwa igoro
Okorae kor'omoke, 'Mwegeni o Nyasae

Tar' omobaso, 'mosunte, Noribia boeto;
Omosunte norasire Emiaka n'emiaka.

Tar' omobaso omanye, Nyasa'
Omwanchani; Obwanchani nabokine, Igoro bokume.
hymns.refrain:
Tar' enchera, Tar' enchera
(Tara a,se oborabu bwa Nyasae,
Tara ase oborabu bwa Nyasae)
Tar' enchera (Tara ase oborabu bwa Nyasae)
Tar' enchera ya Nyasae.

hymns.title: And'onsi Na Yeso
verses:
And'onsi na Yeso nigo ndagende,
Karantang'an' and'onsi as'ens'eye;
Mogoko tori Monene ataiyo,
And'onsi na Yeso tindi nche bweka.

And'onsi na Yeso tindi nche bweka,
Basani mbantiga Ere noyone;
Karanda' ase chinchera chinkong'u,
And'onsi nimosasime' Omotoria.

And'onsi na Yeso ningende ndare,
'Mosunte nimoinyore Omonene;
Tingosira korwa enchera yaye,
And'onsi na Yeso nimenye n'Ere.
hymns.refrain:
And'onsi, and'onsi tindi kwoboa,
And'onsi na Yeso nigo ndagende.

hymns.title: Yeso N'Omosani Omuya
verses:
Yeso n'Omosani omuya, Ekero okobugwa n'ense Nakogwenie omoyo,
Nagokoa chinguru Yeso n'Omosani omuya.
Yeso n'Ornosani obuete! Andemia na kong' omorembe; Ambwate n'okoboko, Tinkoiroka kende, Yeso n'Omosani omuya.
Nimba nomoichan' omonge, Nonya namakweri nachicha, Tinkoigwa kende, Omotoria ng'ang' are Yeso n'Omosani_omuya.
hymns.refrain:
Yeso nomosani omuya (Yes' omosani, Omosani omuya)
Yeso nomosaniomuya (Yes' omosani, Omosani ornuya)
Nagokonye gokogwa, Nakoigwe gokorangeria Nomosani_obuete bonsi.

hymns.title: Kae' Mbeo' Bwoba
verses:
Kae'mbeo 'bwoba, Rema osemeria,
Tat'omanyir' obororo, Nakoimoki igoro.

Goet' emechando, 'Koroseri' enchera,
Gany' engaki yaye botuko bob' omobaso.

Tiger' Omonene anche na gochika
Motayayi nob'oyoye, Ere nomong'aini.

Ogosemia kwaye, nokonene mono
Gakorire emerem' eyio yakwoboetie.

hymns.title: Yes' Omorisi' Oito
verses:
Yes' Omorisi' oito, Otokwerete,
Gaiter' amanyinga, 'Se ker' eng'ondi
Ker' eyem' abeka, Kemanyererio;
'Tebir'''Ab' Omoika, Abwo nabane".

hymns.title: Ens' Engiya Y'ogosaba
verses:
Ens' engiya y'ogosaba,
Kondusi' ense y'emechando
Nakong'ira ase Tata, Motebie kogania kwane
Ekero nde n'obororo, Moy'on'onyor' okoremia
Erio mbua omotemi, Ens' engiya y'ogosaba.

Ense engiya y'ogosaba,
Ira gosorora kwane Gochi' as' Ere omwegenwa,
Oyokoru' ogosesenia
'Ntebirie morigererie, Nyegene 'Ng'ana n'obuya
Nimoe ker' ogwechanda, Nganyet' Ensa y'ogosaba.

Ens' engiya y'ogosaba,
Nyore okoremia kwao Korw' egetunwa gia Pisga,
Ndor'enka yane ndagende 'S' obogima nintenene,
Mbwat' ekeegwa gia kare Ng'ak' eriogi as' embeo, "Mbuya Ensa y'ogosaba".

hymns.title: 'Nsa Ngiya Y'ogosaba
hymns.refrain:
Ensa engiya, Nsa y'ogosaba,
Riogo as'Omorosu, O mbuya kobao.

hymns.title: Ningotunye Omotoria
verses:
Ningotunye Omotoria, And' ons' as' okong'ira
As' ogochia ninkobwatie, Monene ningotunye.

Nonya n'enchera erembe, Bun'emerindo nyancha
Gwatang'anire enchera, N'omogoko ngotunye.

Nimba n'emechand' emenge, Nintemwa mono mono
Nainyoir' Aye ngwatemetwe, 'S' omochengo ngotunye.

Nimba n'oboror' obonge, Ntigire omotaka
Nomanyet' emechand'ense, Nindigetie ngotunye.

Ning'eta as' amatemwa, Aye nig'okondaa
Ngwaetet' as' emechando, Nche ningotunye rioka.
hymns.refrain:
Ningotunye Omotoria, Ogankwer' as' omote
Banto bonsi mbagotiga, S'obuya ningotunye.

hymns.title: Ntererie Riok' Abaminto
verses:
Ntererie riok'abaminto,
Mang'an' obogima Ndore obosera bwaye,
Mang'an' obogima Amang'an' amaya,
Nyegeri' okwegena.

Yes 'omuya otoeire,
Mang'an'obogima Monyabibe tegerera,
Mang'an' obogima Otoeire bosa,
Tong'uswe gochia nka.

Tiga bono toyarandie,
Mang'an' obogima 'Korua kwabera,
Morembe, Mang'an' obogima
Yeso Omoboria, Tochene botambe.

hymns.title: Buna Nde
verses:
Tindi na egetamero, Manying'ao 'ngitekera,
Gwantebirie nchich' as'or' Eng'ondi ya Nyasae, Nchiche.

Buna nde intaganyeti Gwetinyi 'Omoy'on' ekebe,
Manyingao 'tinyi 'ebibe Eng'ondi ya Nyasae, Nchiche.

Buna nde nkorutwarutwa, Nechitang'u tang'u chionsi,
'Segi ime bwoba 'sik 'Eng'ondi ya Nyasae, Nchiche.

Nd'Omotaka omouko, Kogweni' ebirengererio,
Nakwo nganetie as'or' Eng'ondi ya Nyasae, Nchiche.

Buna nde Aye nong'ire, Ondosi 'onyaber 'onsibie,
Negenir'eira yao Eng'ondi ya Nyasae, Nchiche.

Buna nde Bwanchani bwao, Bwatagoire Ker'etoto,
Bono mb'oyoo kegim' Eng'ondi ya Nyasae, Nchiche.

hymns.title: Naigw'eriogi Riao
verses:
Naigw'eriogi riao, Kondangeria nchiche,
Nsibigwe n'amanyinga o 'Tegete Kalwari.

Nonya nche nd'omworo, nomente chinguru,
Nonsibi 'obobe bwane pi, Goika mb'omochenu.

Yeso ondangeirie, mb'omoikeranu,
Gosemeria n'omorembe, As'ense ya Igoro.

Goker'amanyinga Buya bw'okoboria,
Gokera Yes'Ekeegwa, Oboronge bwaito.
hymns.refrain:
Ngochand' as'ore, Ngochande bono,
Onsibi' as' amanyinga, 'Tegete Kalwari.

hymns.title: Nche Nomwan' Oo
verses:
Nche nomwan' oo kwandangeirie, Many'obwanchani bwao;
Ko nindigetie as'okwegena, Kong'uswa ang'e n' Aye.

Onchene bono as' emeremo, 'S' okobua kw'obuya;
Nkogaramer' erio ngosemerie, Kogania kob' as'ore.

Mogoko bw'engaki er'enk 'as'ore, As 'ekerogo kiao;
'Kero nkogosaba Nyasae One, Nkwana bun' omosani.

N'obwanchani_obonge nche ntamanye, Goika ng'amboke nyancha;
Noreo mogoko nche ntamanye, Goika ntimok 'as'ore.
hymns.refrain:
Ng'usa ang'e (ang'e) ang' Omonene, ase gwatokwerete;
Ng'usa ang'e, ang'e, ang' Omonene, Nimbe naye botambe.

hymns.title: Ira Ense Yonsi Ong'e Yeso
verses:
Ira ense yonsi ong'e Yes' omogoko one;
'Bwanchani bwaye tibori Goonchoka nonya ng'ake.

Ira ense yonsi ong'e Yes' Omoremia one;
Omotoria karandende, Ninter' as' emechando.

Ira ense ong'e Yeso Ndor' omosasok' oye;
Ase orogendo rwane, Amoreker' enchera.

Ira ense yonsi ong'e Yes' Omosalab' one;
Goik' Omonene ogocha, Morore as' obosio.

hymns.title: Ir'obogima Bwane
verses:
Ir'obogima bwane, Bochene bob'obwao,
Ir'amaboko naro 'kore bun'origetie.

Ira amagor'ane, 'B' amang' as'emeremo,
Ira n'eriogi riane, Nter'ase Nyasae oka.

Ir' ebikoba biane, Bikwan' ay'origetie,
Ir'amo n'echinibo, Tindigetie kobisa.

Ira chingaki chiane, Chikobake botambe,
Ir'obong'aini bwane, Korer' ay'origetie.

Ira Ogwancha kwane, Gokore kob'okwao,
Ira n'enkoro yane, Eb'obomenyo bwao.

Ir' obwanchani bwane, Nib' as'amagor'ao,
Ir' omobere bwensi, noyoo bono bori.
hymns.refrain:
Nsibi' as'amanying 'Omotoria (Manying'aye),
Nsibi' as' amanying' agochena (Agochena),
'Monene narure bionsi as'ore,
Bib'ebiao botambe.

hymns.title: Ens'enyia Y'Omwando
verses: Yes' Omonene, Er'otoriereir' eira; Eira y'obomeny' Atoroseirie aria Igoro;' Mochie bw'abaya, Enka y'omwando twaeirwe; As'ebibe n'emechando n'amakweri bitabe.
As'ens'eyi'enyia, Botuko mbokob'aroro; Yeso ner'orab'omobaso irumbe ritatube; 'Botaka mboiyo, gose kende kiogoichania; Tomenye nomorembe N'Omotori'oito botambe
Ntoumerane n'abasani twatiganete; Baria bonsi bararet'ase Yeso nababeo;  Ne chintakana nchinyor'abaibori babo; 'Bororo bw'amakweri titokoboinyora rinde.
'Basani baito, rigereria bosio rioka; Intwe nabaeti, bamint'ens'eye teri seito;  Titweb'eira, Y'ense Yes'Atoroseirie; Intwe n'abanyamwando b'obogima botakoera.

hymns.title: Ong'use Ang'e N'aye Tata
verses:
Ong'use ang'e n'Aye Tata, Nganeti' onyagate,
Ang'e ase amabok'ao, Nyare gotimoka.

Ong'use ang'e Omotoria, Timba inche bweka,
Ombwate n'okoboko kwao, Erio nintimoke.

Ong'us' as' Omoik' omuya, Erio nkogwekane;
Onsibie, onchene, nindabe, Goika mbe omuya.
hymns.refrain:
Ong'use n'obwanchani, (Ong'us' ong'use n'obwanchani),
Ng'us' ang'e, Igor'as'ore (Ong'us n'obwanchani, Goch'as'ore Igoro,)
Ng'usa ange Gocha as'ore.

hymns.title: Aye Nobe Buna Yeso
verses:
Aye nobe buna Yeso Omochenu pi? Notare n'Ere nchera enyerere?
Aye nomoe chigurube chiao chionsi? Ancha agotang'ane.

Nabwanche agosibore omotunyane? Nomanyete omoremb' okonyora?
Nabwanche agokony' erio tocha gosira? Ancha agotang'ane.
Nonyore obomenyo as' obonda Bwaye? Nabwanche komanya chinguru Chiaye? Botambe nokor' emeremo ne chinguru? Ancha agotang'ane.
hymns.refrain:
Chinguru chiaye nchibe as'ore, Amanyinga aye nagosibie;
Obwanchani Bwaye nobonyore, Ng'a mbuya, bwanche akorae bo.

hymns.title: Yes' Omosalaba One
verses: Yes' omosalaba one, Bono naywetwekire; Ngotunyan' Omonen' one, Natigir' ebiens' eye.  Tindengererete_enibo, Enibo y' ense eye: Inche nomonguru' as'ore, Monyamwando o Nyasae.
Nonya ngochandek' ens' eye Ningaramere Yeso; 'Mechando neba emenge, Nindemereri' as'ore.  Emechando teri gento, Ninde n' obuya bwao, Nairaneirie mbuya mono, Ninyore bions' as'ore.
'Nkoro ira obogima, 'Konyek' amatuk' onsi; Obue ebibe n'obwoba, Gendereria emeremo,  'Moika nore as'ore, N' Obwanchani bwa Tata, Omotoria nere oyoo, Ogokweret' omote.
Oyominto ayerera, Bweboe okwegena, Bwebo' ebinto bi'esegi, Toraika ense enyia;  Yeso nomotang'ani oo, Sab' asare botambe, 'Ker' oraike Igoro, Nomogok' omonene.

hymns.title: Nanchire Koba Omwan' Oye
verses:
Nanchire koba omwan' oye; Imanye enchera;
Nkor' emeremo y' Omotoria, Onkonye bono.

'Nibo y'ense ig' ere bosa, Otari aroro;
Natigire bionsi kegima, Naye enibo.

Kondatugut' ebinto bi'ense, Ika ang'e nainche;
Ebigochia kare as'ore, Binkonye inche.
hymns.refrain:
Noyoo (Yeso), Noyoo (Yeso), Noyoo eye neira;
Noyoo (Yeso), Noyoo (Yeso), Noyoo nde kegima.

hymns.title: Okogacherwa Yeso
verses: "Okogacherwa Yeso," Na nguru chia Nyasae Ndendwe korw' ebimoa, Ntare buna Yeso.
"Okogacherwa Yeso," Nkore bun' anchete Imbe oyoye bori, nkore emeremo.
"Okogacherwa Yeso," Ngachwe korwa ense Moitongo as' omoika, Mochenu as' enkoro.
"Okogacherwa Yeso," Nimb' oyoye bori Mbe oyoye botambe, Mbe oyoye bweka.
hymns.refrain: Ndendwe as' Omonene, Ngw' as' amagor' Aye Tingwenereti, kende, kende, Obe bionsi_Ase nde.

hymns.title: Bono Ngocha Nde
verses: Natayayire ar'Omonene, Bono ngocha nde nka;  Nganetie ng'irane as'obuya, Bono ngocha nde nka.
Narosire n'ens'eye y'ebibe, Bono ngocha nde nka;  Omotoria nang'ariganie nka, Bono ngocha nde nka.
'Manyir' Omotoria nantimokie, Bono ngocha nde nka; Ko nganetie gotimok'as'are, Bono ngocha nde nka.
Nasabire nonya nobosomba, Bono ngocha nde nka;  Gicha nyor'obuya bw'Omotoria, Bono ngocha nde nka.
Togi'Omonene Omotori'one, Bono ngocha nde nka; 'Ganyet'ang'ariganie nch'omobe, Bono ngocha nde nka.
hymns.refrain: Ee ngocha nde, Tata ngocha nde, Bono ngocha nde nka; Ee ngochande, Tata ngocha nde, Bono ngocha nde nka.

hymns.title: Kwarure Ebinto Bionsi Ekeng'wanso?
verses:
Kwaganirie omorembe, n'okwegena, Gwasabire as'ogweitia?
Kotogotimoka; gos'osesenigwe, Goika bono bweru'ekeng'wanso.

Nobe n'Omonene 'se Ringana riaye, Obe n'omoremb 'oisaneke;
Korer'ogochika, Ob'omochenu pi, Oru'ebiao bionsi ekeng'wanso.
Titokomany' eki Omonen 'atoeire, As'ebisi'ebi twasabire.  Mebere, chinkoro, goik 'abigambere, Bionsi torue as'ekeng'wanso.

Mbori gotebek' obwanchani-atoeire, Chinkoro chiaito na chigoke,
'Buya bw'ogosanga tosange Nere, Gatwarure bionsi_ekeng'wanso.
hymns.refrain:
Kwarure ebinto bionsi ekeng'wanso? Omoika ngokoraa Are?
Norasesenigwe, onyor'omorembe, Koramo' omobere n'enkoro.

hymns.title: Buna Nde Nachire as'ore
verses: Buna nde nachir' as'ore, Inche tingwekor' omuya  'Manyinga oka ngosaba, Ntorie as' amaber' ao.
Buna nde ko namanyire, "Manyinga ok' aisanire"  Gonsibia ndabe kegima, Erio nkwegene kegima.
Buna nde nachire rero, "Moy'one okorereire" Tinkomenya are naye, Noyoo nganetie koba.
Nkoro yane n' obogima, Gotimoka nyor' as'ore  Gantayayete ndosete, "Ntimok 'obwanchani bwao".
hymns.refrain:
Buna (Buna inde), inde (Buna inde)
Buna nde nachir' as'ore (Buna inde)
Nyingw 'Onsesenie onkonye,
Buna nde nachir' as'ore.

hymns.title: Tata Nachire As' Ore
verses: Tata nachire as'ore, Nay' ogotoreka, Korantige inche bweka, Kai nche ndagende?
Nanchire Omwana oo, Ng'a chinguru chiao, Ong'isanekie na bionsi, As'engaki eye.
Omochaki bw'okwegena, Nakorigereirie, Nyore ekeegwa kiao, kebe obogima.
Togontiga inche nsire, Kwana erio menye, Ntimoke ntari korosa, Goik'ong' Omoik' oo.
Nak_Omoy'on 'oragoke, Kondakoror' aye, Tiga nyigw'eriogi riao, Nyaberw' as' obuya.
hymns.refrain: Namanyire, negenire, Yes' Otokwerete, As' omote amanyinga, Akang'itekera.

hymns.title: O Yeso Narire Eira
verses: Yeso narir' Eira, Kogokorera, 'Kabe nainche', Botambe, 'Monen' omosani. Tinkoiroka esegi, Korabe ase nde, Tinkorw' as' enchera, 'ker'orantang'ane.
Nkoigwe ang'e ase nde, Ense ng'ang'e ere, Tindi korora buya, "Mariogi agontema", Babisa ng'ang'e bare, Bang'etananire, O Yeso inchwo ang'e, Ntange korw'ebibe.
'Yeso kwarir'eir 'as 'abakogotunya' Agw'or' as' obonene, Mosomb'oo nabe, Yeso narir' Eira, Kogokorer' Aye, Ng'obuya 'nkobwatie, 'Monen' omosani.

hymns.title: Tokwan' Amang'an' Amabe
verses: Tokwan' amang'an' amabe Korw' oromeme rwao; 'Nkoro eyarengererie Atararwa omonwa.
'Bwanchani obochenu mono, Amo n' obosani bo; 'Boriri bw' egek' egeke 'Go borasarie bionsi.
'Mang'an' amabe namango Na ebirengererio; 'Kegosaria obosani Ring'an' erimo ribe.
hymns.refrain: 'Anchana inwe', Er'otebire; "Bana igw'amachiko a Tata" 'Anchana inwe', Er'otebire; Abana igw' amachiko.

hymns.title: Ondaire, Ondaire
verses:
Ondaire, ondaire, n'amang'ana
y'okoremia, Ase onsi ense eye,
Omonene ondaire.

'Kero kende nomobaso, 'Kero
kende nomosunte; S'amache na ase
ense, Omonene ondaire.

Tinkonyara gotogonya, As'
emeremo ndaegwe, Ekiagera
namanyire, Omonene ondaire.

Koyaerir' emeremo, Konabuire
ebibe, Nony'ogokwa tinkoiroka,
Omonene ondaire.
hymns.refrain:
Ondaire, ondaire, Omonene ondaire
Nokoboko kwaye igo, Omonene ondaire.

hymns.title: Ang'e N' Aye Nyasae
verses:
Ang'e n'Aye Nyasae, Ang'e kobua,
Omonene one, Ang'e kobua.
Amatuko onsi, Nimbe Ang'e naye,
Ang'e n'aye Nyasae, Ang'e kobua.

Nonya nagendire 'Mosunte_ime,
Nay' obotamero Emiaka yonsi.
Ase okorota nindigetie koba
Ang'e naye Nyasae, Ang'e kobua.

Bionsi Aye kwang'eire, N'amaber' ao,
'Malaika bonsi Bandangeirie,
Korwa ense eye, As'ore Igoro,
Ang'e n'aye Nyasae, Ang'e kobua.

Ne chinguru chiane, Ninkobake,
Egetare kiane Kia obuya.
Emechando yonsi, Twaretir' as'ore;
Ang'e naye Nyasae Ang'e kobua.

hymns.title: Ekerengererio Kiang'iranereire
verses: Ekerengererio, Kiang'iranereire; Naikire ang'e na seito, Kobua riria kare.
Ang'e nka ya Tata, 'S'obomeny' obonge; Ase Yeso akogamba, Nyancha y'ekerore.
Ang'e goika seito, Ntore chigurube; K'emechando yaerire, Mbek'egutw' engiya.
hymns.refrain: Ang'e seito, Ang'e seito; Ang'e seito rero, rero, Kobuariria kare.

hymns.title: Goika Nche Mbe N'Omotoria
verses: Goika nche mbe n'Omotoria, Tingotara nche bweka, 'Moigwe ore ang'e nainche' Mabok' ay' amboanie.
Goika nche mbe n'Omotoria, 'Kiagera nd'omoreu; Nanyare kong' oboremu, Ond' atanyare bori.
Goika nche mbe n'Omotoria, As' orogendo rwane; 'S'emechando n'as'obuya, Nonya nase chisegi.
Goika nche mbe n'Omotoria, Ab'Omorai nchera; Goika ngik' ekiambokero, Nsoe as' ens' eri' enyia.
hymns.refrain:
Moy'one tokwoboa (tokwoboa), 'S' arandae ningende (ningende)
Gose tinkwemurungania, Mbwatie chinchera chiaye.

hymns.title: Omotoria Ondaire
verses: Omotoria ondaire; Ninki rende mborire? Tinkoba na tang'utangu, Ere n'Omorai_one; Nere okong'a omorembe, Nimenye ime Yaye; Kende nagecha ase nde, Ere nandende buya; Kende nagecha ase. nde, Ere nandende buya.

Omotoria ondaire, Nony' enchera er' embe; "Ng'obuy' ekero ngotemwa", Ndagera y'obogima; Kondagochwe amagoro, Na korang'a kegima;
Korwa ase egetare, Narorire ensoko; Korwa ase egetare, Narorire ensoko.

Omotoria ondaire, As'obwanchani Bwaye! Ninyore ogotimoka, As'omochie o Tata; 'Kero keria ndabokigwe, 'Moerio bw'orogendo,
Nyare gotera botambe: Yeso ndae enchera; Nyare gotera botambe: Yeso ndae enchera.

hymns.title: Nda' Omonene Yehova
verses: Nda' Omonene Yehova, 'Moeti bwens' ey' embe, Nd' omworo, Ay' Omonguru, mbwate as'okoboko, Endagera ya Igoro, Ondagerie nyigote, (nyigote) Ondagerie nyigote.
Tubora Ensok' engiya, 'Sok' Amach' okogwenia, Tiga rire ri'omorero, Rinda' as' orogendo,  Omoboria Omonguru, Obe chinguru chiane, (chinguru) Obe eng'aya yane.
Ngoik' engegu ya Yordani, Osiri' obwoba bwane, Ong'etie as'omorindo, Ng'ike ng'umbu Kanani; Amatera y'okobaka, Ningoterere Aye, (Aye)  Ningoterere Aye, Amen.

hymns.title: Nkonyeget' Ase Yeso
verses:
Nkonyeget' ase Yeso, 'S' egekuba kiaye,
Gakonyoroki' ogwancha, Nintimok' omoyo.
'Gw' eriogi ri' amalaika, Banterera buya,
Bitii bi' obonene, 'Nyancha y'ekerore.

Nkonyeget' ase Yeso, Korwa
ogwechanda, Korw' amatemwa y'ense, 'Bibe
mbikombua. Tinkoba n'obororo, 'Bwoba,
tang'uang'u; Amatemwa make Igo, 'Mariga
make igo!
hymns.refrain:
Nkonyeget' ase Yeso, 'S' egekuba kiaye,
Gakonyoroki' ogwancha, Nintirnok' omoyo.

hymns.title: Yeso Nakire?
verses: Yeso nakir' as' obororo, Ntagoke gose gotera? 'Gurub'endito birengererio, Orogendo rokondosia.
Yeso nakir' as'omosunte, Konde nobwoba obonge; Omobas'ore botuko bocha, Ere nkomber'are ang'e.
Yeso nakir' as'amatemwa, Ekero nche nasinyirwe; Boror' obonge ntatimogeti, Marig' akonagoiteka.
Yeso nakire kamakweri, Agwatanana abanchwa; Omoy'oichana ang'e n'ogokwa, Tagokira atandore.
hymns.refrain: Nkondend' ar'amaene_igo Oigure emechando, Mobaso ndosa Botuko ng'iroka Omotoria ndenda.

hymns.title: Namanyire Oyokondaa
verses: Kemerind' eng'etanaine, 'Bis' enchera y'obogima, Tinkwoboa ekiagera namanyir' oyokondaa.
Kemerindo ekonucha, 'Se bitare bi' emechando; Tinkwoboa ekiagera namanyire oyokondaa.
Kamatemw' agonchichera, Nyancha neba embe mono; Korende ning'ike ng'umbu, Namayire oyokondaa.
Obwanchani bw' Omotoria, Bontang'aine as'enchera; Nimwegene goika ng'ike, Namanyire oyokondaa.
hymns.refrain: Namanyir' oyokondaa, As' enyancha y'emechando Emerindo y'emechando, Yes' andae onsi mbuya.

hymns.title: Omotoria Ntang'ane
verses: Omotoria ntang'ane, Ase chinchera chionsi, Nde buya kond' as'ore, Mb' as' obwanchani bwao.
Naye obotamero, 'Kero emechand' ere, Nde buya kore ang'e, Nsemeretie as'ore.
Ndae goik' omoerio, 'Mechando yaerire, 'Ngik' as' ense botaire, Marig' aratinyigwe.
hymns.refrain: Ndae, ndae, Omotoria tinsira; Ndae amatuk' onsi, Ndae chinchera chionsi.

hymns.title: Kemechando Yense Egocha
verses:
K' Emechando y'ens' egocha,
'Segi nyancha na ense;
Nindigi as' obotamero,
'Se kiriri kia Nyasae.

Karandeter' emechando,
Nisemerie Igoro;
'S' obwanchani, nandongeyie,
Takworoki' endamwamu.

Ababisa bakondigia,
Saitani_ondigetie;
Yeso aonchor' amabe,
Kob' omogok' omonge.

Kobogori' omosalaba,
Ndor' emechando y' ense;
Yes' orendet' Omoy' one,
Tagontiga nche nsire.
hymns.refrain:
Nambise nche, Nambise nche,
Ase ntanyor' emechando,
Nambise nche, Nambise nche,
'Se kiriri kia Nyasae.

hymns.title: Ande Onsi Gantangaine
verses: Ande onsi gantang'aine, Nindagende mwegenete; Nkoinyora bun' ankwerete, Akabambw'aria Kalwari.
Nagokire komoigwera, Nagokire gantangaine; 'Gwancha kway'ogwansu_ase nde, Gochenire na Kalwari.
Nindagende tinkoiroka, Ngoke Kristo kare ang'e; Nsemeretie komorora, Yes'Omosani_onkwerete.
hymns.refrain: Yeso nandae botambe, Yeso nandae and'onsi; Omosani bw'Ogokumia, Agankwer 'ase Kalwari.

hymns.title: Nay' Enchera
verses: Nay'enchera togotamera korw' amakweri; Noyokorigia Tat' amorigie goeta as'ore.
Nay'ekeene ng'ana yao eru' obong'aini; Naye okoru' obonga'ini nagochen' enkoro.
Nay' Encher', Ekeene, 'bogima many' enchera;  Torend' ekeene naki' omogoko botambe.

hymns.title: 'Monen' Emerindo Nere
verses: 'Monen' emerindo nere! Nig' ekogusa mono! 'Mare _a igoro amwamire, Boigamo mbori ang'e; 'Gokirete togosira? Ng'aki orarare! Kera etageka gekogosa, Gototindeka nyancha.
'Monene nigo ngweitia, Nyekany' as 'obororo, 'Nkoro yane yachandekire, O! boka na Ontorie. 'Merindo y'ebib'ebinge, Yambuir' enkoro; Nasirire Nasirir' Omonen' ayerera onkonye.
Yes'obwoba bwasirire, 'Morind' okanyekire, 'Mobaso ororekanire, im' as' enkoro yane; Ganya Omoboria one, Tontiga nche bweka; Ntimoke as'ore n'omogoko, As' engegu y'ebisio.
hymns.refrain: "Mbeo n'emerindo mbinyigwe, 'morembe, Neba endamwamu y'enyancha, Gos'ebirecha, gose monto onde, Mache takomera bwato as' Omonene bw'enyancha n'ense are, Ng'a bigwer' okogania kwane, 'Morembe, 'Morembe Ng'a bigwer' okogania kwane Omorembe".

hymns.title: Mogambi Ngoch'are Bwango
verses:
'Mogambi ngoch'are bwango,
'Ri'okweret' abanyabibe,
Nache kwoyia abachenu, Abaire Igoro.

Twaror' ebimanyererio,
Bikworoki' ogocha kwaye;
Matuko bwango naere,
Natogende _Igoro.

Amatuk' onsi nesegi,
Titori n' ogotimoka;
Goik' Omotoria asirie,
'Bibe n'amakweri.

Ens' eyio ya_Igoro nenyia,
Toraikaranse botambe;
Toboyigwe Ogotakwa,
Tomenye botambe.
hymns.refrain:
Ngoch' Are, ngoch' Are,
Ogocha kwaye ng'ang'e kore;
O! Nachiche, O! Nachiche,
Nachiche gototoria.

hymns.title: Mboare Ki Erio Ng'ike Nka?
verses: Mboare ki_erio ng'ike nka? Ner' omorendi_akairania; 'Botuko bono bwaerire, Ang'e bokiamoke, Tagoichana ayerera, 'Gosemeria gokorae; Goik' onyore obonda, Bw' barabu_Igoro."
Nkamoboria omorwani, Naboigo n'er 'akandemia; "Bwata mono okorwana, Gwaisire koera, Tagoichana remereria, Kor'emeremo eere, Twatebigwe ekeegwa, 'Kero torabue".
Erio nkaboria naende, Ense yonsi ekairania; "Orogendo rwaerire, Nka teri_are mono, Tagoichana twakureirwe, N'ebimanyereri' ebinge; Ebitongwa mbiganyete, 'Riogi ri' Omonene".
Tari _are goika nka bori, Ekerengereri'ekiya; Kegotogwenia chinkoro, 'Gotiny 'amariga Tagoichana ntoumerane, 'Se totatayaye rinde, Tobe n'omogoko bori, As' omochie o Tata.

hymns.title: Amang'an 'Amay' As' Omogendi
verses: Amang'an 'amay' as' omogendi, 'Yotayayete korwa nka; Omotoria mbwang'arairan'ense, N'obonda bwaye boche.
Chimber'as' abachenu baraire, Nachimanorwe kegima; Baria bonsi baraire mbaboke, 'Rio naende bamenye.
Ntoumeran' as'enka y'omogoko, Toter' ogotoreka; Korwa chinsinyo chionsi chi'ense'eye, Tomosasim' Omogambi.
Haleluya amen Haleluya nabo, Gatoregene ntoike nka; Tosabe mono torendete, Ntobek' egutw' enyia.
hymns.refrain: Ngoch' are, Mbwang' arairan' ens' eye; Namanya nairane bwango, N'abagendi bonsi, baegw'obonene, 'Ker' Omotori'aragambe.

hymns.title: Abachenu Bono Renda
verses: Abachenu bono renda, Igoro yanyegerigwe; Mochiokie chitaya chiaino, Chibe ang'e kagoch'Ere.
Eira ya Omotoria, Nwe mwabeirwe kegima pi; Chianga chiasibigwe bo, Tebi' aband' okoborigwa.
Amagambi agure pi, Yeso mbwang' agocha bono; Morandie obuya bwaye, Amatuk' ataraera.
Ebisaku nabisire, Yeso nachiche bwango bo; Onsi ay'ense naete, Tera Yeso ngocha are.
Abamochi, inchwo bwango, Amatuko ng'ang'e are; Ayerer' atarasieka, Monyore obuya bwaye.
hymns.refrain: Ngoch' are, Ere Yeso; Ig' agocha n' obonene; Erio agambe botambe, Ngoch' are, Ere Yeso.

hymns.title: Bugi' Engoma
verses: Bugi' engoma twora n'echinguru, Yeso nache naende; 'Bagendi goka, tera mochenge, Yeso nache naende.
Chisororo chiarw' as'ebitunwa, Yeso nache naende; Ngoch'ar'ere n'obonen' obonge, Yeso nache naende.
Ndirandigwe n'emerindo nyancha, Yeso nache naende; Rirandigw' as' abanto bonsi pi, Yeso nache naende.
Chiburuburu chiatworokirie, Yeso nache naeade; Mechando yabeire 'nsinyo chionsi, Yeso nache naende.
'Bisaku bionsi biabeanire, Yeso nache naende; Rora chisemi chiamentekire, Yeso nache naende.
hymns.refrain:
Nkoiran'are, Nkoiran'are'
Yeso nache naende.

hymns.title: Rituko Rinene Ngocha Rire
verses: Rituko rinene ngocha rire, Yeso nachiche, Koira abana abageni, Enka y'omwando.
Natorore ogokia kw'emambia, Kogoseria Omosunte, Natorore ogokia, Kw'emambia, Kogwata chimbera.
'Mang'ana y'enchili narandigw' ebisaku bionsi, Monene bw'enyangi tateban' amarandi_abuge.
'Ba igoro bonsi bamokobe namar' agwoka, Omogambi ache abair'abaye ase batakwe.
Bari' abasani twatiganete, Natororane, Baria barosir' emioyo batinyigw' amariga.

hymns.title: Eira Yarurw' As' Abegenete
verses: Eira yaruru' as'abegenete, "Ngocha nde bwango mbair' abar'abane; Morende mono goika nachire, Timorara buna abande renda".
Torende mono as'ogosaba, Nacher'abande buna omoibi; Twamanyire nigo are ang'e, Ko titomanyeti rituko renda.
Ee! ntore na ogosemeria, Ng'a Yeso Omonene oito nache; Chiira chiaye nechi'ekeene, "Mbwango ndach' aseigo mobwate mono".
hymns.refrain: "Morende mono goika nachire, Nimbae ense" N'eira yaye; "Soa 'mogoko, namotimoke, Monyore chigutwa, mobwate mono.

hymns.title: Ntomanyeti Ere Kagocha
verses: Ntomanyeti Ere kagocha, Mambia na mobaso gati; Ande nachiche mogoroba, Gose nobotuko gati; Otebire torende mono, Titochirimia chitaya, Erio Er' ekero agocha Atonyore toganyete.
Nainyoire amaber' Aye, Ageret' agatokwera; Agatig' obonene bwaye. Gokwera abasirete; Kero kende nache kogoka, Arore abw'akwerete, Bagokeret' ogocha kwaye, 'S 'okoganya n' okorenda.
Yes' Omwanchw' Omoboria one, kwamanyire ningwanchete; Nasemeirie ninkoror', Aye, Erio ong'arigani' as'ore; Korache konacha ekina, Ase baria baratame, Ningokwani' erio Omosani, Nkoganyete nakorenda.
hymns.refrain: Ntokoganyete (Ntokoganyet' Aye, Ntorendete) Ntokoganyete (Ntokoganyet' Aye. Ntorendete) Ntokoganyete (Ntokoganyet' Aye, Ntorendete) Nigo tokoganyet' Aye.

hymns.title: Gok'ens' Omonene Nache
verses: Gok'ens' Omonene nache, Rotot' Omogambi, Ker'oyomo amoganye, Ere kagochicha, Ere kagochicha, Ere, Ere kagochicha.
Gok' ens' Omone_agambe, Banto bamotogie, Bonsi na bionsi Motogie, Motogie kobua, Motogie kobua, Moto-motogie kobua.
Nagamb' ense as' obuya, Bisaku bimanye, Obonene bwaye bori, Obwanchani bwaye, Obwanchani bwaye, 'Bwanchani 'bwanchani bwaye.
'Bib' obororo mbikoba, gos' amagw' as' ense, Naretan' ogosesenia, gotub' amab'onsi, 'Y' okoragereria, 'y' oko-'y' okoragereria.

hymns.title: Nore Ang'Omonene Bw'enyangi Kagochicha
verses: Nore ang' Omonene bw'enyangi kagochicha, Nore ang' Omonene bw'enyangi kagochicha, Ngoch'are, Ngoch'are. Kabe ang'e, Bweboyi' obe ang'ere kagocha.
Chitaya chiano ngwoka chire Ere kagocha, Chitaya chiano ngwoka chire Ere kagocha, Nachiche bwango, Nachiche bwango, Orotot' Omonene kagocha.
Togende tomorotote kagocha, kagocha, Togende tomorotote kagocha, kagocha, Togende tomorotot' ekero, Omonene bw'enyangi Agochicha.

Natotere haleluya, kagocha kagocha,
Natotere haleluya, kagocha kagocha,
Tera haleluya! haleluya' Omonene bwenyangi ngoch'are.
hymns.refrain: Ror' Omonene bwe'nyangi ngoch'are, Ror' Omonene bw'enyangi ngocha'are, Ngoch'are, ngoch'are kabe ang'e, Bweboyi'obe ang' Ere kagocha.

hymns.title: Toiroka Ababisa
verses:
Toiroka ababisa, Nyasae nakorende;
Ins'ase chimbaba chiaye, Nyasae nakorende.
Kero ki' amatuk'amabe, Nyasae nakorende; Nony' as' obororo bwonsi, Nyasae nakorende.
Nako' okogania kwao, Nyasae nakorende; Takwang' ogosaba kwao, Nyasae nakorende.
As' amatemw' ande onsi, Nyasae nakorende; 'Morosu eegek' asare, Nyasae nakorende.
hymns.refrain: Nyasae nakorende, Kero gionsi nchera chionsi, Igo nakorende, Nyasae nakorende (nakorende).

hymns.title: Gose Mambia Erioba Rikooroka
verses:
Gose mambia erioba rikooroka, 'Mobas'oseri' omosunte n'ekiriri;
Yeso narache n'obonene bwaye, Kwoyia abanto baye.

Gose mobaso gati gose ko bwaira, Gose nebe obotuko bw'ekeigoro;
Neb'omobaso korw'obonene bwaye, 'Kero Yes' Akwoyi' abaye.

'Buya n'omogoko titogokwa rinde, 'Borwair' obororo n'ebirero mbiyo,
Kobogorigwa as'obonene bwaye, 'Kero Yes' Akwoyi' abaye.

Emeganda yaye etere Hosana, Amalaika n'abachenu mbabeo;
Obuya nabobe as' obosio bwaye, 'Kero Yes' Akwoyi' abaye.
hymns.refrain: O! Yeso Kristo ndiriri, Natoak'eriogi? Yes'ochire, haleluya, haleluya nabo Haleluya Amen.

hymns.title: Yeso Ngochich'Are
verses: Yeso ngochich' are, kwoyi' abanto baye, Abachenu baye bonsi, Baikarans' as'are; Rigereria_Igoro, Goka na gotera, Nache n'obonene bwaye, Yeso Omogambi.

Ense netengeche igoro neete, Omobe ng'ai-orabe ase rituk'erio?
Botamero mboiyo, nonya n'oboigamo, 'Ndamwamu erorekane, Kamaber' aerire.
Amais' ay'agwoka, Nasambe ababe, Onde tagwator'erieta, ria Yes'eker'ekio; Y'okogecha, taiyo, As' Abakrist' erio, Ogosaba n'ebirero Nabibe bos'erio.

hymns.title: Rigesa Ri'ense Riabeire Ang'e
verses:
Rigesa ri'ense riabereire ang'e, Omonene narigeti' abagesi;
Bagese endagera yomire pi, Omonene ayegache kagocha.

Rituko erio rigiya botambe, Ngocha rire bwango, bwango kegima;
Ebibe biasiareire rigesa nchuo, Ayerera gesa ribaga ndire.

Togese tore n'obwanchani mono, Ogokonywa nkorue aaria igoro;
'Bwanchani bwatorangeirie togese, Rigesa nditoganyete togende.
hymns.refrain:
Angoa. . . bwango.
(Angoa abagesi, Angoa. Ira rigesa kiage, are nka)
Angoa. . . bwango. . . Angoa. . . bwango.
(Angoa abagesi, Angoa, Reta_igesa nka). Toire nka.

hymns.title: Ko Rirandi Rikobugigw' As'omoerio
verses:
Ko rirandi rikobugigw' as 'omoerio, Natorore omobas' obarire;
N' abatorigwe korw'ense baumeran'aria ng'umbu, Gakorangeri' amarieta nimbeo.

Rituk'erio n'omogok' abachenu bakoboka, Nabakwete kare nababoke pi;
Abachore nabagende na Nyasae igoro, Gakorangeri' amarieta nimbeo.
Natokore emeremo ya Nyasae eere, Tokwan'obwachani_obo bw'ogokumia; Eri' emerem' ekoera natogende Igoro, Gakorangeri' amarieta nimbeo.
hymns.refrain: Gakorangeri'amarieta, Gakorangeri' amarieta, Gakorangeri' amarieta, Gakorangeri' amarieta nimbeo.

hymns.title: Tindigeti Obonda
verses:
Tindigeti Obonda gose obonene, Tatiga mb' omochenu ing'ike igoro;
'Getabu ki'obogima kerikire buya, Erieta riane rende, Naki ndirikire'?
'Bibe biane nebinge buna omokenye, 'K'amanying' Omotoria nar' ang'isanire; Kwabekire eira ''mbib' ebibariri, Nabirabe kegima, kegima naende".
Ror'omochie omuya, chinyomba chinene, 'Bamenyi babegete chianga chindabu; As'obobe botache gosaria amaya, Erieta riane rende, Naki ndirikire?
hymns.refrain:
'Rieta riane gose, ndirikir'aroro?
'S'egetabu Igoro, naki ndirikire?

hymns.title: Otorangeri' Omogambi Oito
verses: Otorangeiri' Omogambi_oito, Toikarans' as' enyangi yaye; Naki erabe ase tore, Ere kagocha.
Nabekerw' obonene bwaye, Egutwa ribaga ri'amagwa; Kororekane ogosikwa, Ere kagocha.
Bun'ekomesa engaki_eyio, 'Bia bobisi birorekane; Tororekane buna tore, Ere kagocha.
Nagokere abatorigwe, Babegete chianga chi'enyangi; Naki_ere buy' as' ababui, Ere kagocha.
hymns.refrain: Ere kagocha minto, 'Mogambi kagocha, Naki erab' ase tore, Ere kagocha.

hymns.title: Ekero Toragambigwe
verses: Ekero toragambigwe, 'Bogima gos' ogokwa; Natobe bun'edhahabu? Gose bun'amabiria.
Toigw' amang'an' amaya; "Omosomba omuya," Gose nayare amabe, Kwaremeirwe omobe.
Ntomoigwere Omoika, Tonyore amabera; Gose tebana ekina, Kia Nyasae kenachwe.
hymns.refrain: Kwarengirwe n'Omonene, Kwarengirwe; Kwarengirwe nering'ana, Kwaremeirwe.

hymns.title: Rituko Rinene Ngochicha Rire
verses: Rituko rinene, Ngochicha rire, 'Go rikonagosuka gocha; Abachenu n'abanyabibe mbaatananwe, Nore ang' ase rituk'erio?
Ituko rikomesa, Ngochicha rire, 'Go rikonagosuka gocha; 'Borabu bwaye bocher' abanchet' Omonene, Nore ang' ase rituk'erio?
Ituko ri'omoichano, Ngochicha rire, 'Go rikonagosuka gocha; 'Ker'ababe baraigwe "Genda timbamanyeti", Nore ang' ase rituk'erio?
hymns.refrain: Nore ang'e, Nore ang'e, Nore ang'e rituko ri'ekina? Nore ang'e, Nore ang'e, 'Se rituk'erio?

hymns.title: Ekina Giachakirwe Igoro
verses: Ekina giachakirwe_Igoro, Naki ntwe torateneneo; Anache Nyasa' Omogambi, Ker'ogokora n'enchera.
Abakure banacheirw' ekina, Erio nyuma abare moyo; Bonsi nabanyorerw' ekina, 'Kina getari mabera.
Naki torabe ase_ ekin' ekio, Ebibe bikoorokigwa; Kogiaikire konachwa, Kina getari goonchoka.
hymns.refrain: Naki ntwe torantenene, Rituko riria rinene; 'Go toratoke twaremeirwe, Gos'ebibe biatinyigwe?

hymns.title: Ntomanyeti Ensa
verses:
Borabu mboreo 's'abagotoreka, 'Keene nker' as' ebuku ya Nyasae;
'Ker'obobani bwaraga ng'a ngoch'are, Ko ntomanyeti_ensa.

Torende, tosabe chitaya tochiokie, Tokor'emeremo goik' Omonen'ache;
Natotere, togok'ere kagochicha, Ko ntomanyeti_ensa.
hymns.refrain:
Nachiche, Torende tobe ang'e, Nachiche,
Omotoria haleluya; Nachiche, as' amare a Tata, Ko ntomanyeti_ensa.

hymns.title: Tenen' As' Ekeene
verses: Tenen' as' ekeene Gwer 'Omonene, Basike bari 'abake'Mogand' o Danieli.
Bant' abange basir' as' obwoba bwabo, Ng'a mbab' abakong'u babe buna Danieli.
Bant' abanene mono bare_im'as'ense, Mbagwe bakoumer 'omogand' O Danieli.
Imoki' ebendera mobue 'babisa, Moserie Saitani_as'eriogi ria Danieli.
hymns.refrain: Mobe buna Danieli, Tenena mweka, Mobe n'ogwancha okonge timoiroka.

hymns.title: Nyasae Karache Kogambia
verses:
Nyasae karache kogambia,
Ebisaku bi' ense eye;
Gatwarangerigw' ekin' ekio,
Nkogamba ki toragambwe.

Toigwe Yeso ogotebia,
"Mbuya mon' omosomb' one";
Gose toserigwe kegima,
N' abanto ababe bonsi.

'Gok' eker' aror' abaye,
Babwat' ekemanyererio;
Babeke chianga chindabu,
Batenene ang'e nere.

Tosabe rigoro twaganya,
Chitaya chiaito chiogete;
Ker' omonywomi akorangeria,
Ntobe ang'e kogenda nka.

Natomenye na gosemeria.
'S' okogany' engaki eyio;
Ker' orogendo rwaerire,
Toikarens' as' obonene.
hymns.refrain:
Nabobek' obori bwaye kiage,
N' omoiruro nayotugute
Naki torab' as' ekin' ekio,
Rituko ri' okobokigwa?

hymns.title: Ko Rirumbe Riasirere
verses: Ko rirumbe riasirire korwa as'ebitunwa, Omobaso okobara ogotongia emambia; Natosome rirube riaye ri'obwanchani bwaye, Tomanyane twensi buya, rirumbe rigosira.
Tokomocha koinyora buna intwe namaroba, Togosaria amachiko na gochandeka tweka; Chimbaba chiaye chindabu chitub' ebibe biaito, Okorenda gokoera, rirumbe rigosira.
Rirumbe rigototuba, Tata natomanyete, 'Bosi' as'obosio tomanyane, na baria twanchete; Korwa ng'umbu yabarire buya, yakiamokire, Ekiriri kegoeta, rirumbe rigosira.
hymns.refrain:
Tomanya ---- ne buya pi,
(Tomanya ---- ne buya pi)
Totare ---- amo twensi,
(Totare ---- amo twensi)
Bogokia-- moka_igoro,
(Bogokia ---- moka 'goro)
Rirumbe ---- rigosira,
(Rirumbe rigosira)
Bogokia ----- moka_igoro,
(Bogokia ---- moka 'goro)
Rirumbe-- rigosira, (Rirumbe rigosira)

hymns.title: Natororane Na Yeso
verses: Natororane na Yeso, Obosio as' obosio; Nomochengo rituk' erio Kondaror' Omotoria.
Tinkonyara komomanya, Buna are Ere bori; Korend' ekero arache, Nimorore bun'are.
Biserigwe korw' as'are, 'Mariga n' omoichano; Egesiru nakeirane, 'Bobisi bomanyeke.
Bosio as'obosi' ekeene! Omogoko nobeo; Nimbe n'omogoko bori, Kondaror' Omotoria.
hymns.refrain: Natororan' as'amaiso, aria seito Igoro; Nase obonene bwaye, Nimorore botambe.

hymns.title: Ntoumeran' Aria Roche
verses: Ntoumeran' aria roche, 'S' Amalaik' amenyete, Morind' omokenonoku, Okorw' ase Nyasae.
'S' engegu y' oroche roria, Rw'amache akomesa; Totere na gosasima, Botamb' as' omogoko.
Gator' ang'e goika roche, Totige chigurube; 'S' obuya natotorigwe, Aru' eyanga n'egutwa.
Bwango ntoik' aria roche, Tokore orogendo; Chinkoro chigoke mono, Totere n'omorembe.
hymns.refrain: Toumerane twensi roche, As' agay' oroch' oruya mono; Toumerane n'abaye bonsi, 'S' oroche rwa Nyasae.

hymns.title: Emeremo Ekoera
verses: Emeremo ekoera twamboke nyancha ng'umbu, Nindor' emambi' engiya y'obonene; Nimomany' Omotoria ko ndaike aria_igoro, Nankwanie n'omogoko Omonene
Naki ndagoke mono ko ndarore Nyasae, Kondaror' obosio bway' obwororo; Nimobake as' obwanchani n'obuya bwonsi, Bwandoseiri' obomenyo aria_igoro.
Abanchani baito bonsi_abakure as' ens' eye, Bakwete n'okwegena kwa Nyasae; Natogoke mono koumeran' aria_igoro, Ko ninganie korora Yeso kubua.

Kondasoe omochie nechianga chindabu, Nandae as'emechando etari;
Nintere n'omogoko n'ababuir' ebibe, Ko ninganie korora Yeso kobua.
hymns.refrain:
Nimomanye, nimomanye,
Ko ndatenene ang'e as'are;
Nimomanye, Nimomanye,
Kondarore amabok' aye.

hymns.title: 'Mosalaba Togoetera
verses: 'Mosalaba togoetera, Gochia nka igoro; Ntokwobo' emeganda y'ebibe Tat' otorendire.
Mosalaba togoetera, Yes' otang'anire; Ntomobwatie chimbaratero, Nka engeg' engiya.
Mosalaba togoetera, 'Nchera neba embe; Nare' oratorae buya, Nka 'Monen' as'ore.
hymns.refrain: Nka, nka, nka, Gochia nka igoro, Mosalaba togoetera, Enka y'obwanchani.

hymns.title: Ntenen'engegu Yordani
verses: Ntenen' engegu Yordani, Na korigereria; Kanani _engiy' omogoko, 'S' enibo yan'ere.
Ens'eri' engiy' erandete, Nomobaso rioka; Krist' agamba goika kare, Aseri' omosunte.
Ndi ndaike as' agiya, Na gosesenigwa; Ndore obosio bwa Tata, Ntimoke botambe.
Nkor' eichorwe n'omogoko, Tingoteban'ense; Nony' emerind' ekogusa, Ningendeo rioka.
hymns.refrain:
Natomeny' ens' engiy' omogoko, Aria ngumbu_as' engegu_eri' engiya;
Toter' ogotera kwa Musa n'Eng'ondi, Tobe na Yeso botambe.

hymns.title: Eker' Emerem' Ekoera
verses: Eker' emerem' ekoera, Abagesi nabairane; Bakoretana rigesa, Goika Yerusalemu.
Rituko riria natotere, Komosaba, Komotogia; 'Monene Yes' Omotoria, Aria Yerusalemu.
Natobe n'omogok' aroro, As'obomenyo bwa Tata; Obwo bwabekirwe ang'e, Aria Yerusalemu.
hymns.refrain: 'Mogoko nabayorore, 'Mogok'otari koera; 'Mogok' ekiagera bono, 'Meremo yaerire.

hymns.title: Nere Ens' Engiya Kobua
verses: Nere ens'engiya kobua, As' okwegena twayerora; Tata nigo atoganyete, Gotoroseria obomenyo.
Natotere an' as'engegu, Amater'amay' abachenu; Ntokoba nobororo rinde, Gose kogania gotimoka.
Ase Tat' omuy'ore_igoro, Natomobake tomotogie, As'ekeegwa ki' obwanchani N'ebisio atosesenirie.
hymns.refrain:
'Ns'engiya----- botambe-----
('Ns'engiya bota - botambe)
Toumeran'engegu-engiya (botambe)
'Ns'engiya----- botambe-----
(Ns'engiya bota---- botambe)
Toumeran' engegu_engiya.

hymns.title: Ntomeny' As' Amach' Obogima
verses: Ntomeny' as' amach' obogima, Nsok'enchenu_engiya; Yes' atoganyet' atorosie, Korosigw' okuya.
Tokorosa as' orogendo, Mbuya totimoke; Ase amache akwongora, Igo akogokia.
Aye nore n'erang'o gose? Inchwo ase Yeso; Yeso namache y'obogima, Oyanyw' otoreke.
hymns.refrain:
Ntomeny' as' amach' obogima
(Ntomeny' ase amache y'obogima)
As' amache y'obogima
(As' amache nsoko y'obogima)
As' amache y'obogima
(As' amache nsoko y'obogima)
Ensoko y'obogima.

hymns.title: As' Ens' Eyio Engiya
verses: As' ens' eyio engiya, Nor' omochi' omuya; Orabeo botambe, N'omosunte toiyo.
Bisieri bie chilulu, As' omochi' omuya; Chinchera chi' edhahabu, N'omosunte toiyo.
Bisieri bitasiekwe, Gochi 'omochi' omuya; Mach' obogim' asoka, N'omosunte toiyo.
Tibaganeti isase, As'omochi' omuya; Ng'ondi ner' omobaso, N'omosunte toiyo.
hymns.refrain: Totinyigw' amariga, Obororo bosire Mbari kobara engaki, 'Mosunte toiyo.

hymns.title: Ngokor' Emeremo n'Amatemwa
verses: Ngokor' emeremo n'amatemwa, Nimb' as' engegu_komekameka; Mb' ang'e n' Omonene ngosasima, Miaka yonsi n'obonen' ase nde.
As' ekeegwa ki'obuya bwaye, Naeirwe ribaga aria_igoro; Kobao ndore obosio bwaye, Miaka yonsi n'obonen' ase nde.
Basani mbabe' aba nanchete, Mogok' omonge ong'etanane; 'Manyir' omogoko bw'Omotoria, Miaka yonsi n'obonen' ase nde.
hymns.refrain: Ig' erabe, obonene, obonene, obonene 'S' obuya nimorore obosio Neb' obonene, 'bonen' ase nde.

hymns.title: Twaboigure Obuya Bw'Ense
verses: Twaboigure obuya bw'ense, Engiya echabeire, Obuya bwaye bw'ogokumia. Ng'aki_erabe kobao! Chinchera nechia edhahabu, 'Magacho ye chilulu, Tibogotebeka obuya, Ng'aki_erabe kobao.
Ntosiboke korw' as'ebibe, 'Matemwa, n'obororo; Mechando ende tekobao, Ng'aki_erabe kobao; Obwanchani Obonge mono, Tobek'eang' endabu, 'Kanisa y'Omotangi o Igoro, Ng'aki_erabe kobao.
Mechando yaito yonsi_eere, Rituko ri 'omogoko; Torore omochi 'ogoika, Ori'ochabeire mono; Buya buna omoriakari, Koumer' Omonene; Goichana tigokobao, Mosunte tokobao.
Ninchandeka ime as'ense, Nindengererie_Igoro; Bwango nainche nimanye onsi, Ng'aki_erabe kobao; Ntororane aase agare, As' obonen' obonge, Abachenu bonsi mbabeo, Yeso nere nabeo.

hymns.title: Titori Na Obomenyo
verses: Titori na obomenyo; Omochie tori aiga: Toremigw' as' eng'an' eye, Togany' omochie ogocha, Togany' omochie ogocha.
Titori na obomenyo; Torigi' omochie orache: Zayoni nka y'Omonene, Okomeka, miaka yonsi, Okomeka, miaka yonsi.
Obomenyo bw'omorembe; 'Batorigw' batimoke; Onye nabwate chimbaba Nkoiruruka narenge, Ing'iruruke ntimoke.
Omoy'one kira igo! Omonene omanyire; Konda' nkor'obuya bwaye, Ner' ogonchorer' engaki, Ey'ogotimoka kwane.

hymns.title: Bagendi Ng'ai Mogochia?
verses: Bagendi ng'ai mogochia, Nechinyimbo koboko? Na togende orogendo, 'As'ogochika Kwaye. Ebitunwa n'amagoko, Nkogenda tore nka bwoye, Nkogenda tore nka Bwoye, Ase ense engiya.
Bagendi nki morigetie, As'enseria engiya? Yanga ndabu ne chigutwa, korwa as'Omotoria. Tonyw'amache y'obogima, Tomeny' amo na Nyasae, Natomeny' amo botambe, Ase ense engiya.
Bagendi togende nainwe, Gochi' ens' eria engiya? Inchwo bono mwancheirwe, nchwo, Mosoe 'mogand' oito. Inchwo, nchwo, timototiga, Krist' oganyir' atoire. 'Ganyir' atoire Bwoye, As' ens' eria engiya.

hymns.title: Ngoika Nka
verses: Mbek' egutwa y'edhahahu ngoika nka, Ntore chigurube chiane ngoika nka: Mboyigw' obonene. Ninter' omogano, Bw'Omotoria one ngoika nka

'Mosunte bwonsi noete ngoika nka. 'Moerio ndor' oborabu ngoika nka:
Borabu bwa igoro, Bomorek' enchera, Bondae botambe goika nka.
Ndor'obosio bw'Omotoria ngoika nka, Nter'obuya bw'Omotoria ngoika nka; Nintenen'as'are, Erio mosasime, Mbe nere botambe ngoika nka.
hymns.refrain:
Ngoika nka (ngoika nka),
Ngoika nka (ngoika nka),
Bororo bwonsi mboere ngoika nka:
Ngoika nka (ngoika nka),
Ngoika nka (ngoika nka)
Bororo bwonsi mboere ngoika nka.

hymns.title: Nayeigure Ense
verses: Nayeigure ense, Egotoka are, Nomochi' omuya as' enkoro; Yes' oyoagachire, Aria titogokwa, Nense totakogota rinde.
Totagote totagote, 'Nse ase totagote rinde; Totagote totagote, 'Nse ase totagote rinde.
As'ens'eyi 'engiya 'se totatayaye, Toigwanane rioka botambe; Totogi' Omogambi, s'ogotera rioka, Nense ase totakwe rinde.
'Merem' ekoera tonyore egutwa, 'Mechando n'amatemwa aere; Bororo boere, mariogi_igwanane, Nabanchwa abakwete kare.

hymns.title: Nkorengereria Nde
verses: Nkorengereria nde Ens' eria engiya, Ndaike k'erioba rikogwa; As' obuya bwa Yeso ntenene aria, Ninyor' eng'enang'eni gose?
'Ase chinguru chiaye Yeso nindandie, Nindende mobu' omobisa; Erio ching'enang'eni nachib' echiane, Okobakwa kwaye koigweke.
Naki ndagok' ekero nche ndamorore, Nintung'ame komosasima; 'Moy 'one nogok' omochie bw'edhahabu, 'Ninyor' eng'enang'eni gose?
hymns.refrain:
Ninyore eng'enang'eni as'egutwa Mogorob' erioba rikogwa (rikogwa)
Gonkoboka n'abachenu_as'omochi' oria, Ninyor' eng'enang'eni gose? (Ninyore?)

hymns.title: Nyancha Ng'umbu
verses: Nyancha ng'umbu gati y'ense y'emechando, Naria Igoro Ense nere botakoira, 'S'amarig' aratinyigwe.
Nyancha ng'umbu, 'S' Omorembe, 'Bibe n'ense biaetire, Emechando yaerire, Abarosu batimoke.
'Yaetire, takoinyorwa, Emioy'enyore chinguru; Takobao amariga, Ase baria batorigwe.
Nyancha ng'umbu. 'motimoko, Yes'arangerie abaye Emerindo yaetire, 'Malaika bagotera.
hymns.refrain:
Nyancha ng'umbu, nyancha y'emerindo, naigur' abanchwa bakondangeria,
(Nyancha ng'umbu nyancha nyancha y'emerindo)
(Naigur'abanchwa 'banchwa bakondangeria)
Bwango natotige emechando,
Tomenye n'Omonene botambe.
(Bwango, bwango natotige emechando),
Tomenye n'Omonene botambe.

hymns.title: Nchw' As' Omotoria
verses: Nchw' as' omotoria totebana, 'Ngana riatworokirie enchera; Na'are naintwe aiga rero, Nkorangeri'are nchwo.
'Ban' abake igw'eriogi riaye, Nkoro chichenge n'omogoko; Tomochor' ere ab'oyoito, Tagotebana nchwo.
Rengereria nar' amo naintwe, Igw'eriogi riaye oigwere; 'Gwa ngosoror' ar' ogoteba, "Nw'abana bane nchwo."
hymns.refrain: Omogoko natoyorore, Chinkoro ko chiachenekire, Natororane n'Omotoria, 'S' enk'eyio botambe.

hymns.title: Ter' Obwanchari Bwa Yeso
verses:
Ter'obwanchani bwa Yeso, N'amabera, N'obuya As'omochie bw'oborabu,
'Toroseri' obomenyo.
Gatore as'orogendo, 'Mare natub' erioba; Korende ko rwaerire, kweumia ngokobao.
Tiga tobe abegenwa, Tomokorere rioka; Okomorigereria iga, natonyor' obogima.
Gochia bosi' as'ekeegwa, Bwango natomorore; Egeita nakeigorwe, Totar' Omochi' Omuya.
hymns.refrain: Togoi. . . ka Igoro, 'Mogoko ki orab' eker' ekio; Tomoro. . . re Ye. . . so, Totere as'obobui.

hymns.title: Naikir' Ense Y'Omwando
verses: Naikir'ense Y'omwando 'S'enibo nairwe bosa, Ens'eyio tibori koira, Omosunte oetire.
Nintare n'omonen'one, tori'emes' engiya nere; 's'amaig' andae_ n'okoboko, chinsinyo chi'ense ya Igoro;
Gotiok'okuya gokorwa, 's'ebisicha bitakuoma; Bi'emete Yamete_igoro, 'sechinsoko chi'obogima.
Mariogi'amaya nareo, Ay'ogotera kwa_Igoro; 'Malaika bagotera; Amo nabwo babuire.
hymns.refrain: Ens'engiya, 'Ngiya mono, Gantenein' as' egutunwa; Nindore Ngumbu Y'enyancha, Ase ndoseiri ' obomenyo Ndoro'engegu Y' obonene, 'Bomenyo bwane botambe.

hymns.title: 'Buya Mbore Nka
verses: 'Buya mbore nka k'obwachani boreo, 'Mogoko' oigweke k'obwanchani bore nka; 'Morembe n'omoigoto, N'omogoko bibeo, Ng'akiere buya k'obwanchani bore nka.
'Mogoko nyomba k'obwanchani boreo, Moko tegocha, k'obwanchani bore nka; Bisicha biam'as'ense, s'emegond' emiya, Bogima bwagokigwa, 'Bwanchani nyomba.
Igor'egoka k'obwanchani bore nka, Ens'eichorw'obwanchani ko bore nyomba; Agansoko gatera, Igoro ner'eraba, k'obwanchani bore nka, Yes' agokigwa.
Yeso nkore mb'oyoo bwanchani boche, Nsang' ekeng'wanso kiao, 'Rio twanchane nka; Ntimoke korw'obobe, Tindengereri 'ebibe, 'S'obuya nseseneke, Bwanchani nyomba.
hymns.refrain: 'Bwanchani, bore nka, Ng'aki_ere buya k'obwanchani bore nka.

hymns.title: Tenena ase Chiira Chia Yeso
verses: Tenena ase chiira chia Yeso. Nigo aratogigw 'Ere botambe; Moterer' Omonene bw'emeganda, Tenen' ase chiira chiaye.
Tenena ase chiira chia Yeso, Omobe Saitani tagotema; Gochia enchera yaye eria embe, Tenen' ase chiira chiaye.
Tenena ase chiira chia Yeso, Mogende n' Er' esegi timorosa; Mobabu' ababisa ba Saitani, Tenen' ase chiira chiaye.
hymns.refrain: O-te-ne-ne (Tenen'ase chiira chi tenen'ase chiira) Tenena'ase chiira chi'omonene o-te-ne-ne (T'enen'ase chiira,Tenen'ase chiira) Tenen' ase chiira chiaye

hymns.title: Toumerane N'Abasani
verses: Toumerane n'abasani as'ens 'engaki egoeta, Twaichana korengereria ng'a, goika totigane.
Mang'ana y'ogotigana takab'as'enk'eri' enyia, Toter'amatera y'omogoko kare na kare.
hymns.refrain:
Ntogotigana Igoro titogotigana. Ens' engiya y'omogoko, titogotigana.
2.
Twasemeirie 'ker' emeremo y 'ens 'ekoera, Ntomeny' amo n'abasani baito twatiganete.

hymns.title: Gokw' Ase Yeso!
verses: 'Gokw'ase Yeso! Nokuya ond'ataboke korera; Nobotimoker'obuya, Botasarigwe n'obobe.
Gokw'ase Yeso! o mbuya ase oy'ogosundoka; Gotimok'as'okwegena, Gosemeria 'sesenirie.
Gokw'ase Yeso! 'Morembe, 'koboka gosesenirie; 'Nguru chi'Omotoria nchigotangwa n' obobe, n'obwoba.
Gokw'ase Yeso! Nobok' egetureri gekobuga; Chimbera nachimanoke, Baboke tibakwa rinde.

hymns.title: Narorir' Ensok'Engiya
verses: Narorir'ensok' engiya, 'Nsok' entamb'eng'are Yes'Omonen'ogotoria, Ror'amaot'aye.
Bogim'oboyia bwachire, Manying'agokwana; Akwan' obobe bosira, Ins' as' omorindo
Ngotara nd'asoborabu, kobua ebibe, Nkor' enchenu, ang' endabu, Nkrist' omenyete ime.
'Buya bw'ogokumi' ens'aa, Manying' aitegete, Yeso bweka namanyire, Yes' ori' onkwerete.
hymns.refrain: Ndoch'ensoko y'ogosibia, Nsoe im'ensibie kegima, Baka Tata yansibirie, yansibirie, yansibirie.

hymns.title: Otobatise, As'Omoik'Oo
verses:
Otobatise, As'Omoik'oo;
As'obwanchani tobeke chinguru.

Twarer'as'ore, Ntw'abanyabibe;
Tosibie, tochene korw'as'ebibe.

Iruma ria_Igoro, Ika Korwa_Igoro;
Twasab'ebisio, 'S 'amabera nchw'ang'e.

Igwa eriogi, Riarwete_Igoro;
Ay'Omwanchw'one, Ngokiri'as'ore.

Natokobake, Eng'ondi yaitetwe;
Natogosasime, Amen, Amen.
hymns.refrain:
Twagosabire Yes'Omotori 'oito;
'S'Omoika n'obwanchani tobatise.

hymns.title: Yeso Ng'Endagera Y'obogima
verses:
Yeso ng'endagera Y'obogima,
Buna gwakorete ang'e' nyancha;
As'amarik'ao ninkorigie,
Nkoro nekoganetie, 'Ring'ana!"

Seseni'ekeene namanyire,
Buna gwaseseneti 'omogati;
'Bosomba bosire n'ebisibo,
Nyore omorembe ase bionsi.

'Mang'an'ao Moika n'obogima,
Ko tindi na nguru chi'okoigwera;
Naye ogokonywa n'obogima,
Nganetie nyigwer'amang'an'ao

hymns.title: Egetare ki' Emiaka
verses: Egetare ki'emiaka, Nyebise im' as' ore; Amache n'amanyinga, Bikorw' omober' oo; Bib' eriog' as'ebibe, Nkonye korwa ebibe.
Meremo y'amaboko, Tegonkorera gento; Nonya n'omokia bwonsi, 'Mariga naiteka; Ase nde 'bibe mbosa, Naye bwek' orankonye.
Tindi koreta gento, 'Mosalaba ndaimokie; Mbosa nde aye mboyie, Nakorigereire; Ay' ensoko 'bogima, Onsibie tinkwa ense.
Kangokor' orogendo, Mobui bw' ababisa; Ng'iruruke gochi' are, nkoror'As'ekerogo; Egetare ki'emiaka, Nyebise ime as' ore.

hymns.title: Gatogochicha Amo
verses: Gatogochicha amo, As'okoinyora Yeso; Toinyore Yeso Kristo, Tomwanche as' omoyo, Bono toinyore Yeso, 'Y'onkwerete Kalwari
Gatokori' omogati, Na konyw' egekomb' eke Toinyor' omober' oye, Obambetw' as' omote, Toinyor' amanying' aye, 'Ri' aitegete Kalwari
Tata_iter' Omoik'oo, Aso'ase chinkoro; Koinyora omwan' oo, Bun' akweret' abanto, 'Manying' ay'agaiteka, Agakw'aria Kalwari.

hymns.title: Igw' Eriogi Ri'Omorisia
verses: Igw'eriogi ri'Omorisia, Korw'eror' Omosunte ime; Korangeria 'ng'ondi 'nsiru, Korw'obweri bw'omorisia
Ng' okomokony'omorisia, Korigia 'ng'ondi chinsiru; Ng'ogochiirania bweri, Chitangwe korw'obokendu.
Igwa chikwan'eroro ime, As'ebitunw'ebitambe; 'Gw'Omonen' ogotomire, 'Gend'ondigerie ching'ondi.
hymns.refrain: Chirete, chirete, korwa rinani ri'ebibe; Chirete, chirete, chirete ase Yeso.

hymns.title: Nki Twasaber' Abana?
verses: Nki twasaber'abana, 'Ba baiboirw'as'ense; 'Mais'ab' akoigoka, 'Nkor'emany'obwanchani.
Obogim'obuya, Twasabeire Nyasae; Emeremo emiya, 'B' as'obogima bwabo.
Twasabir'obong' aini, ogokor'okuya; N'Omoik'omoitongo, Okoremi 'abataka.
Chinguru as'amatemwa, chibu'oborwaire; Koma'obonda bwa_Igoro, Koba omogoko.
Nabo twabasabeire, As'emambi 'engiya; 'Mogok'ob'oichore, Bun'ensoko y'amache.

hymns.title: 'Bwanchani Bwatogokia
verses: Bwanchani bwatogokia, 'Toroseri' enchera; Botoinyoria kob'abaya, 'S'abande botambe.
Ens' ey'omoichano, 'Borwair' amakweri; 'S'obwanchani natoteme, Gokonya chinkoro.
Amatuk'akoera, Tokoirwa igoro; Natoter'agwo botambe, 'Bwanchani bwa Yeso.
hymns.refrain: Nyasae, Ere n'obwanchani, Naintwe, Nabaye tore; Bwanchani bwatogokia, 'Toroseri'enchera;  Botoinyoria kob'abaya 'S'abande botambe.

hymns.title: Nagokire Ng'a Tat'ore Igoro
verses: Nagokire ng'a Tat'ore_igoro, 'Teb'obwanchani bway'as'ebuku; 'Makumi' amange narorire ime, Kobu'onsi Yeso nanyanchete.
Nonya nkomweb'erio natayaya, 'Nyanchete rioka nonya ngosira; Nimotamer'er'oyonyanchete, Gankoinyora bun'er'ankwerete.
Onye kore gotera ndatere, 'Kero namororir'Omotoria; Nakw'oko goika kare na kare,''N'ogokumia ki Yes' Anyanchete.
hymns.refrain: Nagokire Yes'Anyanchete, Nanyanchete, nanyanchete; Nagokire Yes' Anyanchete, Nanyanchete mono.

hymns.title: Yes'Omosani Bw'Abana
verses: Yes' Omosani bw'abana, 'Be 'Mosani'one; Mbwat 'okoboko mbe naye, Botambe.
Nyegerie nkine n'obuya, 'Matuk'onsi; Aye nkwabet'omwana, Nomanyete.
Ndae ker'enchera, As'obosae bwane; Ng'ainie nkong'a as'ekeene kiao.
Tontuguta, korend' ay' ob' omosani 'one; Ninkoganetie botambe as' obogima.

hymns.title: Nimorigie Yeso Genkio
verses: Nimorigie Yeso genkio, Nimwegere botambe, Mbwati' Amabarato Aye, Ntar'encher' enyerere.
As' aranchike ningende, Tindi moke ningende, 'Nchera ase atang'aine, Tindi moke komanya.
Ingesieri ateneine, 'Botamero bw'ebibe, Ninture orir' eira, Aigwe anyigorere.
hymns.refrain: Onyanchire Ee 'nyanchire, Namanyire 'nyanchire, Yeso 'Kanyancha 'gankwera, Naki' ekio Mwancherete.

hymns.title: Nkwarosire?
verses: Nkwarosire. gwaichanire nagochandeka? "Nchw'ateba, Eri'aye otimoke."
Naki ndamomany'erio nch'asar'oy'okondaa? "Nare amaot'as'ebimo biaye."
Ner'egutw'Omogambi abekeirw'Omotwe? "Maene negutwa, Ko neyamagwa."
Komonyora nagotunya nki ndanyoreo? "Obororo, 'meremo namaiga."
Kondabwaterere nki ndanyor'Omoerio? "Bokong'u mboere ng'ete Yordani."
Ndamobori' ang'ire mbe oyoye nanyange? "Takwanga igoro nense nchieta."
Korigia, gotunya, korenda, nasesenie? "Abachenu mwensi iraneri 'ee."

hymns.title: Abarwani Mwemanye Inwe
verses: Abarwani mwemanye_inwe n'ab'Omonene, Mebere yaino n'enibo yaye Nyasae.
Akaba' amaboko, 'magoro n'amaiso, Erio momanye buna inwe n'abaye more.
Momoinyor' Omonen' as'obosae bwaino, Obogima bwaino bob' ekeng'wans' as'are.
Omobas'oin'obare as'abanto bonsi, 'Gokora kwain'okuya kobake Nyasae.

hymns.title: 'Kero Yes'arwete Igoro
verses: 'Kero Yes'Arwete_Igoro, Gokwera abanyabibe; 'S'amabera taetaneti' Abake buna nche.
Akabarigi' abanene, As'are kworokereria; Bakamoretera abana, Abake buna nche.
'Monene tabaseretie, Nigo abatigete as'are; Tatigete ond'airane, Omoke buna nche.
Akarw'obogima bwaye, 'Batorie korw'amakweri; Nomobui bw'ogotoria, Abake buna nche.
Abana momwanche bono, Mokore ogwancha kwaye; Momosabe, momobake, Abana buna nche.

hymns.title: Ntwe N'Abana B'Erwoti
verses: 'Ntwe n'abana b'Erwoti, ya Igoro, ya Igoro 'Ntwe n'abana b'Erwoti, Ter' as' orogendo; Yeso omotang'ani Atotebia ntoiroka, 'Mobwatie ang'e ang'e, Ter'as'orogendo.
Twatara kogenda nka, Nka seito, Nka seito, Twatara kogenda nka, Ter' as' orogendo; Gochi 'omochi'otarore, 'S'obotuko botari, Yeso ner'Omobaso, Ter' as' orogendo.
Twarara n'omogoko, 'Mogoko, mogoko; Twarara n'omogoko, Ter' as' orogendo. Twatar' as'orogendo, n'echinkoro chinchenu, Goika toyeror' enka. Ter'as'orogendo.

hymns.title: Rero Krist'Obokire
verses:
Rero Krist'obokire Ha-le-lu-ya!
'Goro n'ense 'tebire Ha-le-Iu-ya
'Geturi Ki'obobui Ha-le-lu-ya!
'Gor'etere 'rise itabe Ha-le-lu-ya!

Moy'Ar'Omonen'oito Ha-le-lu-ya!
Amakweri kai are Ha-le-lu-ya!
Agakwa atotorie Ha-le-lu-ya!
Mbera teri na nguru Ha-le-lu-ya!

'Kobori'ogoikeranu Ha-le-lu-ya!
'Rwanir'esegi_obuire Ha-le-lu-ya!
Makweri tamobueti Ha-Ie-lu-ya!
Kristo oigoire Igoro Ha-le-lu-ya!

Toet'as' aetete Ha-le-lu-ya!
Totuny'Omorai oito Ha-le-Iu-ya!
Korw'ense toirwe Igoro, Ha-le-luya!
Korw'ense toirwe Igoro Ha-le-lu-ya

hymns.title: 'Bana Bagater'Agwo Kare
verses: 'Bana bagater'agwo kare, 'Kero Yes'arinet'etigere; Hosana, Hosana, Hosana Igoro mono.
Nanchete aigwe ogotera, Komotogi'Omorwoti O Igoro ; Hosana, Hosana Hosana Igoro mono.
Natoter'ogoter'okuya, Na baria Omogand'oborigwe; Hosana, Hosana, Hosana Igoro mono.
hymns.refrain: Mater'omogoko, 'Bana bater'amater'omogoko, Mater' omogoko, Yes'anchet'amatera.

hymns.title: Monene Ng'Emeremo
verses: 'Monene ng'emeremo, Nkore as'omogoko; Nonya timbwati nguru, Ko ndigeti'emeremo, 'Mabok'ane neng'ea, Merem'emeke nkore:
Nyegene kand'omoke, Amang'an'a Biblia; Ntare chinchera chiao, Nkore n'ogwancha kwao, 'Nkoro, 'Maboko nkoe, Ngokorer' Omorwoti.
Ninsimek'embusuro, Nkor'emerem'emiya; As'Obwanchani nkonya, Ng'ikeranie nkwegene, Nyorokie ngokorere, 'Meremo korwa bono.
hymns.refrain: 'Monene ng'emeremo, Nkore as'omogoko

hymns.title: Riogi Rie Chibesa
verses: 'Riogi rie chibesa, 'Kero chikogwa; Ker'eyem'as'are, Yes'achiire.
Chikogwa Korwa'as'Amaboko' a bana; 'Keegw'ase Yeso, korw'as' abana.
Bono tor'abake, Twaret'ebike, 'Kero twakinire, Toret'ebinge.
Totari na besa, Tomo' obwanchani, Nabiir'ebi 'ebike, As'Omogoko.
hymns.refrain: Igwa, Igwa, Igwa, Igwa, Buna chikogwa; Ker'eyem'as'are, Yes'achiire.

hymns.title: Nasibiri' Amaboko
verses: Nasibiri'amaboko buya bono mambia; Akor'emeremo ya Yeso goika boire.
Ninyateg'amat'ane, ntegerere buya; Nyigw'eki amabok' an' aranyare gokora.
Amais' an' arend' amabok 'as'emeremo, Tayakor' amabe akore aya Yeso.
hymns.refrain: 'Magor'ane renda 'ase mokong'ira; Mokorere Yeso bwek'emeremo.

hymns.title: Yeso Ningotunyane
verses: Yeso  ningotunyane, Naigur'okorangeria; Nachire nkwegenete, Ondae gochia nka.
Yes' otantang'aneti,  Nigo ndasir'enchera; Nche  n'omwor' omorosu, Aye n'Omonguru.
'Boror'  okoremerwa,  'Bibe mbintang' enchera; Korende nkogotunya, Nimbe n'oboremu.
hymns.refrain: Ningotunyane,  Ningotunyane; Ningotunyane, gochi'as'orandae.

hymns.title: Yes 'Onyanchire Bori
verses: Yes'onyanchire  bori,  Biblia  yantebia; 'Bana bonsi nabaye; 'Re nare n'echinguru.
Yes' okwet' onyanchire,  Nansibi' ebibe biane; 'Nyigorer' ebisieri,  'Rio  nainche  nsoe Igoro.
Yes' onyanchire  mono,  Nony' ekero ndwarete; 'Re  nandende  botambe, Nony' ekero nkorara.
Nabe  nainche  botambe,  'Se  chinchera ngoeta; Nainche  kondamwanche  bo, Nang' ir' enka ya Igoro.
hymns.refrain: Yes'onyanchire,  Yes'onyanchire; Yes'onyanchire, Biblia yantebia.

hymns.title: Er'oyoraremeri' Emechando
verses: Er'oyoraremereri'  emechando, Agenderere  gotuny' Omotoria; Kegocha  tikeri  keramoonchore,   'Tig'eira yaye kob'Omotari.
Abakomorosia  nayar'amake, Bagwetutukania  'R'anyora  'nguru; Takobugwa  rinde,  Narwanigwa  naki,   Nekony' ekiagera Ar' Omotari.
Ay'otorwanerera  n'Omoika,  Twamanyire  omwando  N'obogima; Obobe mbotame, Tinkwobo' ay' abanto, Botuko na mobaso mb'omotari.

hymns.title: Nanyanchete
verses: Nyas'aror'amaber'as'enyoni gekogwa  nse; Onye  bwanchete chinyoni, Nainche nanyanchete.
Ebisicha  bir'ense,  Nyasae  abitonga; Onye  bwanchet'ebisicha,  nainche nanyanchete.
Nyasa'agatonga  bionsi,  chinyoni n'ebisicha; Takweba  abana  baye, Nainche nanyanchete.
hymns.refrain: Nanyanchete,  nanyanchete,  Nainche nanyanchete; Bun'anchet'ebike, Nainche nanyanchete.

hymns.title: Naye? Ninche?
verses: 'Monto  ng'asoe  aria  igoro,  Bwango_iga, Bwango_iga, Abwanch'obonene  bw'aroro;  Naye? Ninche  Naye? Ninche?  Atare  'nchera  chi'edhahabu, Aror'ebinto bi'ogokumia;  Aror'omogok'  obanetwe, Naye? Ninche? Naye? Ninche?

'Monto  ng'asoe  aria  igoro,  Bwango_iga,  Bwango_iga, Mwegenwa  anyorerw'egutwa,  Naye?  Ninche?  Naye? Ninche? 'Monto  ng'amoror' Omogambi,  'Siborwe korw'as'obororo; 'Gok'amo  Ner'agwo  botambe, Naye? Ninche? Naye? Ninche?

'Mont'ature  ko  giasiekirwe,  Bwango_iga,  Bwango_iga, Aigw'eriogi,  ''Tinkomanyeti,"  Naye?  Ninche?  Naye? Ninche? 'Mont'arangerie,  ko  taigugwa,  'Ker'egesieri giasiekirwe; 'Siri'ekeegwa  ki'abachenu,  Naye? Ninche? Naye? Ninche?

'Monto  ng'atere  kabuire,  Bwango_iga,  Bwango_iga, 'Tere  n'omogand'  oborigwe,  Naye?  Ninche?  Naye? Ninche? Ngegu  y'edhahabu  ng'akwanie,'Banchwa bense  batiganete; Agiterwe  as'obonene,  Naye? Ninche?  Naye?  Ninche?

hymns.title: Bwanchani Mbori Bun' obwa Yeso
verses: 'Bwanchani  mbori  bun'obwa  Yeso, Botakoremerwa: Goika  toso'ase  riicho ri'Omoremb'o Nyasae.
'Riso  ndiri  buna  eria  Yeso,  Rikorora  are; 'Motayayi takoru' as' oborabu, Kogosira.
'Riogi  ndiri  buna  eria  Yeso,  Eriansu risera; Bun' eriogi  riensok'  ekwongora,  'Kero Ki'omorakera.
'Nkoro  teri  buna  eya  Yeso, Eichir'obwanchani; Mbori boror' enkor' ekoigwa, Er'atamanyeti.

hymns.title: 'Nse Y'omosalab'o Yeso
verses:
'Nse y'omosalab'o Yeso Ninteneneo, Ekiriri ki'egetare 'S'ense yarosire
Enka ere im'as'eroro Gotimok'enchera, Korwa as'omobaso ogwoka Nemechando rero.
'Boigamo bw'omogoko, Botamer' obuya, Ase obwanchani bore Boumer' oboronge; 'Bagaka batari nenka, Bayenyor' enk'eyio, Nabe omosalaba as'ende, Engasi ya Igoro.
'Nse yekiriri kiaye Ensemo moino, Nere embera y'obwoba Er'entamb' engare; Gati yait' omosalaba, 'Mabok' ay'amboirie, Buna omorendi as' enchera, Korw' embera eyio.
'Gor' asomosalaba Amais' an' arora, Ekieni ki'Omotori'one Onchandekerete; Nkor' eichire namariga 'Makumia abere, 'Makumia y'obwanchani bwaye, N'ogotaisana kwane.

hymns.title: 'Monene Nare ime Y'Ekalu
verses:
'Monene nare_ime y'Hekalu,
'Monene nare_ime y'Hekalu,

'Ns'ekire, 'Ns'ekire, as'Are.

hymns.title: Nar'ase Y'obotimoko
verses: Nar'ase yobotimoko, Ang'e na Nyasae; 'Gw'ebibe mbikogochanda, Ange na Nyasae.
Nar' as' okoremi 'okuya, Ang'e na Nyasae, 'Gwo toumer' Omotoria, Ang'e na Nyasae.
Nar' as' obosibore, Ang'e na Nyasae, 'S'omogoko n'omorembe, Ang'e na Nyasae.

hymns.title: Monene Ninkoigwete
verses: Monene ninkoigwete, Nganyet' eng'ana yao, Nyigwet' okwane ondemie; 'Monene kwana bono; Ningotegererete, As' ari' onsi orantebie.
Monen' onyator' erieta, Eri' omonye nase nde, Kwana nainche ntunye bwango, Ndemete nsibogete; 'S' Omorisi' ararae, 'Kiriri Ki' egetare.
Nonya nd' omoke, ochayire, Tonseri 'otanyigweti, Monene nomanyet' onsi, Ayar' enkoro yane; Nomanyet' okogania, Kwana eri' onsesenie.
Monene Kwan' ombek' ang'e, Riogi riao riigweke, 'S' okoigwera n' omogoko, Nimbwati' eng'ana yao; Monene ninkoigwete, Koranche kwana nainche.

hymns.title: Bono Bwairire
verses:
Bono bwairire Riagorobire;
Tobiswe naende 'Mosunte_ime.

Bono natorore Ching'enang'eni;
Ebitongwa bionsi Nkorara bire.

Renda abarwaire N'abakoromwa;
'S'amaber'amange Tiga tomiamie.

Ase obotuko 'Malaik'ao,
Bache batorende Gatwararire.

Erio agwo mambia Gatokoboka,
Tore abachenu 'S'obosio bwao.

hymns.title: Mogoroba Kobwairire
verses: Mogoroba kobwairire, Abarwaire bachire, Ang'e naye Omonene, Basabire obakonye.
Naintwe bono mogoroba, Twachire n'obob'obonge, Nonya titokorochi aye, Twamanyire nao ore.
Omotoria seri'obwoba, 'Bande nabarwaire bare, 'Bande mbaragwancha buya, Abande babosiririe,
'Nde tari nogotimoka, Taiy'otakoreti ebibe, 'Bakogokorera buya Beigwa mbanyabibe bare.
'Koboko kwao nkwa nguru, Ng'ana yao tekogwa bosa, Igwa bono mogoroba, Ase obuya togwenie.

hymns.title: Ntor'as' Orogendo
verses:
Ntor' as' orogendo, Kogenda igoro,
'Bomenyo bw'abaya, Mogokobotambe.

Ase ense eria, Mbareo 'bachenu,
Tibari gwechanda, Gose gochandeka.

'Bisieri chindwaki, Bikomekameka,
Mwateba timori, Kogenda igoro.

Nainw'abatayayi, Igoro neyaino,
Mwateba timori, Kogenda igoro.
