hymns.title: Yeso Atotebia Tomoreke
verses: Yeso atotebia tomoreke, Bun'etay' ekomoreka botuko; Ense nomosunte 'Gotorabe agw'as'ore Nainch'ase nde.
Yeso atotebia tomoreke, Arore obororabu tiborima; Korwa igor' arora, 'Gatorabe agw'as'ore Nainch'asende.
Yeso atotebia tomoreke, 'Mosunt' Oetananire ens'engima; 'Bibe nobororo, 'Gatorabe agw'as'ore Nainch'asende.

hymns.title: Abang'ina Bakareta Abana
verses:
Ker'abang'ina baretera Yes'abana, 'Borokigwa'as'obotindi bakabaseria;
Yes'akarora bagotama'agateba n'obwororo, "Aban'abake nabach'ase nde."
'Nimbaire mbabogori' as'egekuba kiane, Mb'Omorisia bwe ching'ondi tagochiseria; Kobarang'e chinkoro chiabo mbameny' as' Obonene, "Aban' abake nabach'ase nde."
'Motori 'Omuya Okoarigani'abana, Mbar' abange batamanyeti rieta riaye; 'Motori' Omuya toigwe gotogosaba otebe, 'Aban' abake nabach'ase nde.
Bwango tig'abanto b'ebisaku nechinse, Bach'ase Yeso batugute chisanamu; Nabarab' erio bakomanye Nyasae bw' obwanchani, Beger' Omotoria bach' as' ore.

hymns.title: Nkarora Omonto Orosete
verses: Nkarora  ase  enchera,  Omont' oyom' orosete, Akabwati'  Omosalaba  Bun' omogendi  omuya; Orosire,  nechingiki  chichire  obosio  bwaye, "Ng'ai  kwarusi' Omokia"?  agantebia "Okwegena".
Na oyomo  nkamorora  Ne ritimo  na  enguba, Akarwana  nechinguru  Eri'anyore  egutwa;  Nonya orosire  mono;  Tachieti  kwemurungania, "Ng'ai kwarusi' omokia?" Agantebia "Okwegena."
Nar' oyom'  otiget' abasani  Bobosae  bwaye, 'Gatig'  esiko  n'emegoko  Atar'as'obokong'u, Nony'amatemw' areo  'Koroki'omosasok'  obosio, "Ng'ai kwarusi'omokia?" Agantebia "Okwegena."
Bun' abaeti as' orogendo  As'ense'eye yebibe, Gochaywa, 'bokong'u,  nogosikwa, Nonya nas'embera, Goika  Omogambi ache 'Toire  ntw'abasakore nka, 'Nki  kiabaeire Omokia'?  Neke  gioka,  "Okwegena"

hymns.title: Abanto Emeganda
verses: Abanto emeganda, Ne chianga chindabu, Barina ase amare, Kogenda Igoro; Bakorir'okorwana, N'ebibe bi'ens'eye, Ebisieri mbimanorwe, 'Babui basoe.
Batera Aleluya! Ense na Igoro, Amariogi y'amakano, Arari'obobui; Rituko ri'omogoko 'S'ebitongwa bionsi, Emechando n'amakweri, Biaerire bono.
Rituk'erio abaya, Nabaumerane, Abakwete n'abasani, Tibagotigana; Amais' onsi ng'arabe, Amarig' asire, Chintakana nachinyore, Abaibori babo.
Reta ogotereka, Ngwakweret' ababe, Kora Korika ebuku, Inchwo eri' ogambe; Ika ay' Omonene, 'Banto mbaganyete, Oroki' ekemanyererio, Mogambi Omotoria.

hymns.title: Mogambi One
verses: Mogambi_one  ninkobake, 'Bonene nobwao, Tinyeb'egutwa  y'amagwa,  Ndae goika Kalwari.
Nyoroki'embera  Kwaraire,  Buna beumetie; 'Malaika  bakarenda,  Ekero kwaraire.
Nainche  bun'ere  Mariamu,  Nchiche n'ekeegwa; Nyorokie  oboina  bwasie, Ndae_goika Kalwari.
Omonene  nimbogorie,  'Mosalaba  rioka; Nsange  emechando  yaye, Kwambogoreirie_onsi.
hymns.refrain: Tinyeba  Gethesemane,  inyeb'emechando  yao; Tinyeb'obwanchani  bwao,  Ndae  goika Kalwari.

hymns.title: Nkwegenete Omonene Yeso
verses: Nkwegenet' Omonene Yeso Aye bweka; Nkwegen' as' ogotorek' okonene.
Nkwegenet' as' okwabera Ningosasime; As'obuya n'amabera amaya, Nkwegene.
Ninkwegenete Ondae Naye bweka_igo; Amatuko onsi Nong'isanekie.
Ninkwegen' ase chinguru chiao chitagwe; Amang'ana ao Okorua Nabue.
Nkwegen' Omonene Yeso Totiga ngwe nse; Ninkwegene rioka rioka Botambe.

hymns.title: Ntang'ane Omotoria
verses: Ntang'ane Omotoria. 'Merindo y' obogima; Neruma bosio bwane, 'Bitare nabintuba, Bimbise Korw'as'Ore, Ntang'ane Omotoria.
Nokirie emerindo, Buna ng'ina Omwana 'Merindo nekoigwere. Korayetebie 'Kira, 'Omogambi bw' enyancha, Ntang 'ane Omotoria.
Ngoika ang'e n'engegu, 's'emerind' ekoruma; sende n'omotimoko, Ko nyeegeget' as'ore, Ninkoigwe Kogontebia. "Toiroka ninkorae."

hymns.title: Yeso n'Omotoria Bw'ogokumia
verses:
Yeso  n'Omotori' are  bw'ogokumia; Noyo bw'ogokumi' ase  nde;
Abis' enkoro  yan' as' egetare; 'Se chindoche chi'omogoko.
Yeso  n'Omotori'are  bw'ogokumia; Nig'agotang' emechando; Ambogoria  ase amabok' aye; Ang'a chinguru botambe.
Ansesenia  nebisi'ebinge  mono; Ang' ichoria  n'obochenu; Kanaonchoirwe ninter' omogano; Bw' Omoboria on'Omuya.
Karambisi' Oborabu  anyimokie; Toumeran' as' amare; Ntogie Ogotoreka n'obwanchani;  N' emeganda  y'abachenu.
hymns.refrain: 'Bisir'enkoro  ime  y'egetare, 'S  'ekiriri  ens 'enyomo; 'Bisir'enkoro 's'obwanchani  bwaye, Na  gontuba n'okoboko, Na gontuba n'okoboko.

hymns.title: Yeso n'Omasani On'are
verses: Yeso  n'Omosani  on'are,  Nere  bionsi  ase  nde; 'S'enkoro  yane  nabuete  bonsi;    Nig'are bun 'egesicha  kie  rigok'ase  nde;  'Kinganetie nsibigwe  mb'omogima. 'S'  obor'andemia, 's'emechand  'ambisia; Antebia  motwek' amakong'u onsi.

Er' ondusiri'  ogwechanda,  N'obororo  bwane; Nere  obotamer'  as'  amatemwa.    Natugutire bionsi  pi, Nony' emebwekano  Korw' enkoro er' or'omorendi,  one. 'Nse  yonsi  yanyangire, Na  saitani  antema; Konde  na  Yeso  nimb' omobui.

Yaya  ere  tagontiga,  Gose Kombwatoka  Ko mwegenete  na  komokorera  Ongiteire  n'omorero, Tinkwoboa  kende; 'Nyigotirie  n'endagera  ya Igoro, Ninso'as  obonene,  Ndor'obosio  bwaye; 'Se  chindoche  chiomogoko  chire.
hymns.refrain: Ner'egesicha  ekiya, Ng'enang'eni endabu; 'S' enkoro yane nabuete bonsi.

hymns.title: Mbigusuigwe Aria Kalwari
verses: Bororo,  gwechand' okonge,  Biarosia chinkoro, Mbigusuigwe  aria  Kalwari, Yeso  nare  ang'e.
Tigera  Yes'onsi  rero,  Bwoba n'ogwechanda, Mbigusuigwe  aria Kalwari, Yeso nare ang'e.
Mochandeku  Yes' Arora,  mechando, mariga, Mbigusuigwe  aria  Kalwari, Yeso nare ang'e.
hymns.refrain: Mbigusuigwe  aria  Kalwari,  Kalwari, Kalwari, Mbigusuigwe  aria  Kalwari, Yeso nare ang'e.

hymns.title: Ndw' Obosibwa Nas' Emechando
verses: Ndw' obosibwa  nas' emechando  Nche  nachire Yer' as' ore, S' obosibore  nomogoko  Yeso  nagocheire; Ndw' as' Oborwaire 'Rio  ngwenigwe  Ndw' obotaka 'Rio  ntenetakigwe Ntig'ebibe Nchiche  as' ore, Yeso nagocheire.

Ndw'as'obosoku  bw'ogosinywa  Nche  nachire Yes'as'ore, Nyor'Obuya  bw'omosalaba,  Yeso nagocheire; Ndw'as'obororo  ombogorie,
Ntimoke nemorindo  yense, Ndw'as'obokong'u  ntere  ngoke, Yeso nagocheire.

Ndw' as' obotindi  Nogwekaga  Nche  nachire Yes' as' ore, Erio  nkor' okogania  Kwao,  Yeso nagocheire; Nyetige  meny' as' obwanchani, Nyimoke ntig' ogokw' omoyo, Nyiruruke  buna  riruma  Yeso nagocheire.

Ndwe  as'obwoba  bw'amakweri,  Nche  nachire Yes' asore, 'S'omogok'  oborabu  bwa  nka  Yeso nagocheire; Ntam'obosareku  ntatebe  Nyor' omoremb' ase  riicho, Ndor' obosio  bwa' obosera  Yeso  nagocheire.

hymns.title: Mbwat' Omorisia
verses: Mbwat' Omorisia Oyonyanchete; Ansesenia nche Ntanyare kwera; 'S'Omosalab' agachandek' agakwa; Erio menye as'obwanchani bwaye.
'Borisi' obonge aru' ase tore; Mache aeta ng'ora ase' nde, 'Buya n'amabera bintunya nchera; Tinkoremerwa kare nainche.
Kondatayaye nsire enchera; Ere nang'use' ng'iranie nchera, Nonya nobokong'u Nche tinkwoboa; Morisi' Omuya Nandende rioka.
Merem' eere Rogendo boigo; Ere nandae gochia Bwone nka, Agw'ase ndamenye 'Mogoko bori; Nabanchwa ase Amagor' Aye.
hymns.refrain: Gotunya Yeso kera rituko; Kende nkegonsaria kare nainche; 'Mosunte gose omobaso; Yes'omorisi' one nere bionsi.

hymns.title: Mang'an' Omonw'one
verses:
Mang'an'omonwa'one,
Nebirengererio bi'enkoro,
Biancherwe ase ore,
Naye chinguru n'Omotoria,
Amen.

hymns.title: Ter' Ogotera Okuya
verses: Ter'ogotera okuya, Ret' amasari' amaya; Seria omoichano bwonsi, 'S'ogotogi 'okonene; Moterer 'otorendire, Koumer' abasani; 'Riogi riaye ritwegeria, Ncher' as' amagor' aye.
'S'omogoko ter'orabe, Ntoike rituk' erio; Twora Hosan'omogoko, Erio tomosasime; Toter' obonene Bwaye 'Moki'ebirengererio; Teb' omogano o kare, Bwanchani bw'ogotoria.
O mbuya! Tat' Omochenu, 'S'amabera y'omwaka; Gotok'ase ker' enkoro, 'Gotogia gw'ekeenee; O mbuy' Omotori' Omwanchwa!', Gontori' as' amanyinga; Totweri' Omoik' Omochenu, Tong'us'ase Nyasae.
hymns.refrain: Tera Ogotera 'Gotera kw'omogoko; (Tera Ogotera) Tera Ogotera, Kona kw'obobui; (Tera Ogotera)

hymns.title: Obonene Ase Tata
verses:
Obonen' ase Tata, n'Omwana,
N'Omoik'Omochenu,
Buna Yar'omochakano,
Nab'ere goika kare.
Amen

hymns.title: Borabu Ndae
verses: Borabu ndae as' omoichano, Ndae rioka, Obotuko, ng'arende korwa nka, Ndae rioka, Ndend' amagoro; Timboreti korora egeka, Kogoro okomo kong'isane.
Tinanarete iga, gosaba ng'a, Ay'ondae Nigo nanchete gochor' ayane, Bono ndae; Ngancha omogoko ko inde omwoba, Nkaenena, Toinyor' ayaetire.
Chinguru chiao chiansesenirie, Nchindae rioka As'amanani nas' emerindo, Goika bokie Kobwakire, 'Malaika bagoka, 'Banyanchete ko bansireirie ake.

hymns.title: Gosira Korw'ase Yeso
verses: Gosira korw'ase Yeso, Gochia ase abe; Gosira botuko 'Mobaso, Gosira aye bweka.
Gosira korw' ase Yeso, 'Yorakogusuyie; Gosira botuko 'mobaso, Gosira korwa as'Are.
Gosira korw' ase Yeso, kogenda moeneno; Gosira botuko 'mobaso, Gochia 'ngongo chi'obobe.
Gosira korw' ase Yeso, Malaika beumia; Ning'otera' somogoko, korw' as' endib' etambe.
hymns.refrain: Gosira korw'ase Yeso, korw'obwanchani bwaye; Ng'ora eker'agokorangeria, Ngosir'ore korw'as'Are.

hymns.title: Totere Bono
verses: Totere  bono  totere  n'omogoko. 'S'egek'egeke  ntoike  seito; 'Kanisa  entigari  nero erabue, 'S'egek'egeke' ntoike seito.
Tokore  bon'emeremo  n'amaboko, 'S'egek'egeke  ntoike  seito; 'Buya  bwa  Tata nabotoe chinguru, 'S'egek'egeke ntoike seito.
Abw'abarosu  tonyare  kobaremia, 'S'egek'egeke  ntoike  seito; Natoboroki' abareu obwanchani, 'S'egek'egeke ntoike seito.
'Mogoko  ang'e ore  n'ogotima, 'S'egek'egeke  ntioke  seito; N 'amariga takob' as'omochi'oria,  'S'egek'egeke  ntoike seito.
hymns.refrain: Ee  nabo  bwango,  Ee  nabo  bwango,   Natoike  Igoro, Natobaror' abatigari  ba  Yeso, 'S'egek'egeke ntoike seito.

hymns.title: Mobake Nyasae
verses:
Mobake Nyasae, Mogambi ore Igoro; Oyore' emiaka yonsi, Omwanchanii;
'Monene Yehova, Ense na Igoro; Twaribak' erieta riao, Ribakwe bo.
Mobake Nyasae, 's' ogochika kwaye; Ndw' as'ense ndigi' Omogoko, As' ar'ere; Ntige bionsi ebiense, 'Bonene, chisemii; Mokor' ere bweka koba, 'Nguba yane.
Omoganda bwensi, Mobake Nyasae; Tata, Omwana n'Omoika, 'Kero gionsi; Motogie Nyasae, Mbwatisi'aba Igoro; 'Bonene bwensi n'obwao, N'ebako bo.

hymns.title: Egetunwa Nkere Are
verses: Egetunwa nkere are, Getabwati orwaki; As'Omonen' abambetwe, 'Gakwa Atotorie.
Kegima titokomanya, 'Boror' Anyorete; Korende igo twegenete, Nintwe Akwerete.
'Gakwa tonyor' okwaberwa, Atokor' abaya; Omoeri' Atoire Igoro, 'Manying' Atotorie.
Taiy' ond' orenge konyara, Goakan'esira; Ner'oigoret' egesieri, Kia-Igoro tosoe
hymns.refrain: O ng'aki_Atwachete bori, Naintwe natomwache; Tosemeri' amanyinga' aye, Nakomokorera.

hymns.title: Inwe Abarwani Mweroisie
verses:
Intwe abarwani, Mbweroisie kegima,
Mobe noboremu, Mogende nomokia.

Nonya bono segi, Mobe nokwegena,
Oyo 'barangerie, Nare amo ninwe.

Gaki motenene, Mobe nokwegena.
Moyetache ense, Omosunte bwonsi.

Gaki motenene, Mobe nokwegena
Moyetache ense; Omosunte bwonsi.

Nabae chiguru; mogese kegima,
Timoba 'batamu; Ase 'segi ime.

Rigori mokobua; Ne chinguru chiaye,
Igoro mogende, Nobonene mono.

hymns.title: Nar'Omosani Onyanchete
verses: Nar' Omosani _onyanchete, Kobua bonsi ab'ens'eye; Nere Kristo Omochenu, Omonen' Ere n'oyone.
N'oyon'Are ekiagera, Ankweret'erio ntoreke; 'S'omogoko 'mosasime, Nimobak'Ere n'oyone.
Ig' Ar' oyone ekiagera, Are ime y'enkoro yane; Bun'orosagia rw'omote, Nde_ime yay' Ere n'oyone.
Ituk' erim' ase chinchera, Chia_Igoro nimoror' Ere; K'amboanirie nintere, 'S'egeturi_Ere n'oyone.

hymns.title: Mobake Omonda Yeso
verses: Mobake Omonda Yeso, Mo'ekengw'anso bono, Er'otwabeir'ebibe Omogwenia oito; Momobake, momobake, Omogambi botambe.
Mobake as'obwanchan Aorogeti' ens'eye, Mobak' Ere botambe, Otosibiri' ebibe; Momobake, momobake, Ner'Oyo bw'ekeene.
Buna Tat'ogotorenda Ere otomanyire, Atotaboria rioka Korw'ase ababisa; Momobake, momobake, Abar'ang'e na aare.
Amalaika mobake, Inwe morochaine, Erioba n'omotienyi ikomotung'amera; Momobake, momobake, Yes' Omond' O Igoro.

hymns.title: Ndater'Ase Yeso
verses:
Ndater' ase Yeso, As' obuya bwaye, Nigo nkonyora ogosesenigw' as' are;
Natoter' ase Yeso ekengw'anso kiaye, Aiteret' amanyinga Omokonyi one.
Ndater'ase Yeso amatuko onsi, Kondanyare koinyor' obuya bwaye bwonsi; Ndater' ase Yeso nony' as' emechando, Ere nandende ase amaboko Aye.

Ndater'ase Yeso, Gonkogend'enchera, Ning'use orogendo, ng'ike asare;
Nainche ninsoe egesieri keria, Nimoterere Yeso, Igoro botambe.

hymns.title: Ense Engiya
verses: Gochi' as'ens'engiya ng'umbu, Malaika bagotera, Haleluy' as' Omotoria, Hosan' as'Omogambi; Togotara noboremu, Tokoragwa na Tata, Korw' ense y'ebibe nobororo goch'ens' engiya.
'Bachenu bande mbachit'as'en'eyio riria kare, 'Ngaki bono yaerire, Erio naintwe tosoe; Ntogende bosio rioka, Tobe nabwo batorigwe, Ntotogi' Erieta riaye botamb' as'ens'eyi' engiya.
As'ens'eyio obomenyo bwarosigw'ase bonsi, 'Ba begenet' Omotoria na koigw'eriogi riaye; 'Ngaki y'omogoko ngoch'er'Omonen' arachike, Toyetig' ense ey'embe, Togend' as'ense' eri' engiya.
hymns.refrain: Omogoko togoika. Natobeke chigutwa; As' ens'eria engiya, As' ens' eyi' engiya ng'umbu.

hymns.title: Abakoreri B'Enchili
verses: Inyora abaisraeli, Bakemurunganeria Musa; Ndamwamu ya Nyasa' egacha, Bagasirera as'eroro.
'Moik' omochenu abarae, Timobek'endamwamu bosio; As' ogochor' abakoreri. Toma Enchili ense yonsi.

Abachorwa b'obokoreri, Timomenya Yerusalemu; Mwarangerigwe Makedonia, genda, o erio mobakonye.
'Monene Yeso'oranerie, 'Bange bakur' as' ebibe! 'Manying' abo narigigw' as' ore, Otachieti eri'obokonye.
Mbwanchani bwa kerengo ki obo? 'Monene gokwa igoro yaito; Erio tonyare koborigwa, 'Babe twabeir' abana baye.
hymns.refrain: Datani, Kora, Abiiraimu, 'S'endamwamu y'oborai; Rikamanoka bakarimera, Nekiorokeren'ase tore.

hymns.title: 'S' Emambia Y'okobokigwa
verses:
'S'emambia yokobokigwa, getureri nkebuge,
Ntoboke (Halleluya) Ntoboke. 'Bachenu mbachenge gocha,
'mariga takobao, Ntoboke (Halleluya! 'emambi eyio Natoboke) Ntoboke.

'Semambia yokibokigwa naki' Mogand'orabe!
Ntoboke (Halleluya) Ntoboke.
Tata, Baba, Banchwa bonsi, kero torarorane,
Ntoboke (Halleluya 'emambi'eyio Natoboke) Ntoboke.

'Semambia yokobokigwa 'Birengereri'ebiya,
Ntoboke (Halleluya) Ntoboke.
 Morore Motori 'omwanchwa, Bwerwete agankwera,
 Ntoboke (Halleluya' mambieyio Natoboke) Ntoboke.

'Semambia yokobokigwa, Ntoumeran' amare,
Ntoboke (Halleluya) Natoboke.
Ntoirwe as'obonene' s'enk'engiy'ekomesa,
Ntoboke (Halleluya! Mambi'eyio Natoboke) Ntoboke.
hymns.refrain:
(Ntoboke) Halleluya (Ntoboke) Amen
Ntoboke (Halleluya)! 'S'embambia yokobokigwa
Ker'amakweri_arabugwe,
Ntoboke (Halleluya 'mambi'eyio Natoboke) Ntoboke.

hymns.title: Omochie Omuya Zayoni
verses:
'Mochi'omuya nore aria ng'umbu, '
Makweri taiyo nonya mbororo,
Yeso Tata ng'ir'aria Zayoni
As'agiy'omogoko botambe,
As'agiy'omogoko botambe,

'Mochi'omuya, (Zayoni) Zayoni
n'omochie bw'abachenu; (Zayoni)
Tomenye o, (Tomenye)
Tobe n'omogok'omonge mono,
Yeso Tata ng'ir'aria Zayoni,
Yeso tata ng'ir'aria Zayoni.

Abarameny'omochi'o Zayoni,
Mbaria babegete 'yanga ndabu
Yeso ner'orab'omobaso' obo,
Botuko mbokoba o naende,
Botuko mbokoba o naende.

Nkarigereri'omochi'O zayoni,
Nkaba n'okogania 'nso'aroro;
Yes'ombwat' okoboko Onyimokie
Erio nsoe omoch' O Zayoni
Erio nsoe omochi o Zayoni

Yeso mbwate, (koboko)
'Koboko nso'omochi'O Zayoni;
Zayoni Nyimokie nche (Nyimokie)
Ng'ikarans'okoboko kwao
Yeso Tata ng'ir'aria (Zayoni)
Yeso Tata ng'ir'aria Zayoni.

hymns.title: 'S' Eri'eta Ria Yeso
verses: 'S'Erieta ria Yeso, 'S'Erieta ria Yeso; Ntore Nobobui!
'S'Erieta ria Yeso, 'S'Erieta ria Yeso; Saitani natame!

'Ng'oratobue, Togwatora Eriet'eri rinene?
Yeso; Yeso; Yeso; Yeso! "Ntore N'obobui"

hymns.title: 'Botuk' Obochenu
verses:
'Botuk'Obochenu, 'Boser'Oborabu
Bor'ase ng'ina n'omwana,
'Mwan'omochenu Omoitongo,
'Raire n'omorembe,
'Raire n'omorembe,

'Botuk 'Obochenu, 'Borabu bwachire,
'Malaika bagotera;
A lleluyah 's'omogambi!
Oiboirw'Omotoria,
Oiboirw'Omotoria.

Botuk'obochenu Omwan'oNyasae.
'Borabu bwarwa as'are;
Bogotori 'as 'obuya,
Oiboirw'Omonene,
Oiboirw'Omonene.

'Botuk'obochenu, Ng'enang'eni raba
Totere n'amalaika;
Alleluya 'Mogambi!
Oiboirw'Omotoria,
Oiboirw'Omotoria.

hymns.title: Kira Tegerera
verses:
Kira  tegerera,  'Kemonyo  nkere,
Kira tegerera, Toigwe ring'ana.

Kira  tegerera,  N'achen_as'aa,
'Matabau_atebe Ng'ana ri'obuya.

Kira  tegerera,  Torw'ogosaba,
Tun'ay'Edeni, Tosange amo.

Kira  tegerera,  Amaber'Aye,
Kira  tegerera,  Gany'Omonene.
hymns.refrain:
Tara  ng'or'Omonene  nao  Are  aa,
Tara ng'or'Ateba, Tosuke ang'e.

hymns.title: Twarema Emegondo
verses:
Twarema emegondo, Na koyebusura,
 Nyasae orw'embura, N'oborendi obuya;
 Areta riberera, Areta 'mbokendu,
'Mbe'engiya n'omobaso, N'embura y'okwamia

Mbuya, Tat'Omwachani, As'amaya onsi,
Risimeka, rigesa, 'Bogima, 'ndagera;
 Ntobwati ebitorarwe, As'obwancham obo,
Ko ekioganeti'Aye, Ne chinkoro chiato.

Titokoba 'abande, Bun'Er'atoeire!
Tobakony'abanto, Kogenda Igoro;
Torw'esadaka yaito, Yangoyi 'abotomwa,
 Bwa Kristo im'as'ense, N'ogotoreka bo.
hymns.refrain:
Ebiegw'ebiya, Nigoro bikorwa,
Mbuya, Mbuy' as'Omonene, 's'obwanchani bwaye.

hymns.title: Yeso Nguru Chiane
verses:
Yeso nguru chiane,
Nko' ogwenchanda kwane;
Nkwegen'as 'obokanyeku,
 ''Gw'ogosaba kwane.

Ing'enkor'engiya,
Erio nyeange nche;
Tintara chinchera chimbe,
Na tingoki'amabe.

Ing'enkor'endemu,
 'S'emechando yonsi;
Nyoteneni' Omosalaba,
 'Nyorende bokong' u.

Ing'ogokoiroka,
N'eriso eriongo;
Gokorigereria Aye,
 K'ebibe bir'ange.

Ong'e na Omoika,
Ore ang'e rioka;
'Y'orendet'ekero gionsi,
Ase ogosaba.

hymns.title: 'Ng'ana y'Omonene
verses:
'Ng'ana y'Omonene, 'Torae botambe,
Oyoriegenete, Nanyor'Omogoko.

'Babisa mbabao, Ntonyore chinguru,
'Ng'ana ri'okoremia, 'Ret'ogotoreka.

K'emerind'egocha, N'aimar'atotuba,
'Ng'ana riao ribe, Eng'ay'as'enchera.

Ng'oranyare kwera, 'Mogok'ore naki,
Oyotwanyorire, Korw'ase ring'ana?

'Ng'ana y'amabera, As'abare moyo,
Rikorw'oboremu, Ase abagokwa.

Gatwamanyire bo, Obochenu bwaye;
Togwanch'Omonene, Tobe naye rioka.

hymns.title: Yes' Otorangeirie
verses:
Yes'Otorangeirie Korwa,
'S'egeturi gi'ens'eye;
Botambe nkorangeri'are,
"Omokristo ntunyana".

Naki_aborokigwa baye,
Mbaigwet' okorangeria;
Bagatig'ebinto bionsi,
Babakorer'abande.

'Torangeirie totige osasim 'emegwekano;
Ateba ''Mokristo nyanche mono kobua ense".

'Torangeiri'as'amabera,
Tokony'erio tokoigwe;
Tokoigwere na kogwancha,
 Togokorere buya.

hymns.title: 'Malaika A Nyasae Bamenye
verses:
As' orogendo rwaito rwonsi,
Omonene, Omonene,
Natotang'ane botambe As'ens'eye.
hymns.refrain:
O rire ri'omorero, rire ri'omorero,
Ntang'ana inche botambe
O rire ri'omorero, rier ri'omorero,
Ntang'ana goika igoro.

hymns.title: 'Moe Yes'ebibe Biane
verses:
'Moe Yes'ebibe biane, 'Ng'ondi ya Nyasae,
'Bibogori'antimokie, Korw'as'emechando.

'Moe 'Kogania Kwane, Oyo bw'oboikeranu,
Angwenia Oborwaire, Abori'omoy'one.

'Moe 'bororo bware, N'ogwechanda gwonsi,
Nansibore Korwa o, 'Sange nainche onsi.

Nganetie mobwekane, 'Mwororo, 'moitongo,
Ngwekane buna Yeso, Omwan'O Nyasae.

hymns.title: 'Monene Ituko Riaerire
verses:
'Monene_ituko riaerire,
Obotuko bwaikire;
Natokobake n'ogotera,
 'Motimok'osesenirie.

Twairanirie buya'as'ore,
'Kanisa yao terairi;
Nig'erendete'asens'engima,
'Botuko n'omobaso bo.

Igor'as'ebisinka bionsi,
Boira, bwakia kera rituko;
'Riogi ri'ogosaba ndiereti,
Nonya neriogokobaka.

Borwoti bwao mbokoera,
 Buna amanda y'ens'eye;
Mbokine rioka goika Kare,
Bana bao bair'omwando.

hymns.title: Nimenye As' Egetunwa
verses:
Moinyore 'mosalaba, 'Monene abambetwe,
Ase emechando y'ense, Atworokie enchera;
Monene 'torangeirie, Yoimokie 'mosalaba,
Nakoroseirie 'nchera, Oraike Igoro.

hymns.title: Oyo, Nere, Ngoik' Are
'Kwegena Kw'Abatata
verses:
'Kwegena kwa abatata! Nonya bachandetwe moko,
Chinkoro chiaito chiagoka, Gotwaigure ring'an erio,
Okwegena ogochenu! Ntwegene goik' amakweri.

'Batata ase chichela 'Basibor' ase chinkoro,
Mogoko ki abana babo, Baisa gokwa bun'abaise,
Okwegena ogochenu! Ntwegene goik' amakweri.

'Kwegwena kwa abatata! Ntwanch' abasani, babisa,
Ntorandie Yeso kobua; 'S'obogima n'amang'ana,
Okwegena ogochenu! Ntwegene goik' amakweri.

hymns.title: Agwo Kare Yes' Omwanchani
verses:
Agwo  kare  Yes'Omwanchani,  Akoroki'ense  obonene Bwaye,
Akarina  etiger'emori,  Agw'abana  bagatera, Hosana.

Oyi'Omorwoti obachire,  Nere Omworor'okworokereria,
Akarina  etiger'emori, 'Banto bakarabi'enchera, Hosana.

Tiger'ekagenda igor'ase  chianga,  N'amat'amakendo bamwarerete,
Omochi'omogi'ogategokana,  Ng  'oyio mogotogiamono, Hosana.

'Bagak'emioyo  yabo  teri  miya, Tibancheti  baegwe ogosikwa,
Bateba  teri  buy'Omonene,  Baigwe  buna bagotera, Hosana.

Ogotogia kogaikeranigwa,  Nab'abana  bagotera Hosana,
Ogotogia  kogaikeranigwa,  Nab'abana bagotera, Hosana.
hymns.refrain:
Hosan'Asare, Hosan'Aleluya;  Otocheir'as'Erieta  ri 'Omonene,
'S'Are  Hosana 'bare  igoro  mono; Kristo n'Omwan'o Daudi, Hosana.

hymns.title: Nyasae Oito N'orwaki
verses:
Nebirecha bikaer' enseye, 'Ganyete gotosiria,
Titwayabeka 'mayo ime, Titogotobua 'ntwe;
'Mogambi 'gosania. Naba bun' arabe,
Takonyara nonya, Nakio erikeire; "Ring'ana" narimoite.

Biblia se chinguru chiabo, Tageka tekoera,
'Nki'nkeba goikebue, Nyasae arigete bweka;
Nachitour' obogima, Nibo, bana, Nyomba,
Ng'eria yabo nenke; Bionsi nabisire o Nyasae otigare.

hymns.title: Ari' As' Obweri
verses:
Ari' as obweri borere mbwareo,
Omwana oyo Yeso nao araire,
Ching'enang'eni chikainomoreka,
Ase Yes'arareret' obonyansi.

Chiombe chikwana chiatura Omwana,
Ko Omwana Yeso tari korera;
Nche ningwanchete Yeso ndigererie,
 Mbesieyeso goika mambia bokie,

Mbere ang'Omonene nasabire,
Ombwate, Onyanche nagosabire;
Osesenie abana orendete,
 Nario toragwener' agwo igoro.

hymns.title: Natotere Bono Buya
verses:
Natotere bono buya, Ogotera ok'obuya,
Yeso Obuete ebibe, Otokorire boronge.

Nonya twanyor'as'ens'eye, 'Mechando n'ogotemwa,
Ring'an'eri narisane, Otokorire boronge.

Na Ka Yeso andangeirie, Kogenda Igor'as'are,
Nin'ter'ogoter'okoyia, Otokorire boronge.
hymns.refrain:
Okobua, ebinto bionsi, Tera ig'abanto bonsi,
Yeso Obuete ebibe, Otokorire boronge.

hymns.title: Tom' Omobaso
verses:
Tom 'omobaso 'mobas 'omuya,
 Omorek'ens'oseri 'emechando,
Abaminto bonsi baganyete;
Tom'omobas 'Omuya.

Tom'omobaso rituko rionsi,
Ebisio nabisoe ase nde,
Onde Tatoa tatiga Yeso,
Tom'omobas'omuya,

Tom'omobas'emiaka yonsi;
 Goika Yes'airane ase ense,
Erio twensi natogende Igoro,
Tom'omobas'omuya.
hymns.refrain:
Tom 'omobas 'omuya, Tom'omobas 'omuya,
Tom'omobaso tom'omobaso; Tom'omobas'Omuya,

hymns.title: Intw' Abarwani B' Omonene
verses:
Intw'  abarwani  b'Omonene  Oyore  nokobua
Twarir'eira y'okorwania, Mobere n'ebibe.

'Baminto  mwensi  motenene, As'ebender'eye,
Togende  amo  n'Omonene, Omorwoti O igoro.

'Kemanyererio  twanyorire.  'Kero  ki'ebatiso
Bamura n'abaiseke mwensi, Moinyore Kristo.

Timwancha  mobe  abasomab'omorwoti bw'ense,
'Moik'O  Nyasae  nabarae, Timorengereria.

Mogende  amo  n'ogosaba, Moramoki'amaiso,
'Motemi bw'ens'eker'agocha, 'Nyore morendete.
hymns.refrain:
Bon'Omonene  natokonye,  Toserie  Saitani;
Bon'Omonene natokonye, Toserie Saitani.

hymns.title: Ning'o Bw' Omonene
verses:
Ning'o  bw'Omonene,  ning'ore  ang'e?
Abanto  barigetie  kogend'esegi;
Ning'o origeti'aret'abamwabo,
Bache  gokonyeka tibacha gosira?

Agatogora  tari  n'edhahabu,
Rigori'ri'amanyinga  eri'ogokumia;
Yes'otoichoiri'Omoik'Omochenu,
Twatigir'ebibe, Nabaye tore.

Esegi  nendoro  tiga  torore,
Oyorayebu'egonde  y'Erwoti;
Nse  as'ebendera  twatenenire,
Nao  torabuere na'omorembe.

hymns.title: Omoy'one Igwa
verses:
Omoy' one oki' etaya yao, Buya tongia bwang'aiga tari mwao;
Chinguru chi' ense chionsi chireo, Igorabue chionsi, koranche Yeso.

'Mobisa Saitani chinguru chiaye, Yeso ochibuire nogokwa
'Nguru tori, tori 'moremu, Aye nomwororo, mwororo mono.

Imoka ne mambia obotong'ane, Saba mono, tur' emiaka yonsi
Esegi nekare, obe namaiso, Oboe ne chinguru chisonsi chia Iso.

Omonene Yeso nere Omorisia, 'Ng'ana y'omonene nokobua
Igoro naete nense naende 'Ng'ana y'omonene ig'eragende.

hymns.title: Omonene Ng'ang'e Are Gocha
verses:
Omonene ng'ang' Are gocha, 'Banto bateba;
Ng'enang'eni chiarimire, Nebe ogokia kwe rituko.

Ebimanyererio biabeire, Risase n'omotienyi;
'Kurat'as'abanto bonsi. Ogocha kw'Omonene ng'ang'e Kore.

N'eng'aki as'ekanis'enganyi, Gotig'obweanchi;
Korenda, gwokia chitaya, Baganye rituko rigokia.

Genda bwango as' ebinchera, N'epar'enene bo;
Ranger'ebirema, 'meuko, Babe ang'ase rituk'erio.
hymns.refrain:
Ee neb'gokia kwe rituko! Ee nebi 'Ogokia kwe rituko!
'Botuko mboere, rituko richiche; Ee neb'ogokia Kwe rituko.

hymns.title: Yeso Omonene Nyigwa
verses:
Yeso Omonene nyigwa, 'Go ndasir 'ontankonyeti;
Ong'obuya bwa'Obonge, Naboigo ng'ira.

Nche n'omonyen'ebibe 'Manyinga'o nyegenete;
Kondach'as'ore, tokwanga, Naboigo ng'ira.

Okoegwa kw'ogokonyeka, Komanya nindengererie;
Ndich' as'ore nebisanyi, Naboigo ng'ira.

As'origetie gontoma, Ntoma nainche nindegende;
Ime na isiko boichore, Naboigo ng'ira.

As'origetie ong'e buya, Ng'a n'obwanchani oboyia;
Ime na Isiko boichore, Naboigo ng'ira.

Erio esegi ekoera, Nyuma okobua gokoera,
Nao abwo ndakorere, Naboigo ng'ira.

hymns.title: Natogende Intwe Twensi
verses:
Natogende intwe twensi as' emeremo yaye,
Natokore nomogoko, ne chinguru chionsi,
'banto bonsi baganyete, as' ogokonywa gwaito,
Natobatang 'ane bono, enchera y' Omonene.

Natogende, aborokia, as' enyomba ya Nyasae,
Toborokie abanto bonsi, chingencho chia Nyasae,
 Titokwa Moyo, as' ense tiga tosabe mono,
Erio natong'use abange, ase Omokonyi Oito.

Natokonye Abakristo, as' emeremo yaye,
 Kabe ang'e koyeimokia, 'mesigo 'merito,
Tob'ang'e gochiimokia 'gurube chindito,
Natoike seito bori, as' Obonda bwa Yeso.
hymns.refrain:
Nchwo togend', as' omogondo, as' emeremo yaye,
Nonya 'meke, gos' emenge, ninyekore nomokia,
'Banto bonsi, nimbakonye, nobwanchani, nobuya,
Nchwo 'Monene, nkonye bono, nkore emeremo yane.

hymns.title: Togw' As' Amatemwa
verses:
Togw'as' amatemwa, Kogwa n'ebibe,
Korabu'okomo,Nobu'ayande;
Orwane gesacha, Tiga 'ngencho chimbe,
Rigenia Yeso, Nagokony'obue.

Tig'abant'ababe, chinkwana chimbe,
'Rieta ria Nyasae, Risike mono;
Nach'ebiti'ebiya, Ob 'omoitongo,
Rigerenia Yeso, Nagokony'obue.

Er'oyorobabue, Nonyor'egutwa,
'S'okwegena ntobue, Nonya tokogwa;
Er' Omotori 'oito, Naratokongie,
Rigereria Yeso, Nagokony'obue.
hymns.refrain:
Saba Omotoria, Akaoe chinguru,
Nanchet' agokonye, Nagokony'obue.

hymns.title: 'Kero Kia Botuko Gati
verses:
Kero kia botuko gati, Malaik' agatera,
Ogotera Kw'Obonene, 'Makan'edahabu;
'Morembe n'obuy'as'ense, Korw'ase Nyasae,
Ense egakira eigwe, Malaik' agotera.

Naende abande bagacha, 'Meganda ya Igoro,
'Gotera okwo gokaigweka, 'b'ense yarosire;
Igoro y'ebitii ebio, Bakairurukao,
'Riogi riabo rikaigweka as'ens'ey'embe.

'Ba more inse y'egurube, 'Ba mwaisire gokwa,
Mwechandete as'enchera, Y'emechand'emenge;
Rora engaki y'obuya, Ngoch'er 'as' obwango,
Timok'as'encher' ensemo, Moigwe bagotera.

hymns.title: Nomwegene Yeso
verses:
Nomwegene Yeso and' onsi as' ore?
Nar' enkoro yao kera rituko?
Nor' omworokigwa? motemo' orore;
Nak'Omoika, omonge kegima.

'S 'obwanchani bwaye, orari 'erieta,
Ri'Omotori 'omuya, orwete_igoro,
Bachenu sasima ase Ring'ana;
Rikorw' ogotorek' as' amanyinga.

hymns.title: Orogendo Rwa Yeso
verses:
Orogendo rwa Yeso, Mogoko noyoino,
Motunyane Yeso Oino Imanweli;
Koborab'obororo, Tari ban'obwaye,
Enchera mogoeta, Nero aetete.

'Mosalaba o Yeso, Nainwe moimokie,
N'engata abegetwe, Nainwe negwenerete;
Ogwanch'okwo okwaye, Mobe nakorokwo,
Na Obwanchani bwaye, Boikaranse nainwe.
